Performance is generally due once a contract is formed—eg, when a mutual agreement is supported by valuable consideration. However, performance can be delayed or discharged by a condition—ie, an uncertain future event that must occur before performance becomes due or is discharged. There are two types of conditions:

  • Condition precedent* – delays performance until a specified event occurs and requires the plaintiff to prove that the event occurred to prevail
  • Condition subsequent – excuses performance once a specified event occurs and requires the defendant to prove that the event occurred to avoid liability

Here, the contract provided that the woman would be required to pay the life coach for the introductory course only if she received an offer for a second date at the speed-dating event. This created a condition precedent that delayed the woman's obligation to make that payment (Choices C & D). Therefore, the life coach must prove that the woman received an offer of a second date at the speed-dating event (ie, that the specified event occurred) to recover in his breach-of-contract action (Choice B).

*A condition concurrent arises when each party's obligation to perform is a condition precedent to the other party's obligation to perform (ie, when performance is due simultaneously).

📌 Educational Objective

A condition precedent delays performance until a specified event occurs and requires the plaintiff to prove that the event occurred to prevail. Conversely, a condition subsequent excuses performance once a specified event occurs and requires the defendant to prove that the event occurred to avoid liability.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§ 224–30 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (conditions related to performance).
questions.zh-question:
一位人生导师与一位内向的女士签订了一份合同，提供为期一周的课程，作为该人生导师为期一年项目的入门介绍。根据合同条款，该人生导师将与该女士进行为期一周的全职合作，教导她如何更自信地与人交往。之后，该女士将参加一个速配活动，作为其课程的“毕业典礼”。合同还规定，除非该女士在速配活动中收到第二次约会的要约，否则她没有义务支付入门课程的费用。如果她在速配活动中收到了第二次约会的要约，她必须在活动结束后的三天内向人生导师支付1000美元。

在依据合同条款与人生导师合作后，该女士参加了速配活动。活动结束四天后，由于该女士仍未向人生导师付款，人生导师对该女士提起了违约诉讼，要求根据合同追讨1000美元。

下列哪项最准确地陈述了适用于本案的举证责任？

zh-choices.A: 由于合同涉及先决条件，人生导师必须证明该女士在速配活动中收到了第二次约会的要约，方可胜诉。
zh-choices.B: 由于合同涉及先决条件，该女士必须证明她没有在速配活动中收到第二次约会的要约，方可免除责任。
zh-choices.C: 由于合同涉及后决条件，人生导师必须证明该女士在速配活动中收到了第二次约会的要约，方可胜诉。
zh-choices.D: 由于合同涉及后决条件，该女士必须证明她没有在速配活动中收到第二次约会的要约，方可免除责任。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Timing of Conditions

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：合同把付款义务挂在一个未来事件上时，这个事件是先决条件（condition precedent）还是解除条件（condition subsequent），以及原告要不要证明该事件发生。

三秒认题路径：

先看付款门槛 → 再看条件类型 → 原告举证 → 被告抗辩 → 选 A

核心法律规则

先决条件（condition precedent）的意思是：某件事先发生，合同里的履行义务才会到期，所以原告（plaintiff）要证明这件事真的发生了，才有资格赢。

解除条件（condition subsequent）的意思正相反：先有义务，后来某件事发生后义务才被免掉，所以通常要由被告（defendant）证明这个解除事件发生了，才能躲开责任。

这题里，女人只有在 speed-dating event 收到第二次约会邀请后才需要付款，所以 收到第二次约会邀请 是付款前必须发生的门槛，不是事后把义务取消的开关。

核心判例： 本题主要锁定的是 Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§ 224–30 的条件规则：先决条件由主张履行的一方证明。

思维导图

先看合同里的话：“only if she received an offer”，这是付款前门槛，还是付款后免责？
门槛型先发生第二次约会邀请，付款义务（performance due）才到期。
卡死点：这是先决条件（condition precedent），所以原告必须证明事件发生。
诉讼姿态 生活教练起诉要 $1,000 → 先证明条件成真。
结论 原告没证明“收到 offer”，就不能直接赢。
如果是解除条件（condition subsequent），才会变成“先有义务，后靠被告证明事件发生来免责”。
但本题不是 题干不是“除非后来发生某事，否则继续付款”，而是“只有先发生某事才付款”。
所以答案落在：A。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然女人没付钱，当然该由她证明自己不用付。

但考试真正问的是：这笔钱本来就是否已经到期，不是她有没有事后找借口。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

这题最常见的误区，是把“只有收到 offer 才付款”看成“先要付款、后来再免掉”，把门槛型条件误读成免责型条件。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干把付款绑在 收到第二次约会邀请 这个门槛上，所以它是先决条件；生活教练要拿到 $1,000，必须先证明该事件发生。

❌ 概念混淆 | 举证方向反了

✕ B: 把先决条件的举证责任推给女人了，命题人想骗你把门槛当免责。

❌ 法律适用 | 把门槛说成免责

✕ C: 看到 condition subsequent 就套进去，但题干是“先发生才付款”。

❌ 事实误判 | 偷换成事后免除

✕ D: 把 avoid liability 当成题干结构了，其实这里根本不是事后解除。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓句式“only if”，再判断是门槛条件还是免责条件，最后把举证责任放回原告一边。

考场速记

记住一句话：先决条件（condition precedent） = 先证明事件发生，原告才有权赢；解除条件（condition subsequent） = 先有义务，后由被告证明事件发生来免责。

看到 only if、unless、until，先问自己：这是“先到门槛才履行”，还是“先履行后免责”。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
On June 1, a seller and a buyer contracted in writing for the sale and purchase of the seller's cattle ranch (a large single tract), and to close the transaction on December 1. On October 1, the buyer told the seller, "I'm increasingly unhappy about our June 1 contract because of the current cattle market, and do not intend to buy your ranch unless I'm legally obligated to do so."
On October 15, the seller sued the buyer for breach of contract.
Is the seller likely to prevail?

choices.A: No, because the buyer's October 1 statement to the seller was neither a repudiation nor a present breach of the June 1 contract.
choices.B: No, because the parties contracted for the sale and conveyance of a single tract, and the seller cannot bring suit for breach of such a contract prior to the agreed closing date.
choices.C: Yes, because the buyer committed a total breach by anticipatory repudiation on October 1.
choices.D: Yes, because the buyer's October 1 statement created reasonable grounds for the seller's insecurity with respect to the buyer's performance.

questions.explanation:
Anticipatory repudiation
Standard Party's clear & unequivocal words or actions indicate unwillingness to perform
Retraction Party may retract repudiation unless nonrepudiating party:
  • cancels contract
  • materially changes position in reliance thereon or
  • indicates repudiation is final
Effect Upon repudiation, nonrepudiating party may:*
  • treat repudiation as breach or
  • ignore repudiation & demand performance
*Nonrepudiating party may also suspend own performance

A party's failure to perform his/her contractual duties at the time performance is due constitutes a breach. A breach can also occur before the time for performance arises or elapses under the doctrine of anticipatory repudiation. This doctrine applies when a party clearly and unequivocally, by words or acts, indicates an unwillingness to perform his/her contractual duties. The nonrepudiating party may treat the repudiation as a breach or ignore it and demand performance pursuant to the contract.

Here, the buyer's October 1 statement was not a present breach of the contract since performance is not due until December 1. And though the buyer stated that she did "not intend to buy" the seller's ranch, that statement was not an anticipatory repudiation. That is because the statement included the equivocal phrase "unless I'm legally obligated to do so" (Choice C). Therefore, the seller is unlikely to prevail.

(Choice B) The doctrine of anticipatory repudiation allows a party to sue for breach of any contract before the time for performance is due—including contracts for the sale of a single tract of property before the closing date.

(Choice D) The buyer's statement created reasonable grounds for the seller's insecurity with respect to the buyer's performance. However, the seller's recourse in this situation is to demand adequate assurances. If the buyer fails to provide such assurances, the buyer will be deemed to have anticipatorily repudiated the contract. The seller can then treat the repudiation as a breach.

📌 Educational Objective

The doctrine of anticipatory repudiation applies when a contracting party clearly and unequivocally indicates an unwillingness to perform. The nonrepudiating party may treat the repudiation as a breach or ignore it and demand performance pursuant to the contract.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 250 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (repudiation).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 253 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (effect of an anticipatory repudiation).

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Performance, Breach, and Discharge

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：买方在履行期前说“我不想买了”但又加了保留条件，算不算 预期违约（anticipatory repudiation）。

三秒认题路径：

未到交割日 → 先看拒绝 → 再看清楚明确 → 有保留条件 → 不算违约

核心法律规则

预期违约（anticipatory repudiation），考场意思：一方在履行日到来前，用话或行为清楚、明确地表示自己不会履行，另一方才可以把它当成现在的违约来处理。

清楚且明确（clear and unequivocal），考场意思：不能带模糊保留；只要语气还留着“也许会履行”的口子，就通常还没到可立刻起诉的程度。

合理不安与充分保证（reasonable insecurity and adequate assurances），考场意思：如果对方只是让你不放心，你先要保证，不是直接把它升级成违约。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 250 / § 253 —— 锁定本题：带着“unless I'm legally obligated to do so”这种保留条件，就不够明确，不能直接当预期违约。

思维导图

先看：10月1日这句话是不是 预期违约（anticipatory repudiation）？
第1步：12月1日才交割 → 现在还没到履行日，no present breach。
第2步：再看有没有“清楚且明确”的拒绝履行。
卡死点：加了 unless I'm legally obligated，说明不是彻底不履行。
第3步：既不是现时违约，也不是足够明确的预期违约。
结论：卖方现在起诉，通常赢不了，选 A。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：买方都说“do not intend to buy”了，应该已经毁约。

但考试真正问的是：这句话有没有达到 清楚且明确 的拒绝履行标准；这里的保留条件把它变成了可反悔的模糊表态。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干关键是 unless I'm legally obligated to do so，这说明买方并未作出清楚、明确的拒绝履行，所以既不是现时违约，也不是预期违约。

❌ 法律适用 | 单独标的误套

✕ B: 把“单一地块”误当成不能提前起诉的理由。

❌ 概念混淆 | 过早认定

✕ C: 把带保留条件的表态硬说成彻底拒绝。

❌ 事实误判 | 不安等同违约

✕ D: 只是引发不安，最多先要 adequate assurances。

这题建议用什么方法？

先卡履行时间，再抓“清楚且明确”这个门槛；只要话里还有保留条件，就先别把它升级成违约。

考场速记

记住一句：预期违约（anticipatory repudiation）只看“有没有把不履行说死”，没说死就先别急着起诉；如果只是让你不安，先想 充分保证（adequate assurances）。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
The owner of an apartment complex contracted in writing with a landscaper to install a sprinkler system for $20,000. The contract required the landscaper to install a specific brand of brass sprinkler heads. It also required the landscaper to install a $500 anti-backflow device, which was required by the city plumbing code but would not affect the sprinkler system's performance.
In order to speed up installation, the landscaper installed the sprinkler system using brass sprinkler heads left over from a previous job that, while not the brand specifically required by the contract, were equal in quality and performance. However, the landscaper did not install the anti-backflow device, even though the city plumbing code required it and the owner could be subject to a fine if the device were not installed.
The landscaper completed the installation work and then sought payment from the owner. The owner refused to pay the landscaper anything on the ground that the work did not comply with the contract.
If the landscaper sues the owner for breach of contract, what is the likely result?

choices.A: The landscaper will not recover, because he willfully and materially breached the contract.
choices.B: The landscaper will recover restitution for the cost spent on labor and materials.
choices.C: The landscaper will recover the contract price less the cost to remedy any defects in performance.
choices.D: The landscaper will recover the full contract price.

questions.explanation:
Substantial performance is less than full performance that, while imperfect, does not defeat the contract's main purpose. Under the common law—which governs contracts for services (eg, installing a sprinkler system)—a party that has substantially performed can recover damages based on the contract if the other party fails to perform.* Those damages are generally equal to the contract price minus the cost to remedy any defects in performance.

Here, the landscaper imperfectly performed by using the wrong brand of sprinkler heads and not installing the anti-backflow device. However, this did not defeat the contract's main purpose of providing the owner with a working sprinkler system. That is because the sprinkler heads were equal in quality and performance to the ones called for in the contract and the anti-backflow device did not affect performance. Therefore, the landscaper substantially performed and will likely recover the contract price less the cost to remedy any defects in performance (Choice D).

*In contrast, the Uniform Commercial Code requires "perfect tender," and substantial performance of a sale-of-goods contract does not allow a party to recover damages on the contract except for installment contracts or when the parties agree otherwise.

(Choice A) The extent to which a party has acted in bad faith (eg, by committing a willful breach) is one of several factors that courts consider in deciding whether a breach is material. Here, although the landscaper's breach was willful, it was not material since he fulfilled the contract's main purpose.

(Choice B) A party's failure to substantially perform the contract is a material breach. A party in material breach cannot recover on the contract but may be entitled to restitution damages for the reasonable value of benefits conferred on the other party—eg, the cost spent on labor and materials. But here, the landscaper did substantially perform so there was no material breach.

📌 Educational Objective

At common law, a party that has substantially performed—ie, rendered imperfect performance without defeating the contract's main purpose—can recover the contract price less the cost to remedy any defects in performance.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 237 cmt. d (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (effect of substantial performance).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 241 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (factors used to determine whether a breach of contract is material).
questions.zh-question:
一个公寓小区的业主与一名景观设计师签订了一份书面合同，约定以20,000美元的价格安装一套喷淋系统。合同要求景观设计师安装特定品牌的黄铜喷头。合同还要求景观设计师安装一个价值500美元的防回流装置，该装置是城市管道法规所要求的，但不会影响喷淋系统的性能。

为了加快安装速度，景观设计师使用了上一个项目中剩余的黄铜喷头来安装该喷淋系统，这些喷头虽然不是合同明确要求的品牌，但在质量和性能上是相同的。然而，景观设计师没有安装防回流装置，尽管城市管道法规要求安装，且如果不安装该装置，业主可能会被处以罚款。

景观设计师完成了安装工作，然后向业主要求付款。业主以工程不符合合同为由，拒绝向景观设计师支付任何费用。

如果景观设计师以违约为由起诉业主，最可能的结果是什么？

zh-choices.A: 景观设计师将无法获得赔偿，因为他故意且实质性地违反了合同。
zh-choices.B: 景观设计师将获得相当于其在劳工和材料上花费的成本的返还利益（restitution）。
zh-choices.C: 景观设计师将获得合同价格减去弥补履约中任何瑕疵所需成本后的金额。
zh-choices.D: 景观设计师将获得全部合同价格。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Performance of Contractual Duty

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：.common law下的实质履行（substantial performance），做得不完美但没毁掉合同主目的时，能不能按合同价减去补救成本收款。

三秒认题路径：

服务合同 → 不是货物 → 主目的没毁 → 只小瑕疵 → 扣补救费

核心法律规则

对服务合同（service contract），common law看的是有没有实质履行（substantial performance），也就是虽然有瑕疵，但没有打掉合同的主目的。主目的（main purpose）还在，承包方就不是全面违约，仍可按合同主张价款。

这时的考试结论通常是：合同价（contract price）减去补救成本（cost to remedy defects）。willful breach 只是判断是否“material breach”的因素之一，不会自动把小瑕疵升级成拿不到合同价。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 237 cmt. d, § 241 — 先看是否实质履行，再用缺陷补救成本去扣减，而不是一看到不完全一致就直接否掉全部报酬。

思维导图

题干先问：这是要不要“全额付款”还是“扣缺陷成本”的题？
1先看合同类型：服务合同（service contract），所以走 common law，不走 UCC 的 perfect tender。
2再看瑕疵有没有毁掉主目的：喷头品牌不对，但质量性能相同；没装防回流装置会受罚，但不影响喷水系统能正常工作。
卡死点：主目的仍在 = 实质履行（substantial performance） 成立，不能把承包商直接踢成“零回收”。
3所以结论是：可收 合同价，但要扣掉把瑕疵补齐的成本，而不是直接拿满额，也不是只能拿 restitution。
4记忆顺序：先判“有没有实质履行” → 再判“缺陷能补多少” → 最后算“价款减修复费”。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：他故意没装设备，还用了不是指定品牌的喷头，所以一定是重大违约。

但考试真正问的是：这些瑕疵有没有把喷水系统的主目的打掉；没有，就还是实质履行（substantial performance）。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。这题里真正重要的是缺陷怎么扣价，不是承包商看起来多“坏”。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干里喷头只是品牌不符但性能相同，防回流装置也不影响系统工作，说明他已实质履行，所以能拿合同价减去补救缺陷的费用。

❌ 概念混淆 | 误把小瑕疵当重违约

✕ A: 把willful breach直接当成致命违约，忽略了主目的还在。

❌ 法律适用 | 误套恢复返还

✕ B: 只有没实质履行才会走 restitution，这里他不是全面失败。

❌ 事实误判 | 漏看瑕疵补扣

✕ D: 看到已经完工就想直接全额给钱，忘了还要扣补救成本。

这题建议用什么方法？

先认合同是 common law 服务合同，再用“主目的有没有被毁”来卡住实质履行。

考场速记

记忆口诀：实质履行 = 还能收钱，但要扣修复费；perfect tender 主要是货物合同才会更严格。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.topic: Obligations of good faith & fair dealing
questions.question:
In a single writing, a painter contracted with a farmer to paint three identical barns on her rural estate for $2,000 each. The contract provided for the farmer's payment of $6,000 upon the painter's completion of the work on all three barns. The painter did not ask for any payment when the first barn was completely painted, but she demanded $4,000 after painting the second barn.
Is the farmer obligated to make the $4,000 payment?

choices.A: No, because the farmer has no duty under the contract to pay anything to the painter until all three barns have been painted.
choices.B: No, because the painter waived her right, if any, to payment on a per-barn basis by failing to demand $2,000 upon completion of the first barn.
choices.C: Yes, because the contract is divisible.
choices.D: Yes, because the painter has substantially performed the entire contract.

questions.explanation:
Order of performances*
Simultaneous performance possible Condition concurrent implied (ie, performance due simultaneously)
One performance requires time Condition precedent implied (ie, durational performance due before respective duty triggered)
*These rules apply unless express contractual language or circumstances indicate otherwise.

When a party performs one part of a divisible contract, the party is entitled to the agreed equivalent for that part—even if the party fails to perform the other parts of the contract. In other words, that party's performance of the entire contract is not a condition precedent to the other party's duty to perform. A contract is divisible if:

  • the parties' duties can be broken down into at least two corresponding pairs of performances and
  • those pairs of performances can fairly be regarded as agreed (i.e., bargained-for) equivalents.

Although courts prefer to interpret contracts as divisible for reasons having to do with fairness, they will not do so if the contract expressly states that it is indivisible.

Here, the parties' contract provided that the farmer had no duty to pay the painter anything until she had painted all three barns. As a result, the contract was expressly indivisible, and the painter's completion of the work on all three barns was a condition precedent to the farmer's duty to pay (Choice C). Therefore, the farmer is not obligated to pay the painter $4,000 (i.e., $2,000 per barn for two barns).*

*While the painter cannot recover $4,000 based on the contract price, the painter may be entitled to recover restitutionary damages. These damages allow the breaching party to recover the reasonable value of the work performed before the breach, less any damages suffered by the nonbreaching party to ensure that the nonbreaching party is not unjustly enriched.

(Choice B) The painter did not have a right to expect payment for each barn, so she could not waive such a right.

(Choice D) The painter did not substantially perform the contract since she failed to paint one of the three barns—a significant part of the performance for which the farmer contracted.

📌 Educational Objective

Although courts prefer to interpret contracts as divisible for fairness reasons, they will not do so in contradiction of the express terms of the contract.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 234 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (order of performances).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 240 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (part performances as agreed equivalents).

在一份单一书面文件中，一名油漆工与一名农场主签订合同，为其乡村庄园的三个相同谷仓进行粉刷，每个谷仓收费2,000美元。合同规定，农场主应在油漆工完成所有三个谷仓的粉刷工作后支付6,000美元。在第一个谷仓完全粉刷完毕时，油漆工并未要求任何付款，但在粉刷完第二个谷仓后，她要求支付4,000美元。

农场主是否有义务支付这4,000美元？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为根据合同，在所有三个谷仓都粉刷完毕之前，农场主没有义务向油漆工支付任何款项。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为油漆工在完成第一个谷仓后未能要求支付2,000美元，从而放弃了她可能拥有的按每个谷仓为基础获得付款的权利。
zh-choices.C: 是，因为该合同是可分割的。
zh-choices.D: 是，因为油漆工已实质性履行了整个合同。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Obligations of good faith & fair dealing

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：合同写明“做完三座仓才付钱”时，条件先决（condition precedent）是否成立，所以农民现在能不能先付这 $4,000。

三秒认题路径：

先做完？ → 才付款？ → 条件先决 → 不可分割 → 不能先要钱

核心法律规则

如果合同明确写了“对方要等你完成全部工作后才付款”，这就是条件先决（condition precedent），考场意思：没做到约定节点，对方就暂时没有付款义务。

如果双方义务能按对应部分拆成若干对价，这才更像可分割合同（divisible contract），考场意思：做完一部分就能拿对应部分的钱。

本题里合同明说“完成三座谷仓后才付款”，所以不是按每座仓单独结算，而是要等全部完成后农民才负付款义务。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§ 234, 240 — 先看合同写的是不是“先做完全部，再触发付款”；写死了，就按条件先决走，不按可分割去拆账。

思维导图

合同怎么写付款节点？
YES：“完成三座谷仓后才付款”
卡死点：这是条件先决（condition precedent），没做完三座，付款义务不触发。
NO：若写成“每完成一座就付对应价款”
才更像可分割合同（divisible contract），做一部分拿一部分。
结果：
农民现在不必付 $4,000
原因不是“没诚信”，而是合同还没到触发付款的时点。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：她已经刷完两座仓，应该能先拿两座的钱。

但考试真正问的是：合同有没有把“每座仓对应一笔钱”写成独立触发点；本题没有，反而写死了“全部完成后才付”。

所以不要把“做了很多”误当成“现在就有收款权”；看的是合同怎么触发付款，不是看你已经干了多少。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干 “完成三座谷仓后才付款” 已把付款义务锁成条件先决，所以农民现在没有义务先付这 $4,000。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ B: 把 waived 说成有单项收款权后放弃；题干根本没给这种权利。

❌ 法律适用 | 可分割误套

✕ C: 看到三座仓就硬拆成三笔独立账，但合同明写整单完成才付款。

❌ 事实误判 | 进度偷换

✕ D: 把 substantially performed 套进来，但她少了一座，离“整单履行”还差关键部分。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓付款触发点，再看合同有没有明示不可分割，最后排除可分割和实质履行的干扰。

考场速记

记住一句：先决条件（condition precedent）没到，付款义务就不启动；合同写“全部完成后付款”时，优先按整单算，不要自己帮它拆单。

速记：complete first, pay later；想起可分割再反问一句：合同有没有写成“一部分工作对应一部分钱”。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A fugitive was wanted for murder. The authorities offered the following reward: "$20,000 to anyone who provides information leading to the arrest and conviction of this fugitive." A private detective knew of the reward, located the fugitive, and brought him to the authorities, who arrested him. The authorities then determined that although the fugitive had, in fact, committed the crime, he had been directed to do so by his boss. The authorities and the fugitive then agreed that in exchange for the fugitive's testimony against his boss, all charges against the fugitive would be dropped. The fugitive testified and was released. The authorities refused to pay the reward to the private detective on the ground that the fugitive was never convicted.
Would the private detective be likely to prevail in a breach of contract action against the authorities?

choices.A: No, because the express conditions set out in the reward offer were not met.
choices.B: No, because the private detective failed to notify the authorities that he had accepted the reward offer.
choices.C: Yes, because the authorities' agreement with the fugitive was against public policy.
choices.D: Yes, because the authorities themselves prevented the conviction of the fugitive.

questions.explanation:
When nonoccurrence of condition is excused
Waiver • Party waives condition by words or conduct
Wrongful interference • Party wrongfully prevents or interferes with condition's occurrence
Estoppel • Party indicates condition will not be enforced
AND
• Other party reasonably & detrimentally relies on belief that condition has been waived
Disproportionate forfeiture • Party substantially performed & will be significantly harmed if condition is enforced

A party may generally avoid performance until a condition precedent—ie, an uncertain future event that must occur before either or both party's performance becomes due—has occurred. The nonoccurrence of a condition may be excused, however, if the party protected by the condition wrongfully prevents or interferes with its occurrence (eg, through a breach of the implied duty of good faith and fair dealing).

Here, the authorities' duty to pay the reward was subject to two conditions precedent—the arrest and conviction of the fugitive. The implied duty of good faith and fair dealing imposed a duty on the authorities to refrain from hindering either condition's occurrence. However, they breached that duty by agreeing to drop all charges against the fugitive despite their determination that he had committed the crime, thus excusing the express condition of conviction that was not met (Choice A). Therefore, the detective's suit will likely prevail.

(Choice B) In a unilateral contract, an offeree who accepts by completing the requested performance must give notice if he/she has reason to know that the completed performance will not come to the offeror's attention within a reasonable time. Here, there was no need for the detective to notify the authorities that he had accepted their reward offer because they learned of his performance when he brought the fugitive to them.

(Choice C) Whether the authorities' agreement with the fugitive was against public policy goes to the enforceability of the agreement between the fugitive and the authorities; it has no bearing on the outcome of this dispute.

📌 Educational Objective

The nonoccurrence of a condition may be excused if the party protected by the condition wrongfully prevents or interferes with its occurrence (eg, through a breach of the implied duty of good faith and fair dealing).

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§ 224–25 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (conditions and effect of non-occurrence).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 245 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when a party's wrongful interference excuses a condition).
questions.zh-question:
一名逃犯因谋杀罪被通缉。当局发布了以下悬赏：“向任何提供导致该逃犯被逮捕和定罪信息的人士提供20,000美元。”一名私家侦探知晓此悬赏，找到了该逃犯，并将其带至当局，当局随即将他逮捕。随后，当局确定，尽管该逃犯确实犯下了罪行，但他是在其老板的指使下所为。于是，当局与该逃犯达成协议，以换取该逃犯指证其老板的证词为条件，撤销对该逃犯的所有指控。该逃犯作证后被释放。当局以该逃犯从未被定罪为由，拒绝向私家侦探支付赏金。

在对当局提起的违约诉讼中，该私家侦探是否可能胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为悬赏要约中列明的明示条件未被满足。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为私家侦探未能通知当局他已接受悬赏要约。
zh-choices.C: 是，因为当局与逃犯达成的协议违反了公共政策。
zh-choices.D: 是，因为当局自己阻止了对该逃犯的定罪。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Excuse of conditions

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：条件先决（condition precedent）本来没成就，但被保护该条件的一方自己故意或不当阻止了条件发生，所以还能不能拒付。

三秒认题路径：

奖励合同 → 条件先决 → 自己阻止 → 条件被免除 → 仍要付款

核心法律规则

只抓这条规则

条件先决（condition precedent）是指某个不确定未来事件先发生，合同义务才到期；没发生时，表面上可以不履行。

但如果受该条件保护的一方违反善意与公平交易义务（implied duty of good faith and fair dealing），自己不当阻止（wrongful interference）条件发生，考试上就会把这个“没成就”免除（excused）。

所以这题不是看“有没有字面上的 conviction”，而是看官府有没有自己把 conviction 这一步堵死；如果是自己堵死的，就不能拿没 conviction 当借口拒付奖励。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 245 - 受保护方若不当阻止条件成就，条件的不发生可被免除。

思维导图

先问：奖励支付是不是被“抓到并定罪”这个条件卡住了？
是表面上，没 conviction 就不用付。
再问谁让 conviction 没发生？
官府自己和 fugitive 达成协议，主动撤掉指控，等于把条件堵死。
结论不当阻止（wrongful interference）→ 条件不发生被免除 → 奖励义务仍到期。
答案选 D。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然最后真的没有 conviction，那就直接按字面条件拒付。

但考试真正问的是：是不是条件一方自己把条件弄没了。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

这题里真正会害你选错的，不是案情戏剧性，而是把“条件未成就”误看成“永远都不付”。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干的 conviction 本来是条件先决，但官府自己和 fugitive 交易撤诉，等于把条件堵死，所以不答应付钱的借口站不住。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 只盯着 express conditions，忘了条件也会因对方阻止而被免除。

❌ 事实误判 | 通知义务偷换

✕ B: 把完成抓捕说成还要额外通知，但题干里官府已经亲眼知道他抓到人了。

❌ 法律适用 | 公共政策错位

✕ C: 拿 public policy 去打 fugitive 协议，但这题争的是奖励合同能不能拒付。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看条件先决，再查是不是条件保护方自己把条件弄没了。

考场速记

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A sailor owns an exceptionally seaworthy boat that she charters for sport fishing at a $500 daily rate. The fee includes the use of the boat with the sailor as the captain, and one other crew member, as well as fishing tackle and bait. On May 1, a customer agreed with the sailor that the customer would have the full-day use of the boat on May 15 for himself and his family for $500. The customer paid an advance deposit of $200 and signed an agreement that the deposit could be retained by the sailor as liquidated damages in the event the customer canceled or failed to appear. On May 15 at 1:00 a.m., the Coast Guard issued offshore "heavy weather" warnings and prohibited all small vessels the size of the sailor's boat from leaving the harbor. This prohibition remained in effect throughout the day. The customer did not appear at all on May 15, because he had heard the weather warnings on his radio.
Which of the following is an accurate statement of the parties' legal relationship?

choices.A: The contract is discharged because of impossibility, and the customer is entitled to return of his deposit.
choices.B: The contract is discharged because of mutual mistake concerning an essential fact, and the customer is entitled to return of his deposit.
choices.C: The contract is not discharged, and the customer is not entitled to return of his deposit, because the liquidated-damage clause in effect allocated the risk of bad weather to the customer.
choices.D: The contract is not discharged, because its performance was possible in view of the exceptional seaworthiness of the sailor's boat, and the customer is not entitled to return of his deposit.

questions.explanation:
Ways to discharge contractual obligations
  • Full performance of contractual obligations
  • Impossibility, impracticability, or frustration of purpose
  • Release (in writing only)
  • Mutual rescission
  • Substituted contract
  • Contract or covenant not to sue
  • Accord & satisfaction
  • Novation
Mnemonic: FIRM SCAN

A contract is canceled or rescinded due to the occurrence of an unexpected or extraordinary event if:

  • that event makes it impossible or impracticable for one or both parties to perform their duties*
  • the contract was formed under a basic assumption that the event would not occur and
  • neither party was at fault in causing the event to occur.

Rescission excuses both parties' nonperformance of the contract (ie, discharges their obligations). This means that damages for breach cannot be recovered and any deposit or other benefit conferred on the other party must be returned.

Here, the customer contracted to use the sailor's boat and paid a $200 deposit. But the Coast Guard issued a heavy-weather warning and prohibited all small vessels from leaving the harbor—making it objectively impossible to use the boat despite its exceptional seaworthiness (Choice D). The parties must have assumed that the Coast Guard would not prohibit the use of the boat, and neither party could control its decision to do so. Therefore, the contract is discharged because of impossibility, and the customer is entitled to return of his deposit.

*Impossibility will generally be found only in these specific situations: (1) the death or incapacity of someone necessary for performance, (2) the destruction of the contract's subject matter, and (3) the prevention of performance by governmental regulation or order (as seen here).

(Choice B) In contract law, a mistake is an erroneous belief regarding the facts and/or law as they exist at the time of contracting. This could not be a case of mutual mistake since the Coast Guard prohibition was not in effect when the contract was entered.

(Choice C) A liquidated-damages clause is unenforceable as a penalty if the amount is so unreasonably large that it punishes the breaching party (as opposed to merely compensating the nonbreaching party). But this would not be a reason to discharge a contract.

📌 Educational Objective

A contract is rescinded, and both parties' contractual obligations are discharged, when (1) an unexpected or extraordinary event makes performance impossible or impracticable, (2) the contract was formed under a basic assumption that the event would not occur, and (3) neither party was at fault in causing the event to occur.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 261 cmt. d (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that an unexpected event can discharge a party's duty to perform due to impossibility or impracticability).

以下哪项是对双方当事人法律关系的准确陈述？

zh-choices.A: 合同因履行不能而解除，顾客有权要求退还其定金。
zh-choices.B: 合同因对关键事实存在共同错误而解除，顾客有权要求退还其定金。
zh-choices.C: 合同未解除，顾客无权要求退还其定金，因为违约金条款实际上已将恶劣天气的风险分配给了顾客。
zh-choices.D: 合同未解除，因为鉴于该水手船只异常的适航性，合同的履行是可能的，顾客无权要求退还其定金。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Performance, Breach, and Discharge

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：遇到政府命令把合同标的的使用直接堵死时，合同能不能因不可履行（impossibility）而解除，押金要不要退。

三秒认题路径：

政府禁航 → 不能出海 → 不能履行 → 合同解除 → 退押金

核心法律规则

不可履行（impossibility）的考场意思：不是“做起来很麻烦”，而是因为外部事件让履行客观上做不到。政府规制或命令（government regulation or order）把小船禁止出港时，承租人和船主都不能完成当天的用船安排，所以合同可以解除。

解除（discharge）后，双方都不用继续履行，先付的款项也要返还；这不是在讨论谁违约赔多少，而是在讨论合同义务本身已经被法律切断。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 261 cmt. d - 说明意外事件若让履行变成不可能或不切实际，可解除合同义务。

思维导图

先问：这是终局判决吗？
NO： 这是一道取证/程序性命令，不是案件结束。
再问：有没有法定中间上诉？
没有特别授权，就继续看附带命令原则（collateral-order doctrine）。
三要件里最关键的是：事后还能不能有效救济？
这题是强制披露律师特权材料，事后通常仍可复审，第三要件没过。
所以：不能立刻上诉，必须等终局后再救济。
对应本题答案：政府禁航使履行客观不能，合同解除，押金退回。
关键触发： 海岸警卫队禁航令 + 小船不能出港。
关键结论： 不是“天气不佳”，而是履行被外部命令挡住。
答案走向： A 成立；如果是上诉题则看 Mohawk，不是立刻上诉。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：船本身“特别耐海”，所以应该还能履行，或者天气只是让出海变难，不至于解除。

但考试真正问的是：外部政府命令已经把当天的履行路径堵死了，和船多结实没有关系。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干的禁航令让小船当天客观不能出港，属于政府命令导致的不可履行；因此合同解除，已付deposit要退还。

❌ 概念混淆 | 事后事实误填

✕ B: 把后来的禁航当成订约时就存在的mutual mistake。

❌ 法律适用 | 违约后果误套

✕ C: 把liquidated-damage条款说成能保住已无法履行的合同。

❌ 事实误判 | 船况细节偷换

✕ D: 盯着“异常耐海”就忽略了真正挡路的是government order。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓外部事件有没有把履行“直接卡死”，再判断是不可履行还是普通违约。

考场速记

记住：不可履行（impossibility）看的是“能不能做”，不是“想不想做”。政府命令把履行堵住时，合同通常解除，先付的钱也要退。

口诀：FIRM SCAN，先扫 Full performance、Impossibility / impracticability / frustration、Release、Mutual rescission、Substituted contract、Contract not to sue、Accord & satisfaction、Novation。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A buyer agreed to purchase and took delivery of a telescope from a seller for a price of $100. She promised to pay him $100 "as soon as I am able."
What effect does the quoted language have on the enforceability of the buyer's promise?

choices.A: None.
choices.B: It makes the promise illusory.
choices.C: It requires the buyer to prove her inability to pay.
choices.D: It requires the seller to prove the buyer's ability to pay.

questions.explanation:
Delay or discharge of performance
Contract formed

Suit filed

precedent

Performance is generally due once a contract is formed (e.g., when a mutual agreement is supported by valuable consideration). However, performance can be delayed or discharged by a condition—i.e., an uncertain future event that must occur before performance becomes due or is discharged. There are two types of conditions:

  • Condition precedent* – delays performance until a specified event occurs (e.g., buyer's promise to pay as soon as she is able) and requires the plaintiff to prove that the event occurred to prevail
  • Condition subsequent – excuses performance if a specified event occurs (e.g., buyer's nonobligation to pay if telescope is delivered late) and requires the defendant to prove that the event occurred to avoid liability

Here, a contract was formed when the buyer agreed to purchase the telescope from the seller for $100. The buyer's promise to pay "as soon as I am able" created a condition precedent that delayed her obligation to make the promised payment until she could pay. This language therefore requires the seller to prove the buyer's ability to pay (i.e., that the specified event occurred) before he can enforce the buyer's promise (Choices A and C).

*A condition concurrent arises when each party's obligation to perform is a condition precedent to the other party's obligation to perform (i.e., when performance is due simultaneously).

(Choice B) A promise is illusory and unenforceable if it actually promises nothing because it is vague or because the promisor can choose whether to honor it—e.g., had the buyer promised to pay $100 "if I want to." But here, the buyer's promise to pay $100 "as soon as I am able" is not illusory because the buyer committed to paying when she could.

📌 Educational Objective

Performance is generally due once a contract is formed. However, the contract can contain a condition precedent that delays performance until—or a condition subsequent that will excuse performance if—a specified event occurs.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§ 224–230 (Am. L. Inst. 1981) (discussing conditions related to performance).
questions.zh-question:
一位买方同意从一位卖方处购买一台望远镜并已收货，价格为100美元。她承诺“待我有能力支付时”即支付卖方100美元。

上述引用的表述对买方承诺的可执行性有何影响？

zh-choices.A: 没有影响。
zh-choices.B: 它使该承诺成为虚幻的承诺。
zh-choices.C: 它要求买方证明其无力支付。
zh-choices.D: 它要求卖方证明买方有能力支付。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Performance, Breach, and Discharge

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：买方说“等我有能力时再付钱”时，这句话是在设先决条件（condition precedent），还是在让她的付款义务变成可立即逃掉的空话。

三秒认题路径：

合同已成立 → 付款附条件 → 先决条件 → 卖方举证 → 选 D

核心法律规则

规则只抓这一条

合同一旦成立，通常就该履行；但如果履行被先决条件（condition precedent）卡住，义务要等那个未来事件发生后才到期。“as soon as I am able” 的考场意思：不是“我想付就付”，而是“等我有能力付款后才付”。

所以本题里，卖方要先证明买方已经有能力付款，才能强制执行这句承诺；这不是买方去证明自己没能力。附带条件（condition subsequent） 则相反，是先有义务，再用后来的事件把义务免掉，这题不是这个结构。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§ 224–230 - 这组规则把“先决条件”和“附带条件”的举证方向直接锁死。

思维导图

合同已经成立，但付款要不要现在到期？
先看“as soon as I am able”
这不是空话式承诺；它是在等“有能力付款”这个事件发生。
定性先决条件（condition precedent）
事件未发生前，付款义务还没到期。
举证谁主张付款到期，谁先证明条件成就
卖方要证明买方“有能力了”，才轮到法院支持他收钱。
结论不能说买方自己先证明“我还没能力”
所以正确答案是：D。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：买方写了“as soon as I am able”，是不是等于她在替自己留后门，所以应该由她证明自己没能力。

但考试真正问的是：这句话把付款义务往后推了，谁想让义务现在到期，谁就得证明那个条件已经成就。

考场看的是“谁能让义务到期”，不是“谁更容易解释自己的财务状况”。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干 as soon as I am able 把付款义务拖到买方“有能力”之后才到期，所以卖方要先证明条件成就，才能收钱。

❌ 事实误判 | 先后次序偷换

✕ A: 把“有能力”当成无影响，直接忽略了题干加的付款条件。

❌ 概念混淆 | 空话承诺误判

✕ B: 看到 illusory 就慌，但这句不是“我想付就付”的空承诺。

❌ 法律适用 | 举证方向倒置

✕ C: 把证明责任塞给买方，和“先决条件由主张到期的一方证明”正好相反。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓条件类型，再看义务到底有没有到期，最后顺着举证方向选答案。

考场速记

记住这句：先决条件（condition precedent）先证明“条件成就”，附带条件（condition subsequent）才是后面再证明“义务被免掉”。

本题一句口诀：“想让付款现在到期，先证明她已经有能力。”

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A homeowner and a planner signed a detailed writing in which the planner, a landscape architect, agreed to landscape and replant the owner's residential property in accordance with a design prepared by the planner and incorporated in the writing. The owner agreed to pay $10,000 for the work upon its completion. At the owner's insistence, the written agreement contained a provision that neither party would be bound unless the owner's law partner, an avid student of landscaping, should approve the planner's design. Before the planner commenced the work, the owner's law partner, in the presence of both the owner and the planner, expressly disapproved the landscaping design. Nevertheless, the owner ordered the planner to proceed with the work, and the planner reluctantly did so. When the planner's performance was 40% complete, the owner repudiated his duty, if any, to pay the contract price or any part thereof.
If the planner now sues the owner for damages for breach of contract, which of the following concepts best supports the planner's claim?

choices.A: Irrevocable waiver of condition.
choices.B: Promissory estoppel.
choices.C: Substantial performance.
choices.D: Unjust enrichment.

questions.explanation:
When nonoccurrence of condition is excused
Waiver
  • Party waives condition by words or conduct
Wrongful interference
  • Party wrongfully prevents or interferes with condition's occurrence
Estoppel
  • Party indicates condition will not be enforced
  • AND
  • Other party reasonably & detrimentally relies on belief that condition has been waived
Disproportionate forfeiture
  • Party substantially performed & will be significantly harmed if condition is enforced

A contracting party may generally avoid performance if a condition precedent—ie, an uncertain future event that must occur before either or both parties' performance becomes due—has not occurred. The nonoccurrence of a condition may be excused, however, if the party who benefits from the condition waives it by words or conduct. And the waiving party cannot retract the waiver if the other party has detrimentally relied on it.

Here, the agreement provided that it would be binding if the owner's law partner approved the planner's landscape design (condition precedent). The law partner disapproved the design (nonoccurrence), but the owner ordered the planner to proceed with the work anyway (waiver). And because the planner detrimentally relied on that waiver by completing 40% of the work, the owner could not retract it (ie, the waiver was irrevocable). Therefore, the concept of irrevocable waiver of condition best supports the planner's breach-of-contract claim.

(Choice B) Under the doctrine of promissory estoppel, a party can enforce a promise on which it reasonably and detrimentally relied when no valid contract was formed. But because a contract was formed here, this doctrine does not apply.

(Choice C) The planner did not substantially perform under the contract since his performance was only 40% complete.

(Choice D) The doctrine of unjust enrichment applies in the absence of a valid contract to prevent one party from receiving a benefit from another that was not rightfully earned and would be unfair to keep.

📌 Educational Objective

Nonoccurrence of a condition precedent may be excused if the party who benefits from the condition waives it by words or conduct. The waiving party cannot retract the waiver if the other party has detrimentally relied on it.
questions.zh-question:
一位房主和一位规划师签署了一份详细的书面文件，其中规划师（一位景观设计师）同意根据其本人编制并已纳入书面文件的设计，对房主的住宅物业进行景观美化和重新种植。房主同意在工作完成后支付10,000美元。在房主的坚持下，该书面协议包含一项条款，规定除非房主的法律合伙人（一位热衷于景观设计的爱好者）批准规划师的设计，否则任何一方均不受协议约束。在规划师开始工作之前，房主的法律合伙人在房主和规划师均在场的情况下，明确表示不批准该景观设计。尽管如此，房主仍命令规划师继续进行工作，规划师不情愿地照办了。当规划师完成40%的履约时，房主拒绝履行其支付合同价款或其任何部分的义务（如果存在此义务）。

如果规划师现在因违约向房主提起损害赔偿诉讼，以下哪个概念最能支持规划师的主张？

zh-choices.A: 不可撤销的条件放弃。
zh-choices.B: 允诺禁反言（Promissory estoppel）。
zh-choices.C: 实质性履行。
zh-choices.D: 不当得利。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Performance, Breach, and Discharge

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：附条件合同里，受益方已经用言行放弃了先决条件（condition precedent），而且对方已据此履行，所以这个放弃不能随便反悔。

三秒认题路径：

先决条件 → 口头/行为放弃 → 对方已依赖 → 放弃不可撤回 → 卖方可索赔

核心法律规则

如果合同写着要某个先决条件（condition precedent）先发生，才轮到一方履行，那条件没发生时，一般可以不履行。放弃（waiver）就是受益方用言语或行为表示“这个条件我不要了”，考场意思：对方可以继续按合同干活。

如果另一方已经因为这个表示而合理且不利地依赖（detrimentally relied），放弃通常就不可撤回（irrevocable）。这题里，业主让规划师继续施工，规划师又干到 40%，所以业主不能再拿“没批准设计”来脱责。

核心判例：本题逻辑对应 waiver of condition 的传统规则：受益方一旦用言行放弃条件，并诱发对方依赖，就不能回头反悔。

思维导图

合同先问：设计批准是不是 先决条件（condition precedent）？
是批准没来，原则上业主可拒绝付钱。
但受益方有没有用言行把条件放弃（waiver）了？
有业主当场叫规划师继续干活。
对方有没有据此依赖？
有规划师继续施工，已经完成 40%。
卡死点：依赖已发生，放弃不可撤回，所以“没批准”这张牌不能再翻出来。
结论：规划师可以按违约追损害赔偿。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然设计没被批准，合同条件没成就，那业主就能一句话不付钱。

但考试真正问的是：受益方已经用行为把条件放弃了，而且另一方已经照着这个表示去做了，能不能再反悔。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的损失有没有发生」。 这题不是在比谁更吃亏，而是在看谁把条件先放弃了。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干里业主当面让规划师继续施工，已经构成对 审批条件 的放弃；规划师又继续干到 40%，所以这项放弃不可撤回。

❌ 概念混淆 | 先合同误判

✕ B: 这是 promissory estoppel，但本题合同已经成立，不是没合同的救济。

❌ 法律适用 | 完成度误判

✕ C: 只做了 40% 就想拿 substantial performance，进度太早。

❌ 事实误判 | 无合同偷换

✕ D: unjust enrichment 要先看没有效合同，这里不是这条路。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看条件有没有被放弃，再看对方有没有依赖；有依赖时，优先锁定不可撤回的 waiver。

考场速记

记忆口诀：条件先决（condition precedent）被受益方用言行放弃后，只要对方已经依赖，通常就不能反悔。

看到“我让你继续干”这类事实，先想 waiver，再想依赖；别把它误当成 promissory estoppel。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A manufacturer contracted in a signed writing to provide a company with industrial ceiling tiles for its new production facility. The contract specified that the manufacturer would deliver the tiles by third-party carrier, "F.O.B. the company's production facility."
While in transit to the production facility, one-third of the tiles fell off the carrier's truck and were destroyed. The manufacturer subsequently emailed the company that it did not intend to replace the tiles. The company sent a letter to the manufacturer that read in relevant part: "You are not responsible for replacing the damaged tiles. We will sue the carrier." The company signed the letter. Shortly thereafter, the carrier filed for bankruptcy and the company decided to sue the manufacturer for breach of contract.
Will the company be likely to prevail?

choices.A: No, because the company's signed letter operated as a release and discharged the manufacturer from its remaining contractual duties.
choices.B: No, because the tiles were specifically identified goods that were destroyed through no fault of either party.
choices.C: Yes, because the manufacturer bore the risk of loss when the tiles were destroyed and breached the contract by refusing to replace the tiles.
choices.D: Yes, because there was no new consideration to support the release of the manufacturer's remaining contractual duties.

questions.explanation:
Titleholder's risk of loss during transport
(UCC sale of goods)
FOB shipment
Seller
Buyer
FOB destination
Seller
Buyer
= seller holds title
= buyer holds title
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

Under the UCC, which governs contracts for the sale of goods, the risk of loss generally passes to the buyer when the buyer receives the goods. But if the contract requires the seller to deliver the goods by third-party carrier, then the risk of loss passes to the buyer at different times depending on whether the contract is a:

  • shipment contract – does not require delivery at a particular location, so the risk of loss passes to the buyer when the goods are properly delivered to the carrier or
  • destination contract – requires delivery at a particular location, so the risk of loss passes to the buyer when goods are delivered at the named location.

Destination contracts are often identified by the letters "F.O.B." (free on board) followed by a location (as seen here). And since the ceiling tiles were in transit to the company's production facility when they were destroyed, the risk of loss was with the manufacturer at that time. Therefore, the manufacturer was in breach when it informed the company that it did not intend to replace the tiles (Choice C).

However, the company then sent the manufacturer a letter stating that the manufacturer was not responsible for replacing the damaged tiles. This operated as a release—ie, a writing that manifests an intent to discharge another party from an existing duty. The UCC requires that a release be signed by the releasing party (as the company did here), but no consideration is needed (Choice D).* Therefore, the company is unlikely to prevail in its suit against the manufacturer.

*For common-law contracts, the release must be supported by consideration or a consideration substitute (eg, detrimental reliance) to be effective.

(Choice B) A seller's performance is excused if specifically identified items of inventory are destroyed through no fault of either party before the risk of loss passes to the buyer. Since the tiles here were general inventory items, the manufacturer's performance was not excused on this basis.

📌 Educational Objective

A release is a writing that manifests an intent to discharge another party from an existing duty. The UCC requires the release to be signed by the releasing party, but new consideration is not required for the release to be effective.

📚 References
  • U.C.C. § 1-306 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (waiver or renunciation of claim or right after breach).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 284 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (release).
questions.zh-question:
一家制造商在一份签署的书面合同中承诺，为其新生产设施向一家公司提供工业天花板瓷砖。合同规定，制造商将通过第三方承运人交付瓷砖，条款为“F.O.B. 公司生产设施”。

在运往生产设施的途中，三分之一的瓷砖从承运人的卡车上掉落并被损毁。制造商随后通过电子邮件告知该公司，其不打算更换这些瓷砖。该公司向制造商发送了一封信函，其中相关部分写道：“贵方不负责更换损坏的瓷砖。我方将起诉承运人。”公司签署了该信函。此后不久，承运人申请破产，该公司决定以违约为由起诉制造商。

该公司是否可能胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 不会，因为公司的署名信函起到了责任豁免的作用，免除了制造商剩余的合同义务。
zh-choices.B: 不会，因为这些瓷砖是特定物，其损毁并非由于任何一方的过错。
zh-choices.C: 会，因为在瓷砖被损毁时，制造商承担了灭失风险，并且其拒绝更换瓷砖的行为构成了违约。
zh-choices.D: 会，因为没有新的对价来支持免除制造商剩余的合同义务。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Performance, Breach, and Discharge

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：UCC货物买卖里，卖方先看起来有风险，但买方后来签了release（免责书），会不会把卖方责任直接放掉。

三秒认题路径：

F.O.B.到达地 → 运输中毁损 → 先看风险 → 再看release → 卖方脱责

核心法律规则

F.O.B. the company’s production facility 是 destination contract（到达地合同），考场意思：货没送到指定地点前，risk of loss（毁损风险） 通常还在卖方这边。risk of loss 先不利于卖方，不代表买方一定能赢，因为买方后来可以用 release（免责书） 放弃继续追究。release 在 UCC 下只要是放弃方签字，new consideration 考场意思：不需要再加新对价。

核心判例： 本题规则锁定在 U.C.C. § 1-306 和 Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 284：买方签了放弃函，就算之前卖方本来可能违约，后面也可能被放掉。

思维导图

先问：货损时，卖方有没有先承担风险？
是，因为什么？
F.O.B.到达地 = 目的地交货，货在路上毁损时，卖方先背风险。
但下一关更关键：
买方后来有没有签字把权利放掉？
有
签了 release（免责书） → 放弃继续追责 → 卖方不再承担这次诉讼责任。
所以结论
答案选 A：买方难以胜诉

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然货在运输中毁了，而且 risk of loss 还在卖方，买方当然能继续告违约。

但考试真正问的是：买方后来自己签了 release（免责书），等于把这条索赔路先关掉了。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的货有没有已经毁掉」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干里公司自己签了信，明确说 you are not responsible，这就是有效 release，所以卖方剩余义务被放掉了。

❌ 事实误判 | 货物属性偷换

✕ B: 把 specifically identified 说成已满足，但题目是一般库存货，不是特定标的。

❌ 法律适用 | 风险归属误判

✕ C: 只盯着运输毁损就冲动选，但忽略了后面的签字放弃函已经切断救济。

❌ 概念混淆 | 对价要求混淆

✕ D: 把 no new consideration 当成致胜点；UCC 的 release 本来就不靠新对价。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看风险归属，再看有没有书面 release 把原本能告的权利直接放掉。

考场速记

记住一句：F.O.B. 到达地先判风险归属，但只要买方后来签了 release，通常就别再追卖方了；In Certain Circumstances, An Appeal Can Be Made Prematurely 这类口诀是中间上诉题才用，本题真正要记的是“先看 release，再看对价”。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A homeowner contracted in writing with a kitchen contractor to renovate her kitchen for $25,000, "subject to the homeowner's complete personal satisfaction." The contractor replaced the cabinets, flooring, and countertops and then sought payment from the homeowner. The homeowner paid the contractor only $20,000, truthfully saying that she did not like the finish on the cabinets and was therefore not satisfied.
If the contractor sues the homeowner for the balance of the contract price, will the contractor be likely to prevail?

choices.A: No, because a condition to the homeowner's obligation to pay was not satisfied.
choices.B: No, because the contractor breached his duty of good faith and fair dealing by supplying unsatisfactory materials.
choices.C: Yes, because the homeowner breached the covenant of good faith and fair dealing by rejecting the cabinets without justification.
choices.D: Yes, because the homeowner was the first party to breach the contract.

questions.explanation:
Meeting condition of satisfaction
Objective standard (default) Whether reasonable person would be satisfied with performance
Subjective standard (aesthetics) Whether promisor is personally satisfied with performance (provided that dissatisfaction is honest & in good faith)

Many contracts include a condition precedent that a party's duty to pay will not become due unless the party is satisfied with the other party's performance (ie, condition of satisfaction). Satisfaction is typically measured objectively, meaning that the condition is met if a reasonable person would be satisfied. But if aesthetic taste is involved, satisfaction is measured subjectively. In that case, the condition is met only if the promisor is personally satisfied, provided that any dissatisfaction is honest and in good faith.

Here, the homeowner's duty to pay for the kitchen renovation was subject to her "complete personal satisfaction." This condition of satisfaction was not met because the homeowner was honestly dissatisfied with the cabinets' finish. As a result, the homeowner was not obligated to make the promised payment, and the contractor likely will not prevail in a suit to recover the balance of the contract price **(Choices C & D)**.

(Choice B) There is no indication that the materials supplied by the contractor were unsatisfactory. And even if they were, using unsatisfactory materials is not a breach of the covenant of good faith and fair dealing.

📌 Educational Objective

When a contract conditions a duty to pay on satisfaction with another party's performance, satisfaction is measured objectively. But when the condition involves a party's aesthetic taste, the condition is only met if that party is personally satisfied with the other party's performance, provided that any dissatisfaction is honest and in good faith.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 228 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (party's satisfaction as a condition).
questions.zh-question:
一位房主与一名厨房承包商签订了书面合同，以25,000美元的价格翻新她的厨房，“前提是房主完全个人满意”。承包商更换了橱柜、地板和台面，然后向房主索要付款。房主只支付了承包商20,000美元，并如实说她不喜欢橱柜的饰面，因此不满意。

如果承包商就合同价款的余款起诉房主，承包商是否可能胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 不会，因为房主付款义务的一个条件未获满足。
zh-choices.B: 不会，因为承包商提供了不合格的材料，违反了其诚信与公平交易的义务。
zh-choices.C: 会，因为房主无理拒绝橱柜，违反了诚信与公平交易的契约。
zh-choices.D: 会，因为房主是首先违约的一方。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Satisfaction Of Conditions

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：合同把付款义务设成条件先决（condition precedent）时，若标的是主观审美满意条款，法院看的是买方是否真诚地不满意，而不是旁观者觉得值不值。

三秒认题路径：

付款前提 → 满意条款 → 审美装修 → 主观诚实 → 不用付款

核心法律规则

条件先决（condition precedent）的意思是：没满足之前，付款义务就不触发，所以先别急着看承包商有没有拿到钱。满意条款（condition of satisfaction）通常用客观标准，考场意思：看reasonable person会不会满意。可是一旦题目碰到装修、外观、品味这类审美判断（aesthetic taste），就改成主观标准，只要当事人是真诚、善意地不满意，条件就没成就。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 228 — 它把“能不能真诚不满意”直接锁成本题结论。

思维导图

先看付款义务是不是被写成 满意条件（condition of satisfaction）？
是
再问争议点是不是 审美/品味（aesthetic taste）？
是
改用主观标准：本人是否真诚满意？
卡死点：题干说 homeowner 真诚地不喜欢 cabinets 的 finish，所以条件没成就。
结论：付款义务不发生 → 承包商拿不到尾款 → 选 A。
否
若只是一般履约质量，就看客观人是否会满意；但本题不是这条路。
否
如果根本没有条件条款，就回到一般违约分析；本题已被“complete personal satisfaction”卡住。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：厨房都装完了，承包商已经完成工作，当然该拿到全款。

但考试真正问的是：付款有没有被合同先绑在“我本人满意”这个门槛上。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

这里最容易被骗成“只要工程看起来没毛病就得付钱”，但题目已经把标准改成了主观满意，所以只要 homeowner 诚实不满意，就能挡住付款义务。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干明确写了付款以 complete personal satisfaction 为前提，而 homeowner 对 cabinets finish 真诚不满意，所以条件没满足，尾款义务不发生。

❌ 法律适用 | 义务归属误判

✕ B: 把 good faith 甩到承包商头上，但题干没说他用坏材料骗钱。

❌ 概念混淆 | 反向归责误判

✕ C: 误把 homeowner 的诚实不满说成违约，good faith 不是强迫她假装满意。

❌ 事实误判 | 先后顺序偷换

✕ D: 题干没有“先违约”的事实，拒付只是条件没成就。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓付款前提，再分清“客观满意”还是“主观审美”，别被完工事实带偏。

考场速记

记住一句：审美满意条款看本人是否真诚满意，不看旁观者替他满意。

若题目问到一般履约质量，就回到客观标准；若问装修、外观、品味，就先想“主观真诚不满”。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A seller and a buyer entered into a contract obligating the seller to convey title to a parcel of land to the buyer in exchange for $100,000. The agreement provided that the buyer's obligation to purchase the parcel was expressly conditioned upon the buyer's obtaining a loan at an interest rate no higher than 10%. The buyer was unable to do so but did obtain a loan at an interest rate of 10.5% and timely tendered the purchase price. Because the value of the land had increased since the time of contracting, the seller refused to perform. The buyer sued the seller.
Is the buyer likely to prevail?

choices.A: No, because an express condition will be excused only to avoid forfeiture.
choices.B: No, because the contract called for a loan at an interest rate not to exceed 10% and it could not be modified without the consent of the seller.
choices.C: Yes, because the buyer detrimentally changed position in reliance on the seller's promise to convey.
choices.D: Yes, because the buyer's obtaining a loan at an interest rate no higher than 10% was not a condition to the seller's duty to perform.

questions.explanation:
When nonoccurrence of condition is excused
Waiver
  • Party waives condition by words or conduct
Wrongful interference
  • Party wrongfully prevents or interferes with condition's occurrence
Estoppel
  • Party indicates condition will not be enforced
  • AND
  • Other party reasonably & detrimentally relies on belief that condition has been waived
Disproportionate forfeiture
  • Party substantially performed & will be significantly harmed if condition is enforced

Performance is generally due once a contract is formed. However, a party may avoid performance if a condition precedent—ie, an uncertain future event that must occur before either or both parties' performance becomes due—has not occurred, and the nonoccurrence is not excused. Nonoccurrence of a condition may be excused by waiver if the party who benefits from the condition chooses to perform despite the nonoccurrence.

Here, the buyer's duty to perform under the contract by purchasing the land was expressly conditioned on obtaining a loan at an interest rate no higher than 10% (condition precedent). The buyer was unable to do so (nonoccurrence) but tendered the purchase price anyway (waiver). Since the buyer waived the condition, the seller was also required to perform by conveying title to the buyer. Therefore, the buyer will likely prevail.

(Choice A) It is untrue that an express condition (ie, one that appears in the contract) will be excused only to avoid disproportionate forfeiture. There are other excuses, such as waiver.

(Choice B) The buyer's waiver of the condition was not a contract modification requiring the seller's consent since it did not alter the material terms of the contract (eg, purchase price).

(Choice C) Under the doctrine of promissory estoppel, a party can enforce a promise on which it reasonably and detrimentally relied when no valid contract was formed. But here, a valid contract was formed, so the buyer's reliance is irrelevant.

📌 Educational Objective

Nonoccurrence of a condition may be excused by waiver if the party that benefits from the condition chooses to perform despite the nonoccurrence.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 224 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (definition of condition).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 225 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (effect of non-occurrence of condition).
questions.zh-question:
卖方和买方签订了一份合同，约定卖方有义务将一块土地的所有权转让给买方，以换取100,000美元。协议规定，买方购买该土地的义务明确以买方获得年利率不高于10%的贷款为条件。买方未能获得该贷款，但确实以10.5%的利率获得了贷款，并及时支付了购买价款。由于自签约时起土地价值已经上涨，卖方拒绝履行合同。买方对卖方提起了诉讼。

买方胜诉的可能性大吗？

zh-choices.A: 不大，因为只有在为了避免权利丧失的情况下，明示条件才会被豁免。
zh-choices.B: 不大，因为合同要求贷款利率不超过10%，且未经卖方同意，该条款不得修改。
zh-choices.C: 很大，因为买方因信赖卖方的转让承诺而使其处境发生了不利的改变。
zh-choices.D: 很大，因为买方获得不高于10%利率的贷款并非卖方履行义务的条件。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Performance, Breach, and Discharge

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：买方对自己受益的先决条件（condition precedent）可以通过继续履行而放弃（waiver），所以卖方不能拿这个条件没成就来拒绝过户。

三秒认题路径：

先决条件 → 买方没达标 → 仍照付价 → 视为放弃 → 卖方要履行

核心法律规则

合同履行一般从合同成立后开始，但如果某一方的义务被先决条件（condition precedent）卡住，条件没成就时，通常可以暂时不履行。

不过，放弃（waiver）可以让条件失效：如果“受益于该条件”的一方明知条件没满足，还是选择继续履行，就等于把这个门槛自己拿掉了。

这里，买方的付款义务本来受“贷款利率不高于10%”限制，但买方拿到10.5%的贷款后仍按时付款，说明买方放弃了这个条件；因此卖方也必须按合同过户。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§ 224、225 — 条件的定义和后果：条件不成就时，一般不生履行义务，但受益方可通过 waiver 让条件失效。

思维导图

先看：买方的“10%贷款”是给谁设的门槛？
关键点只限制买方的购房义务，不是给卖方的过户义务加条件。
事实触发买方没拿到 10% 贷款，但拿到 10.5% 贷款后仍按时交钱。
规则关卡受益方继续履行 = waiver（放弃）。
卡死点：条件虽没成就，但已被买方放弃，卖方不能据此拒绝过户。
结论买方可胜诉，卖方仍要履行。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：这是个express condition，条件没成就就一定不能强制履行。

但考试真正问的是：受益于条件的一方自己还要不要把条件当回事。 买方既然照样付款，就是在考试里把这个门槛放掉了，不是靠“条件没成就”反过来逃掉自己的履行。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干 买方在10.5%贷款下仍及时付款，说明买方作为受益方已放弃该条件，所以卖方不能借条件未成就拒绝过户。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 以为只有forfeiture才救得了条件，其实 waiver 也能让条件失效。

❌ 法律适用 | 修改同意误判

✕ B: 把买方放弃条件当成改合同条款，误以为必须卖方同意。

❌ 事实误判 | 依赖关系偷换

✕ C: promissory estoppel 要的是没有效合同，这里早已先有合同。

这题建议用什么方法？

先找条件受益方，再问他有没有继续履行；有，就先想 waiver，不要先跳到 forfeiture 或 estoppel。

考场速记

记住一句：“谁受益，谁可以放弃”；受益方明知条件没成就还照做，通常就是 waiver。

这题的速记公式：condition precedent 没成就 ≠ 自动免责，先看受益方有没有自己把门槛放掉。

reason.en: Establishes a condition that must occur before performance is required.

B.text: modified without the consent of the seller

reason.en: Incorrectly applies reliance principles where a valid contract exists.

D.text: not a condition to the seller's duty

reason.en: Recognizes the condition was not for the seller's benefit and thus cannot be used by the seller to refuse performance.
reason.zh: 确认该条件并非为卖方利益设定，因此卖方不能以此拒绝履行。

highlights.text: buyer's obligation to purchase the parcel was expressly conditioned upon the buyer's obtaining a loan at an interest rate no higher than 10%

reason.en: Identifies that the condition precedent was established solely for the buyer's protection.
reason.zh: 识别出该先决条件是专为保护买方利益而设立的。

highlights.text: The buyer was unable to do so but did obtain a loan at an interest rate of 10.5% and timely tendered the purchase price

reason.en: Shows the buyer waived the loan condition by tendering the purchase price anyway.
reason.zh: 表明买方通过提出履行（支付货款）的方式放弃了贷款条件。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A manufacturer of computer chipsets for smartphones contracted to sell to a tech company 1 million chipsets each month for three years, payment for each installment to be made upon delivery. Before delivering the first installment, the manufacturer told the tech company, "Our manufacturing plant is undergoing renovations. This will likely have a temporary impact on the quantity, but not the quality, of chipsets in future installments." The manufacturer delivered the first three installments to the tech company in compliance with the contract. However, the fourth installment contained only 500,000 chipsets. The tech company accepted the installment on the manufacturer's assurance that the remaining 500,000 chipsets would be delivered in two weeks, which they were. Then the manufacturer communicated that the fifth installment likely would contain only 500,000 chipsets.
Which of the following statements best describes the tech company's rights after receiving the manufacturer's most recent communication regarding the fifth installment?

choices.A: It can demand adequate assurance that the fifth installment will conform to the contract and treat a failure to give immediate assurance as a repudiation.
choices.B: It can treat the manufacturer's communication as a repudiation and sue for breach of contract.
choices.C: It cannot demand adequate assurance that the fifth installment will comply with the contract because it accepted a nonconforming installment.
choices.D: It cannot sue for breach of contract if it demands, and the manufacturer gives, adequate assurance that the fifth installment will comply with the contract.

questions.explanation:
Prospective inability to perform v. Anticipatory repudiation

Contract
formed
Doubtful ability to perform =
Prospective inability to perform
Clear & unequivocal refusal to perform =
Anticipatory repudiation
Demand for assurance (in writing under UCC)
Repudiation from failure to assure
Reasonable time for assurance
(≤ 30 days under UCC)
Action for breach
Performance due
Action for breach
Performance due
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

A party's statements or conduct may cast doubt on its ability or willingness to perform under the contract. This prospective inability to perform is not a breach of contract because—unlike anticipatory repudiation—the party has not clearly and unequivocally refused to perform. However, it gives the other party the right to demand assurance of performance and suspend its own performance until assurance is provided. Failure to provide such assurance within a reasonable time (not to exceed 30 days under the UCC) constitutes a breach.

Here, the manufacturer communicated that the fifth installment likely would contain only 500,000 chipsets. Although this cast doubt on the manufacturer's ability to deliver 1 million chipsets as promised (prospective inability to perform), it was not a clear and unequivocal refusal to do so (no anticipatory repudiation). Therefore, the tech company cannot sue for breach of contract if it demands, and the manufacturer gives, adequate assurance that the fifth installment will comply with the contract (Choice B).

(Choice A) A party that receives a proper demand for assurance has a reasonable time to provide assurance (not to exceed 30 days under the UCC) before the other party can treat the failure to do so as a repudiation. As a result, the tech company cannot treat a failure to give immediate assurance as a repudiation.

(Choice C) In an installment contract, a party that accepts a nonconforming payment or delivery (eg, the fourth installment of 500,000 chipsets) does not forfeit the right to demand adequate assurance that future installments will comply with the contract.

📌 Educational Objective

One party's prospective inability to perform under the contract gives the other party the right to demand assurance of performance and suspend its own performance until assurance is provided. Failure to provide assurance within a reasonable time (not to exceed 30 days under the UCC) constitutes a breach.

📚 References
  • U.C.C. § 2-609 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (right to adequate assurance of performance).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 251 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining when a party's failure to give adequate assurance may be treated as repudiation).
questions.zh-question:
一家智能手机电脑芯片组制造商与一家科技公司签订合同，在三年内每月向其出售100万个芯片组，每批次货款在交货时支付。在交付第一批货物之前，该制造商告知科技公司：“我们的制造工厂正在进行翻新。这可能会对未来批次的芯片组数量产生暂时性影响，但不会影响其质量。” 制造商按照合同规定向科技公司交付了前三批货物。然而，第四批货物仅包含50万个芯片组。在制造商保证剩余的50万个芯片组将在两周内交付后，该科技公司接受了这批货物，而制造商也确实做到了。随后，制造商告知，第五批货物可能也只包含50万个芯片组。

在收到制造商关于第五批货物的最新通知后，以下哪项陈述最准确地描述了该科技公司的权利？

zh-choices.A: 它可以要求对方提供第五批货物将符合合同规定的充分保证，并将未能立即提供保证的行为视为毁约。
zh-choices.B: 它可以将制造商的通知视为毁约，并以违约为由提起诉讼。
zh-choices.C: 它不能要求对方提供第五批货物将符合合同规定的充分保证，因为它曾接受过不符合同规定的批次。
zh-choices.D: 如果它要求，且制造商就第五批货物将符合合同规定提供了充分保证，则它不能以违约为由提起诉讼。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Performance, Breach, and Discharge

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：未来履约可疑时，对方能不能先要 adequate assurance（充分保证），而不是直接按 anticipatory repudiation（预期违约） 处理。

三秒认题路径：

看出货不稳 → 先问保证 → 不是拒绝 → 可催保证 → 给了就别告

核心法律规则

这道题只看这条规则

当一方的话或行为只是在制造 prospective inability to perform（未来可能无法履约），考场意思：它让你怀疑，但还没到“我就是不履约了”的程度。

这时，对方可以发出 demand for adequate assurance（要求充分保证），并暂缓自己的履行；如果对方在合理时间内给了保证，就不能立刻按违约起诉。

只有在没有给出充分保证，或者已经出现清楚、明确的拒绝履约时，才会走到 repudiation（拒绝履约） 或 breach 的路径。

核心判例： Mohawk Industries v. Carpenter 不适用本题；本题真正锁定的是 U.C.C. § 2-609 的充分保证规则：先催保证，给了就先别告。

思维导图

题干先告诉你：第五批可能只有 50 万件，但还没说“绝不交足”
第一步：这是 final judgment（终局判决） 吗？不是，本题根本不是上诉题。
真正判断：这是 prospective inability to perform（未来履约可疑），还是 anticipatory repudiation（预期违约）？
卡死点：这里只是“可能少交”，不是“明确拒绝交”。
法律动作：先发 adequate assurance，再决定是否继续等。
结果：只要制造方给了充分保证，买方就不能直接把这次通信当成 breach 起诉。
答案走向：选 D，不是 A/B/C。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然前面已经少交过一次，这次一听到“还可能少交”，是不是就能直接当成 repudiation？

但考试真正问的是：这句话有没有到“明确拒绝履约”的程度；它没有，所以只能先要保证，不能直接把它升级成立即可诉的违约。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干的 likely would contain only 500,000 chipsets 只是引发合理怀疑，不是明确拒绝；所以买方先要 adequate assurance，对方给了就不能直接起诉。

❌ 法律适用 | 即时违约误判

✕ A: 把 immediate assurance 说成立刻违约，错在把“合理时间”抹掉了。

❌ 概念混淆 | 预期违约误判

✕ B: 它还没明确说不交足，命题人骗你把“可疑”当成“拒绝”。

❌ 事实误判 | 已验收外推

✕ C: 先前接受过 nonconforming installment，不等于放弃以后再要保证。

这题建议用什么方法？

先分清是“可疑履约”还是“明确拒绝”，再看有没有 adequate assurance。

考场速记

记住一句：prospective inability to perform 先催保证，anticipatory repudiation 才能直接当违约。

口诀：“先怀疑，后保证；不拒绝，先别告。”

question_analysis.skill_tested: distinguishing anticipatory repudiation from prospective inability

reason.en: Identifies that the contract is for the sale of computer chipsets, which are goods, meaning the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) governs the transaction.
reason.zh: 确定该合同是关于计算机芯片（货物）的销售，这意味着统一商法典（UCC）适用于该交易。

reason.en: Indicates an installment contract under the UCC, which requires separate deliveries and separate acceptances.
reason.zh: 表示UCC下的分期交付合同，该合同要求分开交付和分开接受。

reason.en: Shows that the tech company did not reject the nonconforming fourth installment, raising the issue of whether it waived future rights.
reason.zh: 表明科技公司并未拒绝不符合合同的第四次分期交付，从而引申出其是否放弃了未来权利的问题。

reason.en: Indicates a prospective inability to perform rather than an anticipatory repudiation, as the statement is not an unequivocal refusal to perform.

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A buyer agreed in writing to purchase a car from a seller for $15,000, with the price to be paid on a specified date at the seller's home. The contract provided, and both parties intended, that time was of the essence. Before the specified date, however, the seller sold the car to a third party for $18,000. On the specified date, the buyer arrived at the seller's home prepared to tender payment. The seller was not there, so the buyer called the seller to ask where he was. The seller then told the buyer that he had sold the car to the third party.
If the buyer sues the seller for breach of contract, will the buyer be likely to prevail?

choices.A: No, because the buyer did not tender her performance on the specified date.
choices.B: No, because the contractual obligations were discharged on the ground of impossibility.
choices.C: Yes, because the seller anticipatorily repudiated the contract when he sold the car to the third party.
choices.D: Yes, because the seller did not inform the buyer of his repudiation.

questions.explanation:
The doctrine of anticipatory repudiation
Did party clearly & unequivocally indicate unwillingness to perform?
No
No anticipatory repudiation
Yes
Anticipatory repudiation
Did party retract repudiation before other party did any of the following?
  • Canceled contract
  • Materially changed position or
  • Indicated repudiation is final
Yes
Repudiation retracted
No
Nonrepudiating party may:*
Treat repudiation as breach
OR
Ignore repudiation & demand performance
*The nonrepudiating party may also suspend its performance if commercially reasonable

A contract is breached when a party fails to perform contractual duties at the time performance is due. A breach can also occur before the time for performance arises or elapses under the doctrine of anticipatory repudiation. This doctrine applies when a party clearly and unequivocally, by words or actions, indicates an unwillingness to perform.* Upon repudiation, the nonrepudiating party can suspend his/her own performance and either:

  • • treat the repudiation as a breach and sue immediately or
  • • ignore the repudiation and demand performance pursuant to the contract.

Here, the seller clearly and unequivocally repudiated the contract with the buyer by selling the car to a third party. Since the buyer has the right to treat this anticipatory repudiation as a breach of contract, she will likely prevail in a suit against the seller.

*If a party's words or actions provide reasonable grounds for insecurity about the party's performance, the other party may demand adequate assurances.

(Choice A) The buyer arrived at the seller's home on the specified date to tender payment. However, since the seller had anticipatorily repudiated the contract, the buyer's duty to tender performance was discharged.

(Choice B) Performance is discharged due to impossibility when an unexpected and extraordinary event beyond the parties' control makes performance impossible. But since the seller's own actions made it impossible to sell the car, his contractual obligations were not discharged.

(Choice D) The seller did not need to inform the buyer of his repudiation because an anticipatory repudiation can be express or implied. It is express if the repudiating party informs the other of his/her intention not to perform and is implied if the repudiating party's actions prevent him/her from being able to perform (as seen here).

📌 Educational Objective

Anticipatory repudiation occurs when a contracting party clearly and unequivocally, by words or actions, indicates that he/she will not perform. Upon repudiation, the nonrepudiating party can suspend his/her own performance and either (1) treat the repudiation as a breach and sue or (2) ignore it and demand performance.

📚 References
  • U.C.C. § 2-610 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (anticipatory repudiation).

如果买方以违约为由起诉卖方，买方是否可能胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为买方未在指定日期提交其履行。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为合同义务以履行不能为由被解除。
zh-choices.C: 是，因为卖方在将车卖给第三方时，已构成预期毁约。
zh-choices.D: 是，因为卖方未将其毁约一事通知买方。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Performance, Breach, and Discharge

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：一方在履行期限前用卖给第三人这种行为，是否构成 预期违约（anticipatory repudiation），从而让对方可以立刻起诉。

三秒认题路径：

未到履行日 → 卖给他人 → 明确不履行 → 预期违约 → 可立即起诉

核心法律规则

预期违约（anticipatory repudiation） 是指：履行期限还没到，一方就用言语或行为明确表示自己不会履行。考试上，这等于先把对方“违约牌”亮出来，对方不用傻等到到期日。

一旦出现 repudiation，守约方可以选择 把 repudiation 当作 breach 立即起诉，也可以先不理会、继续要求履行。这里卖车给第三人，已经把合同标的处置掉，等于把自己履行的门直接关上。

核心判例： U.C.C. § 2-610 锁定了这题的结论：卖方用行为明确表示不再能按合同卖车，买方可直接按预期违约起诉。

思维导图

先看：卖方在履行日前，是否用行为明确表示“不履行”？
是卖给第三人 = 预期违约已成立
守约方可选：立即按 breach 起诉 或 继续要求履行
本题结论：买方可胜诉，选 C
不是 只是含糊不清 / 还没到不能履行的程度
那就不是 anticipatory repudiation，不能直接按这条规则赢。
别被带偏 到期日是否 tender、impossibility、是否通知，都不是这里的主考点。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：买方到期日没真正交钱，所以她先违约了。

但考试真正问的是：卖方在到期前已经先把车卖掉，自己先构成了 预期违约（anticipatory repudiation）。

这题看的是“谁先把合同履行门关上”，不是看谁先站到门口。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干里卖方先把车卖给第三人，这个 before the specified date 的行为已经清楚表示不再履行，所以买方可按预期违约立即起诉。

❌ 事实误判 | 到期履行偷换

✕ A: 把买方没交钱当成先违约，忽略了卖方已先 sold the car。

❌ 法律适用 | 不可能履行误套

✕ B: 这是卖方自己卖掉导致不能履行，不是外部意外造成的 impossibility。

❌ 概念混淆 | 通知要件误判

✕ D: 误以为必须先正式通知才算 repudiation，但行为本身就能构成拒绝履行。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓“到期前是否明确不履行”，再判断守约方能否直接把它当 breach 处理。

考场速记

记住一句：到期前先把标的卖掉，就是在用行为说“我不交了”。遇到 预期违约（anticipatory repudiation），先问“有没有明确拒绝履行”，再问“守约方能不能立刻起诉”。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
On June 1, a woman telegraphed a vendor, "At what price will you sell 100 of your basic garbage-disposal units for delivery around June 10?" On June 2, the vendor telegraphed the woman, "You're in luck. We have only 100 basic garbage-disposal units, all on clearance at 50% off usual wholesale of $120 per unit, for delivery at our shipping platform on June 12." On June 5, the vendor received a letter from the woman that stated, "I accept. Would prefer to pay in full 30 days after invoice."
On June 6, the woman received a telegram from the vendor that stated, "You must pick up at our platform and pay upon delivery." On June 9, the vendor received a letter from the woman that stated, "I don't deal with people who can't accommodate my simple requests." On June 10, the vendor received a telegram from the woman that stated, "Okay. I'm over a barrel and will pick up the goods on your terms on June 12." The vendor had sold all 100 of the units to another buyer earlier that day.
The woman sued the vendor for breach of contract.
Which of the following arguments will best serve the vendor's defense?

choices.A: The vendor's telegraph on June 2 was merely a price quotation, not an offer.
choices.B: The woman's letter on June 5 was not an acceptance because it varied from the terms of the vendor's initial telegraph.
choices.C: The woman's letter on June 9 was an unequivocal refusal to perform that excused the vendor even if the parties had previously formed a contract.
choices.D: The woman's use of the mail in response to the vendor's initial telegraph was an ineffective method of acceptance.

questions.explanation:
Anticipatory repudiation
Standard Party's clear & unequivocal words or actions indicate unwillingness to perform
Retraction Party may retract repudiation unless nonrepudiating party:
  • cancels contract
  • materially changes position in reliance thereon or
  • indicates repudiation is final
Effect Upon repudiation, nonrepudiating party may:*
  • treat repudiation as breach or
  • ignore repudiation & demand performance
*Nonrepudiating party may also suspend own performance

The doctrine of anticipatory repudiation applies when a party clearly and unequivocally indicates an unwillingness to perform a promise before the time for performance is due. The nonrepudiating party may treat the repudiation as a breach or ignore it and demand performance pursuant to the contract. Additionally, any performance owed by the nonrepudiating party is excused.

Here, the parties likely formed a contract for the sale of the garbage-disposal units, which the vendor then sold to another buyer on June 10. However, the vendor's performance may be excused by the woman's anticipatory repudiation on June 9. That is because her June 9 letter could be interpreted as an unequivocal refusal to perform since it stated, "I don't deal with people who can't accommodate my simple requests." Therefore, this argument will best serve the vendor's defense.*

*The woman will not be able to argue that she retracted her repudiation because her attempted retraction occurred after the vendor had materially changed position in reliance on the repudiation by selling the units to another buyer.

(Choice A) An offer must express definite terms and an intent to be bound, thereby justifying acceptance by the offeree. Here, the vendor's June 2 telegraph would probably be interpreted as an offer (not a price quotation) because its terms were definite (100 units at 50% off) and it gave the woman the power to accept.

(Choice B) Contracts for the sale of goods (eg, garbage-disposal units) are governed by the UCC, which follows the battle-of-the-forms rule for contract formation. Under this rule, an enforceable contract is created once there has been an offer and acceptance—even if the acceptance varies the terms of the offer (as seen here).

(Choice D) The woman's use of the mail was an effective method of acceptance since the vendor did not specify how acceptance was to be rendered.

📌 Educational Objective

When a party anticipatorily repudiates a contract, the nonrepudiating party may treat the repudiation as a breach or ignore it and demand performance. Additionally, any performance owed by the nonrepudiating party is excused.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code
📚 References
  • U.C.C. § 2-610 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (anticipatory repudiation).

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Anticipatory Repudiation

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：一方在履行期前用清楚、明确的话表示不履行时，另一方能不能把它当成违约并据此抗辩。

三秒认题路径：

未到履行日 → 明确拒绝 → anticipatory repudiation → 可当违约 → 卖方胜

核心法律规则

只抓能改答案的规则

预期违约（anticipatory repudiation），考场意思：在履行期到来前，只要一方用清楚、明确的言行表示不想履行，对方就能把这句话当成现在的违约。

非违约方（nonrepudiating party），考场意思：可以直接把它当违约，也可以先不翻脸、继续要求履行；自己的后续履行也能先暂停。

这里的关键不是“有没有已经到交货日”，而是六月九日那封信是不是已经把“我不履行”说清楚了。若是，卖方六月十日再转卖给别人，通常就更像是在行使抗辩，而不是自己先违约。

核心判例： U.C.C. § 2-610 — 这条规则直接锁定：一方明确拒绝履行时，另一方可先按违约处理并停止自己的履行。

思维导图

先看六月九日那封信：是不是履行期前的明确拒绝？
YES清楚、明确地说不干了
这就触发 anticipatory repudiation
效果卖方可以把它当成违约，自己的履行先不做也行
卡死点：不用等到六月十二日才算违约
结果六月十日卖给别人后，卖方更像在用权利止损
对应答案：选 C
NO只是讨价还价、抱怨、犹豫
那就还不是 repudiation，卖方不能靠它免责

考点陷阱

你可能会想：女方六月九日那句话没有直接写“我拒绝履行”，所以不能算数。

但考试真正问的是：这句话放在整段来读，能不能让卖方合理看出她在六月十日之前已经不想按合同走了。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

这题的坑就在于把“语气委婉”误当成“没有拒绝”。MBE 只要你能看出是明确拒绝，就会把它当成 repudiation；别被后面六月十日的“我愿意照做”带跑，因为卖方已经先卖货并改变立场了。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

六月九日那封信可读成 明确拒绝履行，因此卖方即使已形成合同，也能据此主张 anticipatory repudiation 免责。

❌ 概念混淆 | 价格报价误判

✕ A: 把 price quotation 当结论，但题干给了定量和折扣，像要约不是单纯报价。

❌ 法律适用 | 镜像接受误判

✕ B: 抓着 varied terms 说没接受，可货物买卖里这不等于当然失败。

❌ 事实误判 | 邮寄方式偷换

✕ D: 以为 mail 当然无效，但卖方没指定方式时，邮寄照样可能有效。

这题建议用什么方法？

先锁定“是否已明确拒绝”，再看对方是否可以把它当成现在的违约来抗辩。

考场速记

记住一句：anticipatory repudiation 不是等到最后一天才算数，只要“清楚、明确不履行”，对方就能先把它当违约。

口诀：“看见履行前的明确拒绝，先想 repudiation；对方可当违约，自己可暂停。”
