questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A young lawyer asked her neighbor to lend her $1,000. On September 15, the neighbor lent $1,000 to the lawyer, which she agreed to repay in installments of $100 plus accrued interest on the last day of each month beginning October 31. The lawyer did not pay the installments due on October 31, November 30, or December 31 and has informed the neighbor that she will be unable to make repayments in the foreseeable future.
On January 15, the neighbor is entitled to a judgment against the lawyer for which of the following amounts?

choices.A: Nothing, because if the neighbor sues before the entire amount is due, he will be splitting his cause of action.
choices.B: $300 plus the accrued interest, because the lawyer's breach is only a partial breach.
choices.C: $1,000 plus the accrued interest, because the failure to pay her debts as they come due indicates that the lawyer is insolvent and the neighbor is thereby entitled to accelerate payment of the debt.
choices.D: $1,000 plus the accrued interest, because the lawyer's unexcused failure to pay three installments is a material breach.

questions.explanation:
Installment contracts
Deliveries
  • Price for each installment generally due at time & place of each delivery
  • Seller's damages for breach amount to missed payments
  • Buyer's damages for breach amount to fair market value minus contract price for missed deliveries
Payments
  • Creditor's damages for breach amount to missed payments

Breach by nonperformance coupled with repudiation of the contract typically gives rise to a claim for damages for total breach. This is true unless, at the time of the breach, the only contractual obligation that remains is for the breaching party to make installment payments of money. In that circumstance, the breaching party's failure to pay—whether or not coupled with a repudiation—gives rise to a claim for damages for partial breach only. This means that the nonbreaching party can recover the missed payments.

Here, the lawyer failed to pay the first three installments of $100 plus accrued interest (breach by nonperformance) and informed the neighbor that she would be unable to make repayments in the foreseeable future (repudiation). However, the only contractual obligation remaining on either side was for the lawyer to make the rest of the installment payments. Therefore, the neighbor has a claim for damages for partial breach only, and he is entitled to a judgment against the lawyer for $300 plus the accrued interest (missed payments).

(Choice A) After breach of an installment contract, the nonbreaching party can (1) wait until the end of the contract and sue for the total damages or (2) split the cause of action—ie, sue for partial breach immediately and reserve the right to sue again for later breaches.

(Choice C) Under the UCC, each party to a sale-of-goods contract gains certain rights when the other party becomes insolvent無力償債（資不抵債）. However, this does not apply to loan contracts, which are governed by common law.

(Choice D) A material breach occurs when the nonbreaching party fails to receive the substantial benefit of the contract. But failing to make a few payments of an installment loan is only a partial breach.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

📌 Educational Objective

Breach by nonperformance coupled with repudiation typically gives rise to a claim for total breach. But where the only duty that remains at the time of breach is for the breaching party to pay installments, the failure to do so—whether or not coupled with a repudiation—gives rise to a claim for partial breach only.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 243 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (effect of breach by nonperformance).

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Performance of Contractual Duty

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：分期还款贷款里，借款人没按期付前几期，还顺带表示以后也不还时，能不能直接按 总违约（total breach） 算。

三秒认题路径：

分期贷款 → 先欠三期 → 还放话不还 → 只剩还款义务 → 只能按部分违约算

核心法律规则

先抓规则，再看本题

预期违约（repudiation）一般会把案件推向总违约（total breach），但前提是合同中还剩下的不只是“分期付钱”这种最后义务。分期付款合同（installment contract）里，如果到违约时剩下的唯一义务就是继续按期付款，那么不论有没有放话不履行，考试上通常都按部分违约（partial breach）处理。部分违约（partial breach）考场意思：对方只能要已经到期没付的那几期，不能把未到期的整笔债务一次全拿走。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 243 — 当剩下的只是分期金钱给付时，未付款通常只构成部分违约，不自动升级成总违约。

思维导图

先问：是不是终局违约（total breach）？
YES只有在剩余义务不只是“继续付分期款”时，才可能把整笔债务一次算清。
NO本题剩下的唯一义务就是借款人继续按月还款，所以先掉到部分违约（partial breach）。
再看：有没有把“未到期分期款”也一起变成可马上追的全部本金？
规则分期贷款的常见结果是：只能追已经到期没付的金额。
卡死点：effectively reviewable不是这题的语言；这题真正的卡点是“剩余义务只剩付款”，所以不能把整笔1,000美元全部加速到期。
结论答案走向：只拿到已欠三期的 $300 + 利息，而不是整笔 $1,000。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：她都说“以后也不会还了”，这不就是预期违约（repudiation）吗？

但考试真正问的是：到违约那一刻，合同里还剩的义务是不是已经只剩“继续分期付款”。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

这题的命门不是她态度多差，而是她欠的只是三期到期款，命题人想骗你把未到期本金也一起打包进来。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干里她已经没付前三期 $100 加利息，而且到 1 月 15 日时剩下的还是继续分期还钱，所以只能按已到期未付的 $300 + 利息追部分违约。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 把分期合同误看成必须等最后一期才可起诉。

❌ 法律适用 | 无力偿债泛化

✕ C: 看到 insolvent 就想直接加速整笔债务，但这是把商品法规则硬套进普通借款合同。

❌ 事实误判 | 重大违约夸大

✕ D: 只漏付几期就直接说成重大违约，太夸张了。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看合同还剩什么义务，再判断拒付是不是只能算到期分期款的部分违约。

考场速记

记住这句：“分期还款，剩下只剩付钱时，拒付通常只算部分违约。”

如果题干同时出现“以后也不还”，先别急着选总违约；先问合同里是不是只剩分期付款这一个动作。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
On March 1, an excavator entered into a contract with a contractor to perform excavation work on a large project. The contract expressly required that the excavator begin work on June 1 to enable other subcontractors to install utilities. On May 15, the excavator requested a 30-day delay in the start date for the excavation work because he was seriously behind schedule on another project. When the contractor refused to grant the delay, the excavator stated that he would try to begin the work for the contractor on June 1.
Does the contractor have valid legal grounds to cancel the contract with the excavator and hire a replacement?

choices.A: No, because the excavator did not state unequivocally that he would delay the beginning of his work.
choices.B: No, because the excavator would be entitled to specific performance of the contract if he could begin by June 1.
choices.C: Yes, because the excavator breached the implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing.
choices.D: Yes, because the excavator committed an anticipatory repudiation of the contract by causing the contractor to feel insecure about the performance.

questions.explanation:
Anticipatory repudiation
Standard Party's clear & unequivocal words or actions indicate unwillingness to perform
Retraction Party may retract repudiation unless nonrepudiating party:
  • cancels contract
  • materially changes position in reliance thereon or
  • indicates repudiation is final
Effect Upon repudiation, nonrepudiating party may:*
  • treat repudiation as breach or
  • ignore repudiation & demand performance
*Nonrepudiating party may also suspend own performance

Under the doctrine of anticipatory repudiation, a contracting party may treat another party's repudiation as a breach and cancel the contract. A repudiation occurs when a party clearly and unequivocally, by words or acts, expresses an unwillingness to perform. But a party's mere expression of doubt as to its ability to perform or request that the contract be modified does not constitute a repudiation.

Here, the excavator requested a 30-day delay in the start date of his work. After the contractor denied this request, the excavator stated that he would try to begin work on the start date. Neither of these statements is an unequivocal assertion that the excavator would delay the beginning of his work. Therefore, the excavator did not anticipatorily repudiate the contract, and the contractor has no valid legal ground to cancel it.

(Choice B) Specific performance is an available remedy when monetary damages would be inadequate. Here, monetary damages would be adequate to compensate the excavator if the contractor unjustifiably canceled the contract.

(Choice C) All contracts contain an implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing, which prohibits the parties from engaging in improper behavior (e.g., deceit). But the excavator did not breach this covenant since his request for a delay was reasonable considering his circumstances.

(Choice D) A party with reasonable grounds for insecurity about the other's performance may demand adequate assurances that the other party will perform. If the other party fails to provide those assurances within a reasonable time, the contract is anticipatorily repudiated. Although the excavator's statements were reasonable grounds for insecurity, the contractor did not demand assurances.

📌 Educational Objective

An anticipatory repudiation occurs when a party clearly and unequivocally, by words or acts, indicates an intention not to perform pursuant to the contract. A mere expression of doubt regarding one's ability to perform or request to modify the contract does not suffice.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 250 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (repudiation).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 253 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (effect of an anticipatory repudiation).

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Anticipatory Repudiation

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：对方只是请求改期（request to modify）、表达“我会尽量按时开始”，还没有到预期违约（anticipatory repudiation）那种明确说“不履行”的程度，所以不能立刻解约换人。

三秒认题路径：

改期开口 → 看是否明确拒绝履行 → 只是试着做 → 还没到 repudiation → 不能取消

核心法律规则

预期违约（anticipatory repudiation）要求一方用语言或行为清楚、明确地表示自己不打算履行合同，考场意思：不是“我有点赶不上”或“能不能改一下”。

单纯表达疑虑（mere doubt）、请求修改合同（request to modify），都不等于 repudiation；只有真的把“不会做”说死，另一方才可以当成违约处理。

本题里，挖掘机承包人先提出延后 30 天，后又说会尽量在 6 月 1 日开始，这两句话都不是明确拒绝履行，所以合同方不能以 anticipatory repudiation 取消合同。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 250 的规则就是：必须是清楚、明确的拒绝履行，才算预期违约。

思维导图

先看：对方有没有明确说“不履行”？
NO： 只是说“想延期”“我会尽量按时开始”
卡死点：不是 clear & unequivocal，不构成 anticipatory repudiation
YES： 明确拒绝履行 / 明确说不会按合同做
后果：对方可把 repudiation 当 breach，直接取消或要求继续履行
本题结论：没有到“明确拒绝履行”这一步，所以选 A

考点陷阱

你可能会想：他都主动要求改期开工了，听起来就是不靠谱，应该能立刻解约。

但考试真正问的是：他有没有明确无条件拒绝履行（clear and unequivocal refusal），而不是你主观觉得他“很危险”。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

这题里最容易被骗的是把“想延期”偷换成“我不会干”，但题干没有这一步。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干只有请求延后 30 天和“会尽量在 6 月 1 日开始”，都不是明确拒绝履行，所以不能认定预期违约。

❌ 概念混淆 | 救济前置误判

✕ B: 把 specific performance 当成先决问题了，题目问的是能不能立刻取消。

❌ 事实误判 | 善意延误偷换

✕ C: 题干没有骗人或恶意，只是想改期。

❌ 法律适用 | 不安全感套错

✕ D: 把 feel insecure 直接等同于 repudiation，但这里只是可疑，不是明确拒绝。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓“有没有明确拒绝履行”，再把“改期请求”和“预期违约”分开看。

考场速记

记忆口诀：预期违约（anticipatory repudiation）看的是“清楚说不干”，不是“我有点难、我想改”。

以后看到“请求延期”“试着按时做”“表达担忧”，先想：这通常只是 doubt，不是 repudiation。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
An engineer entered into a written contract with an owner to serve in the essential position of on-site supervisor for construction of an office building. The day after signing the contract, the engineer was injured while bicycling and was rendered physically incapable of performing as the on-site supervisor. The engineer offered to serve as an off-site consultant for the same pay as originally agreed to by the parties.
Is the owner likely to prevail in an action against the engineer for damages resulting from his failure to perform under the contract?

choices.A: No, because the engineer offered a reasonable substitute by offering to serve as an off-site consultant.
choices.B: No, because the engineer's physical ability to perform as on-site supervisor was a basic assumption of the contract.
choices.C: Yes, because the engineer breached the contract by disappointing the owner's expectations.
choices.D: Yes, because the engineer's duty to perform was personal and absolute.

questions.explanation:
A contracting party's duty to perform can be discharged by impracticability. The defense of impracticability is available when:

  • an unanticipated or extraordinary event makes it impracticable for the party to perform
  • the contract was formed under a basic assumption that the event would not occur and
  • the party seeking discharge was not at fault in causing the event to occur.

Here, the engineer entered into a contract to serve in the essential position of on-site supervisor for construction of an office building. The next day, the engineer suffered a bicycle injury that rendered him physically incapable of performing. Because the engineer's physical ability to perform as on-site supervisor was a basic assumption of the contract and there is no indication that the injury was his fault, his duty to perform was discharged. Therefore, the engineer did not breach the contract by failing to perform, and the owner is unlikely to prevail (Choice C).

(Choice A) An offer by a party to perform less than what was contracted for (eg, the engineer's offer to serve as an off-site consultant) will not excuse a breach. This is true even if the offered performance is a reasonable substitute.

(Choice D) Although the engineer's duty to perform was personal and absolute, he is not in breach—and the owner will not prevail—because the doctrine of impracticability excused the engineer's nonperformance under the contract.

📌 Educational Objective

The defense of impracticability is available when (1) an unanticipated or extraordinary event makes it impracticable for a party to perform, (2) the contract was formed under a basic assumption that the event would not occur, and (3) the party seeking discharge was not at fault in causing the event to occur.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 261 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (discharge by supervening impracticability).
questions.zh-question:

业主因工程师未能履行合同而对其提起的损害赔偿诉讼，是否可能胜诉？

zh-choices.B: 不会，因为该工程师履行现场主管职责的身体能力是合同的一项基本假设。
zh-choices.C: 会，因为该工程师未能满足业主的期望，从而违反了合同。
zh-choices.D: 会，因为该工程师的履行义务是属人且绝对的。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Impracticability

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：合同履行中出现意外身体伤害时，不可能履行（impracticability）能不能把工程师的履约义务直接解除。

三秒认题路径：

签约后受伤 → 无法到岗 → 基本假设落空 → 非本人过错 → 义务解除

核心法律规则

抓住这条规则就够了

不可能履行（impracticability）的意思是：签约后出现了意外或异常事件，让履行变得现实上做不到。关键要看三件事：事件是不是合同订立时默认“不会发生”，以及主张解除的一方是否没有过错。basic assumption 在考场上的意思就是：双方当时就是按“他能继续干”来签的，所以一旦这个前提被突发伤害打碎，义务就可能被解除。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 261 — 突发且非本人过错的事件，使履行失去可行性时，可解除后续履约义务。

思维导图

先看：合同义务有没有被意外事件打断？
事实触发：工程师签约后第二天骑车受伤，on-site supervisor 的工作直接做不了。
规则关卡：impracticability 需要“意外事件 + 基本假设 + 非本人过错”。
本题卡死点：受伤不是工程师自己故意制造的，而且能不能继续到岗正是合同默认前提。
不能靠“我改当 off-site consultant 也行”来硬补；这只是替代提议，不会把原合同的履约义务自动改写。
结论：义务被解除，工程师不构成违约，雇主想拿损害赔偿通常赢不了。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：他都主动提出当 off-site consultant 了，雇主应该不能再追究。

但考试真正问的是：原合同要求的是“现场主管”这个特定履行，意外伤害让这个核心前提没了，司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

换句话说，替代性提议不等于自动免责；真正决定答案的是合同基本假设是否被打碎。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干的关键触发点是签约后次日受伤且无法到岗；这正好击中 impracticability，因为能继续担任现场主管是合同的基本假设。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 误把reasonable substitute当成免责理由，替代方案不能抹掉原合同义务。

❌ 法律适用 | 期待落空误判

✕ C: 只讲雇主失望，不抓“意外事件是否解除义务”这个真正门槛。

❌ 事实误判 | 责任绝对化误判

✕ D: 把personal and absolute当成一定违约，但题干里先被免责的是履约义务。

这题建议用什么方法？

先问是否有超出当事人控制的突发事件，再看它有没有打掉合同的基本假设。

考场速记

记住一句：不可能履行（impracticability）不是“我不想做”，而是“合同默认会继续存在的前提突然没了”。

本题一眼抓“签约后突发受伤 + 不能胜任原职”，就直接联想到：义务可能解除，雇主通常拿不到违约赔偿。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A dealer needed a certain rare baseball card to complete a set that he had contracted to assemble and sell to a collector. On March 1, the dealer obtained such a card from a woman in exchange for $1,000 and a written promise to redeliver to the woman "no later than December 31 of this year" a comparable specimen of the same kind of card. On March 2, the dealer consummated the sale of the complete set to the collector.
On September 1, the market price of rare baseball cards suddenly began a rapid, sustained rise. On September 10, the woman wrote the dealer for assurance that the dealer would timely meet his card-replacement commitment to her. On September 15, the dealer telephoned the woman and said, "I absolutely will not replace your card until the market drops far below its present level."
The woman sued the dealer on October 15 for the market value of a comparable replacement-card.
If the dealer moves to dismiss the woman's complaint, which of the following is the woman's best argument in opposing the motion?

choices.A: The dealer breached an implied warranty by failing to supply the baseball card.
choices.B: The woman complied with her duty to mitigate her losses by promptly suing when the market rose.
choices.C: The woman may resort to any appropriate remedy for breach of contract because the dealer repudiated his performance.
choices.D: The woman may treat the dealer's anticipatory repudiation as an immediately actionable tort.

questions.explanation:
Right to adequate assurances
Are there reasonable grounds for insecurity about other party's performance?
No No right to assurances
Yes
Right to demand assurances*
Were assurances provided within reasonable time or
30 days for sale-of-goods contract?
Yes No repudiation
No
Anticipatory repudiation
Nonrepudiating party may treat repudiation as a breach or ignore it & demand performance
*The demand must be in writing if the contract is for the sale of goods.

A contract for the sale of goods (eg, a baseball card) is governed by the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC). Under the UCC, a party with reasonable grounds for insecurity about the other party's performance has the right to make a written demand for assurances that the other party will perform the contract. A failure to provide those assurances within 30 days after a valid demand constitutes an anticipatory repudiation. The nonrepudiating party may then treat the repudiation as a breach or ignore it and demand performance pursuant to the contract.

Here, the woman had reasonable grounds for insecurity about the dealer's promise to replace the rare baseball card since the market price of rare cards had begun a rapid, sustained rise. The dealer then failed to provide adequate assurance and explicitly repudiated his performance by stating, "I absolutely will not replace your card until the market drops far below its present level." As a result, the woman's best argument in opposing the dealer's motion to dismiss is that the woman may resort to any appropriate remedy for breach of contract.

(Choice A) The dealer did not breach any implied warranty by failing to supply the card. However, the dealer anticipatorily repudiated the contract by failing to provide adequate assurance that he would perform.

(Choice B) Although the woman had the right to bring an immediate suit once the dealer repudiated, she was not required to mitigate her losses by promptly suing when the market rose.

(Choice D) The woman may treat the dealer's anticipatory repudiation as an immediately actionable breach of contract, not a tort—ie, a wrongful or injurious act, other than breach of contract, subjecting the actor to civil liability.

📌 Educational Objective

Under the UCC, a party with reasonable grounds for insecurity about the other's performance may make a written demand for assurances that the other party will perform. Failure to provide assurance within 30 days after a valid demand constitutes an anticipatory repudiation, which the nonrepudiating party may treat as a breach or ignore.

📚 References
  • U.C.C. § 2-609 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (right to adequate assurance of performance).
  • U.C.C. § 2-610 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (anticipatory repudiation).

一名经销商需要一张特定的稀有棒球卡，以完成他根据合同为一名收藏家组装和出售的一套卡片。3月1日，该经销商从一名女士处获得了这张卡片，作为交换，他支付了1000美元，并书面承诺“不迟于今年12月31日”向该女士返还一张同类型的可比卡片。3月2日，该经销商完成了向收藏家出售整套卡片的交易。

9月1日，稀有棒球卡的市价突然开始快速、持续上涨。9月10日，该女士致信经销商，要求其保证将及时履行其更换卡片的承诺。9月15日，经销商致电该女士说：“我绝对不会更换你的卡片，除非市场价格远低于目前水平。”

10月15日，该女士起诉经销商，要求赔偿一张可比替换卡片的市价。

如果经销商动议驳回该女士的起诉，以下哪项是该女士反对该动议的最佳论点？

zh-choices.A: 经销商因未能提供棒球卡而违反了默示担保。
zh-choices.B: 该女士在市价上涨时及时提起诉讼，履行了其减轻损失的义务。
zh-choices.C: 由于经销商拒绝履行其义务，该女士可以就违约行为采取任何适当的救济措施。
zh-choices.D: 该女士可将经销商的预期拒绝履行视为可立即起诉的侵权行为。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Performance, Breach, and Discharge

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：UCC 下买卖货物合同中，收货方有合理担忧时能否先要书面担保（adequate assurances），对方拒绝后是否构成预期违约（anticipatory repudiation），从而可以直接起诉索赔。

三秒认题路径：

货物买卖 → 担忧履约 → 要担保 → 拒绝保证 → 预期违约

核心法律规则

在货物买卖合同（sale of goods contract）里，只要一方有合理理由怀疑对方会不会履行，就可以发出书面担保请求（written demand for adequate assurances），考场意思：先确认对方到底还会不会按约做。若对方在合理时间内不提供担保，或直接说不会履行，就会变成预期违约（anticipatory repudiation），考场意思：你不用傻等到到期日才起诉。非违约方可以把这当成违约，立刻选择可用的合同救济。

核心判例： Mohawk Industries v. Carpenter 不适用；本题对应的是 U.C.C. § 2-609 和 U.C.C. § 2-610 的规则：先要担保，拒绝后就能按预期违约处理。

思维导图

先看：有没有 合理不安（reasonable grounds for insecurity）？
有 可以发出书面担保请求（written demand for assurances）。
题干触发 价格快速持续上涨，买方担心卖方会反悔，正好触发要担保。
对方有没有在合理时间内给担保？
没有 直接进入预期违约（anticipatory repudiation）。
题干动作 卖方说“我绝不会替换”，这不是拖延，是明说不履行。
卡死点：非违约方可以把它当成违约，马上起诉索赔，不必等到12月31日。
结论走向
正确答案 可以选择任何适当的合同救济，所以选 C。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：对方还没到 12 月 31 日，怎么能说已经违约？

但考试真正问的是：卖方已经明确拒绝继续履行，非违约方现在就能把这当成预期违约（anticipatory repudiation）来处理。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的卡有没有立刻回到她手里」。

别被“市场暴涨”带跑题：它只是制造合理不安（reasonable grounds for insecurity），真正决定答案的是后来那句明确拒绝。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干里 合理不安 已出现，卖方又明确说不会替换，这就构成预期违约（anticipatory repudiation），所以她可以直接用合同救济起诉。

❌ 概念混淆 | 保证类型误判

✕ A: 把implied warranty当成这题的主轴了。

❌ 事实误判 | 先告义务偷换

✕ B: 题干没说她必须先等到损失扩大再去mitigate。

❌ 法律适用 | 救济性质误判

✕ D: 预期违约是合同违约，不是tort。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓 UCC 的“合理不安→要担保→拒绝即预期违约”链条，再看能否立刻起诉。

考场速记

记住这句：货物买卖先要担保，拒绝就能按预期违约处理。看到“合理不安 + 明确不履行”，就直接联想到 U.C.C. § 2-609 和 U.C.C. § 2-610。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
On June 1, a seller agreed to sell an antique car to a buyer for $20,000, in a writing signed by both the seller and the buyer. At the time, the car was on display in a museum in a different city and was to be delivered to the buyer on August 1. On July 15, before the risk of loss had passed to the buyer, the car was destroyed by fire without fault of either party. Subsequent to the contract but before the fire, the car had increased in value to $30,000. The seller sued the buyer for the contract price of $20,000, and the buyer counterclaimed for $30,000.
What is the likely outcome of this suit?

choices.A: Both claims will fail.
choices.B: Both claims will succeed, and the buyer will recover $10,000.
choices.C: Only the buyer's claim will prevail.
choices.D: Only the seller's claim will succeed.

questions.explanation:
Effect of destruction or damage to identified goods
(UCC § 2-613)
Complete destruction Contract avoided (ie, neither party is required to perform)
Partial destruction Buyer may demand inspection & (1) treat contract as avoided or (2) accept goods at reduced price but with no further right against seller
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

Contracts for the sale of goods are governed by Article 2 of the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC). Under the UCC, the risk of loss generally remains with the seller until the buyer receives the goods. However, if the contract deals with specifically identified goods (eg, the antique car on display), then complete destruction of the goods excuses each party's duty to perform so long as the destruction occurred:

  • without fault of either party and
  • before the risk of loss passed to the buyer.

Here, the buyer and seller formed a contract for the sale of an antique car. That car was destroyed by fire without fault of either party and before the risk of loss passed to the buyer. Therefore, the contract was avoided and neither the buyer nor the seller was required to perform. This means that both their claims will fail (Choices B, C & D).

📌 Educational Objective

When a contract deals with specifically identified goods, complete destruction of the goods excuses each party's duty to perform if the destruction occurred (1) without fault of either party and (2) before the risk of loss passed to the buyer.

📚 References
  • U.C.C. § 2-509 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (risk of loss in the absence of breach).
  • UCC § 2-613 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (casualty to identified goods).

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Performance, Breach, and Discharge

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：特定标的物（identified goods）在交付前因无过错灭失时，合同是否因标的物完全毁损而解除（contract avoided），所以双方还能不能继续要价或索赔。

三秒认题路径：

已识别货物 → 交付前灭失 → 无过错 → 风险未转移 → 合同解除

核心法律规则

《统一商法典》第二编（UCC Article 2）管货物买卖。风险负担（risk of loss）一般在买方收货前仍在卖方这边，考场意思：货还没交到你手里，通常先算卖方扛风险。

但如果合同卖的是特定识别货物（specifically identified goods），而且货物在无过错、且风险未转给买方前完全毁损（complete destruction），那就按UCC § 2-613处理：双方都不用继续履行，合同被解除。

核心判例： UCC § 2-613 - 特定标的物在转风险前完全灭失时，合同直接失效，买卖双方都不能再按原合同要履行或要价。

思维导图

先看是不是特定识别货物？
是古董车，合同锁定的是这辆车，不是“任意一辆车”。
再看毁损时点：交付前吗？
是7月15日就烧掉了，原定8月1日才交货。
再看有没有过错或风险已转移？
都没有火灾无过错，风险还没过给买方。
卡死结论：合同解除（contract avoided），卖方不能要价，买方也不能反要差价。
所以答案怎么选？
选 A双方都败诉，卖方的合同价请求和买方的 $30,000 反诉都没了。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：车后来涨到 $30,000，那买方是不是还能抓住卖方要差价？

但考试真正问的是：毁损发生时合同还在不在、风险有没有已经转过去。司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

这里的涨价事实只是干扰你情绪，不会把已经因完全毁损而解除的合同“复活”。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干 特定古董车在交付前无过错烧毁，风险还没转给买方，所以按 UCC § 2-613 合同直接解除，双方都不能再要履行或损害赔偿。

❌ 概念混淆 | 价差误判

✕ B: 把涨价当成可索赔的差额，但合同已灭失，$10,000 不是当然可收。

❌ 法律适用 | 风险转移误判

✕ C: 以为买方还能单独追回全价，可风险还没转移，reduced price 这条也走不通。

❌ 事实误判 | 仍可履行偷换

✕ D: 误把毁掉的古董车想成还能交付，卖方当然不能继续要 contract price。

这题建议用什么方法？

先锁定标的是不是已识别货物，再按“毁损时点 + 风险是否已转移”一刀切判断合同是否解除。

考场速记

记住一句：特定货物 + 无过错 + 风险未转移 + 完全毁损 = 双方都不用履行。看到这组事实，先别算价差，先想合同有没有已经被 UCC § 2-613 直接打掉。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
The owner of a fleet of taxis contracted with a dealer in petroleum products for the purchase and sale of the fleet owner's total requirements of gasoline and oil for one year. As part of that agreement, the petroleum dealer also agreed with the fleet owner that for one year the petroleum dealer would place all his advertising with the fleet owner's wife, who owned her own small advertising agency. When the wife was informed of the contract, she declined to accept an advertising account from another company because she could not handle both accounts during the same year. During the first month of the contract, the fleet owner purchased substantial amounts of his gasoline from a supplier other than the petroleum dealer, and the petroleum dealer thereupon notified the wife that he would no longer place his advertising with her agency.
In an action by the wife against the petroleum dealer for breach of contract, will the wife succeed?

choices.A: No, because the failure of a constructive condition precedent excused the petroleum dealer's duty to place his advertising with the wife.
choices.B: No, because the wife did not provide any consideration to support the petroleum dealer's promise to place his advertising with her.
choices.C: Yes, because she is a third-party beneficiary of the contract.
choices.D: Yes, because the fleet owner was acting as the wife's agent when he contracted with the petroleum dealer.

questions.explanation:
Common examples of constructive (ie, implied) conditions
Condition of performance
  • Each party's performance is conditioned on other party's performance
Condition of cooperation
  • Each party's performance is conditioned on other party's cooperation with that performance
Order of performance
  • Simultaneous performance possible – each party's performance is condition concurrent to other party's duty to perform (ie, performance due simultaneously)
  • One party's performance takes time – party's completion of longer performance is condition precedent to other party's duty to perform

The wife is an intended beneficiary—ie, a nonparty to a contract whom the contracting parties intended to benefit directly—of the contract between the fleet owner and the petroleum dealer. As a result, she has contractual rights and may sue to enforce them (Choice C). However, when the original contracting parties each make a promise to the other, each party's performance of its own promise is a constructive condition precedent to the other party's duty to perform. If either party fails to substantially perform, the other party's duty is excused.*

Here, the fleet owner promised to purchase its total gasoline and oil requirements from the petroleum dealer, and the petroleum dealer promised to use the wife's advertising agency in return. It is implied that each party's performance is a constructive condition precedent to the other party's duty to perform. And since the fleet owner failed to substantially perform his end of the bargain by purchasing substantial amounts of gasoline from another supplier, the petroleum dealer's duty to use the wife's agency was excused. Therefore, she will not succeed.

*In contrast, express conditions (ie, ones that appear in the contract) require strict compliance.

(Choice B) Although the petroleum dealer received no consideration from the wife, his agreement with the fleet owner was supported by consideration. That is because the petroleum dealer's promise was induced by the fleet owner's promise to purchase gasoline and oil (and vice versa). And the wife, as an intended beneficiary, could sue to enforce her rights. But she will not succeed, because the petroleum dealer's duty was excused.

(Choice D) The fleet owner was not acting as an agent for the wife because she did not direct him to enter into the contract on her behalf. Instead, she was an intended third-party beneficiary of the contract.

📌 Educational Objective

Each party's performance of its own promise is a constructive (ie, implied) condition precedent to the other party's duty to perform. If either party fails to substantially perform, the other party's duty is excused.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 234 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (order of performances).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 302 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (intended and incidental beneficiaries).

一位出租车队的所有人与一名石油产品经销商签订合同，约定在一年内购买该车队所需的全部汽油和机油。作为该协议的一部分，石油经销商也同意车队所有人，在一年内，他会将其所有广告业务交由车队所有人的妻子处理，该妻子拥有一家自己的小型广告代理公司。当妻子得知该合同后，她拒绝了另一家公司的广告业务，因为她无法在同一年内同时处理两项业务。在合同的第一个月，车队所有人从石油经销商以外的供应商处购买了大量的汽油，石油经销商随即通知妻子，他将不再把广告业务交由她的代理公司。

在妻子对石油经销商提起的违约诉讼中，妻子能否胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 不会，因为一项推定先决条件的未能满足，免除了石油经销商将广告业务交给妻子的义务。
zh-choices.B: 不会，因为妻子没有提供任何对价来支持石油经销商将其广告业务交给她的承诺。
zh-choices.C: 会，因为她是该合同的第三方受益人。
zh-choices.D: 会，因为车队所有人在与石油经销商签订合同时是作为妻子的代理人行事。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Types of conditions

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：第三人受益人虽然能起诉，但只要一方先没按约定实质履行，另一方的义务就会被构造性先决条件卡掉。

三秒认题路径：

第三人受益人 → 双务合同 → 先履行失约 → 构造性条件 → 义务免责

核心法律规则

只背这一段就够做题

构造性先决条件（constructive condition precedent）考场意思：双方互相承诺时，通常默认“你先把自己那份做对，我才轮到做我的那份”。

实质履行（substantial performance）考场意思：只要一方没大体完成自己的义务，对方就可以不继续履行，不是非要等到书面写了“必须先做完”才算。

所以这题里，fleet owner 没有按约买足燃油，petroleum dealer 的广告投放义务就被免除了，wife 作为受益人也拿不到违约救济。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 234 的顺序履行逻辑锁定本题结论：先履约的一方没做到，对方义务就不再触发。

思维导图

先看 wife 能不能直接起诉？
是： 第三人受益人（intended beneficiary） 可以起诉，别被“不是合同当事人”骗走。
再问： 双方约定是互相交换履行，属于 构造性先决条件（constructive condition precedent）。
关键卡点： fleet owner 先违约：没买足总需求燃油
结果： dealer 的广告义务被免除，wife 虽有权利，effectively reviewable 这类救济逻辑不在这里；她是 拿不到胜诉结果。
答案： 选 A。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：wife 是 intended beneficiary，那她当然能赢。

但考试真正问的是：她能不能绕过“对方先没履约”的抗辩；这里真正卡住的是另一方义务已经被免除，不是她有没有起诉资格。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干 fleet owner 先去别家买油，说明先决的互相履行条件没过，dealer 的广告义务因此被免除。

❌ 概念混淆 | 受益人误判

✕ B: 盯着 no consideration 乱想，受益人没出价不等于合同没成立。

❌ 法律适用 | 受益人资格误用

✕ C: 把“能起诉”当成“必然胜诉”，忽略对方义务已经被免除。

❌ 事实误判 | 代理关系偷换

✕ D: 题干没说 agency，只是把妻子当受益人，不是让丈夫替她签约。

这题建议用什么方法？

先认第三人受益人，再看互相履行是否形成构造性先决条件，最后检查有没有一方先实质违约。

考场速记

记住一句：第三人受益人（intended beneficiary） 只能拿到“本来就存在的合同权利”，拿不到已经被对方先违约打断的履行结果。

顺口记：先履约，后轮到；先失约，对方跳。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
Before the season began, a professional hockey player entered into a signed, written agreement with the owner of the team. Among the provisions in the agreement was one that provided that, if the player scored 20 or more goals during the season, he would receive additional compensation. The player tried his best during the season but only managed to score 19 goals. The owner refused to pay the player any additional compensation.
Is the owner excused from paying the additional compensation?

choices.A: No, because the player substantially complied with the condition regarding goals scored.
choices.B: No, because the player's failure to satisfy the condition was not willful.
choices.C: Yes, because the additional compensation was conditioned on the player scoring at least 20 goals during the season.
choices.D: Yes, because the player promised to score 20 goals.

questions.explanation:
Contract conditions
Type of condition How created Performance required
Express
Set forth explicitly in contract Must be complied with fully; substantial performance does not suffice
Implied-
in-law
Supplied by court if reasonable under circumstances (i.e., constructive condition) Substantial performance suffices; full performance is not required
Implied-
in-fact
Nature of agreement suggests that parties intended condition but failed to expressly include it Substantial performance suffices; full performance is not required

Express conditions are specified in the contract and must be complied with fully unless excused. Substantial compliance will not suffice. An express condition is enforceable even when the failure to meet the condition results in the denial of compensation.

Here, the agreement between the player and owner contained an express condition requiring the player to score at least 20 goals during the season before the owner's obligation to pay the player additional compensation arose. Because the player failed to meet this condition by scoring only 19 goals, the owner is excused from paying the player the additional compensation.

(Choice A) A party who substantially complies with an implied or constructive condition can trigger the obligation of the other party to perform. But the doctrine of substantial performance does not apply to express conditions like the one in this fact pattern.

(Choice B) Willfulness may be relevant to substantial performance, but substantial performance does not apply to express conditions. Therefore, it is irrelevant that the player's failure to score 20 goals was not willful.

(Choice D) The player did not promise to score 20 goals during the season. Had he made that promise, his failure to score 20 goals would be treated as a breach. Instead, this was just an express condition that if met would have triggered an additional duty on the part of the owner.

📌 Educational Objective

Express conditions must be complied with fully unless excused. Substantial performance will not satisfy an express condition.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 224 (Am. L. Inst. 1981) (explaining that a condition is an event that must occur before performance under a contract is required).
questions.zh-question:
主题：合同法（Contracts）——履行、违约与解除（Performance, Breach, and Discharge）

题目：
赛季开始之前，一名职业冰球运动员与球队所有人签订了一份经签字的书面协议。协议中的一项条款规定：如果该球员在赛季中打入20个或更多进球，他将获得额外报酬。该球员在赛季中尽了最大努力，但最终只打入19球。球队所有人拒绝向该球员支付任何额外报酬。
球队所有人是否可以免于支付该额外报酬？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为该球员对有关进球数的条件已经基本履行（substantially complied）。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为该球员未满足该条件并非故意（willful）。
zh-choices.C: 是，因为额外报酬以该球员在赛季中至少打入20球为条件。
zh-choices.D: 是，因为该球员承诺要打入20球。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Conditions

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：明示条件（express condition）是否必须严格满足；这里不是看“尽力了没有”，而是看条件有没有真的成就。

三秒认题路径：

先找条件 → 看是明示 → 再看是否成就 → 没成就就不付钱 → 选 C

核心法律规则

明示条件（express condition）是合同里明写的“先发生这个事件，另一方才有履行义务”，所以要严格满足，substantial performance 这套一般救不了它。附带/推定条件（implied-in-law or implied-in-fact condition）才常常允许实质履行。

这题里，追加报酬的义务被写成“球员本赛季进 20 球或以上”才触发，所以 19 球就是条件没成就，老板可以不付。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 224 — 说明条件是“必须先发生，合同才要求履行”的事件。

思维导图

1. 先看是不是条件
写进合同的“20 球”就是触发义务的门槛。
2. 条件类型
明示条件（express condition），不是普通承诺。
3. 结果是否成就
只进 19 球，条件没达到。
4. 能否用实质履行救
卡死点：substantial performance 不救明示条件
5. 结论
老板的追加付款义务没有触发，所以答案是 Yes, excused。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：球员已经“尽力了”，所以应该拿到钱，或者至少能按 substantial performance 处理。

但考试真正问的是：这笔追加报酬是不是被写成了一个先决条件；只要条件没成就，付款义务就没启动。

司法考试看的是「合同程序上条件有没有成就」，而不是「球员主观上努不努力」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干把 20 球写成触发额外报酬的条件，球员只进 19 球，所以老板的付款义务根本没被触发。

❌ 概念混淆 | 实质履行误套

✕ A: 把 substantial 套到明示条件上了。

❌ 法律适用 | 故意要件误判

✕ B: “不是故意”只影响某些履行争议，这里关键是条件没成就。

❌ 事实误判 | 承诺内容偷换

✕ D: 题干没说球员承诺必须进 20 球，只是把它当成付款门槛。

这题建议用什么方法？

先分清“条件”还是“承诺”，再问条件有没有成就；明示条件没过，就直接停。

考场速记

记住一句：明示条件（express condition）要全额满足，substantial performance 只常救普通履行，不救条件门槛。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
On August 1, a nursing home for the elderly admitted an 84-year-old man for a trial period of two months. On September 25, the man and the nursing home entered into a written lifetime-care contract with an effective commencement date of October 1. The full contract price was $20,000, which, as required by the terms of the contract, the man prepaid to the nursing home on September 25. The nursing home rejected a woman's application for lifetime care on September 26 due to its commitment to the man.
On October 2, the man died of a heart attack.
In a restitutionary action, will the administrator of the man's estate likely recover on behalf of the estate either all or part of the $20,000 paid to the nursing home on September 25?

choices.A: No, because the man's life span and the duration of the nursing home's commitment to him were risks assumed by both parties.
choices.B: No, because the nursing home rejected the woman's application due to its commitment to the man.
choices.C: Yes, because the doctrine of frustration of purpose applies.
choices.D: Yes, because the nursing home would otherwise be unjustly enriched at the man's expense.

questions.explanation:
Ways to discharge contractual obligations
  • • Full performance of contractual obligations
  • • Impossibility, impracticability, or frustration of purpose
  • • Release (in writing only)
  • • Mutual rescission
  • • Substituted contract
  • • Contract or covenant not to sue
  • • Accord & satisfaction
  • • Novation
Mnemonic: FIRM SCAN

A contract can be rescinded after an unexpected event if (1) the event frustrates the purpose of the contract, (2) the contract was formed under a basic assumption that the event would not occur, and (3) neither party was at fault in causing the event to occur. The frustrating event must be so severe that it cannot fairly be regarded as within the risks that the parties assumed under the contract. Additionally, a party who conferred a benefit before the contract was rescinded can recover restitutionary damages to prevent unjust enrichment.

Here, the 84-year-old man and the nursing home entered into a written contract in which he prepaid $20,000 for lifetime care that began on October 1. Although the man unexpectedly died one day later, his life span and the duration of the nursing home's commitment to him were risks assumed by both parties. That is because:

  • • the man assumed the risk that he would die before receiving the full value of his payment and
  • • the nursing home assumed the risk that the man would live so long that his payment would be insufficient.

Therefore, the doctrine of frustration of purpose does not apply, and the administrator of the man's estate is unlikely to recover restitutionary damages for all or part of the $20,000 paid to the nursing home (Choice C).

(Choice B) The fact that the nursing home rejected the woman's application has no effect on the outcome of this dispute.

(Choice D) Unjust enrichment occurs when a party receives a benefit from another that was not rightfully earned and would be unfair to keep. But here, it would not be unfair for the nursing home to retain the $20,000, and the nursing home rightfully earned it, because the nursing home assumed the risk that the man would live so long that his payment would be inadequate.

📌 Educational Objective

The doctrine of frustration of purpose applies only where the frustrating event is so severe that it cannot fairly be regarded as within the risks that the parties assumed under the contract.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 265 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (frustration-of-purpose doctrine).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 377 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (restitution for frustration of purpose).

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Frustration of purpose

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：合同目的受挫（frustration of purpose）能不能让预付的 合同价款（contract price） 退回一部分，关键看事件是不是超出双方已承担的风险。

三秒认题路径：

预付价款 → 突发死亡 → 目的受挫？ → 风险归属 → 不能退款

核心法律规则

合同目的受挫（frustration of purpose）只在一个突发事件把合同目的“打没了”，而且这个事件不是双方订约时已经默认承担的风险时才成立。基本假设（basic assumption） 的意思是：双方签约时都把“它不会发生”当作前提。

如果事件虽然意外，但仍落在双方分配好的风险里，就不能靠这个理论解除合同或要回价款。effectively unreviewable 那类程序词不在这里；这题只看风险有没有被合同吸收。

核心判例：《Restatement (Second) of Contracts》§ 265 说明：只有当挫败事件超出双方风险分配，目的受挫才会成立；§ 377 只是在该理论成立后讨论返还利益。

思维导图

先问：这个突发事件是不是把合同目的直接打掉了？
是 继续问：这个事件是不是双方签约时已经默认会承担的风险？
是 卡死结论：不能用 frustration of purpose 退钱
否 可走目的受挫，之后才谈 restitution。
本题事实 84岁老人预付 lifetime-care contract 价款，隔天去世，生死长短本来就是双方都要承担的风险。
终点 所以管理员不能拿到全部或部分 $20,000。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：老人只住了一天，护理院拿了整笔钱，看起来很亏。
但考试真正问的是：这个“亏”是不是法律上可退的那种亏，而不是单纯看结果刺不刺眼。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的利益有没有落差」。

这里最容易被骗的是把 unjust enrichment 和 frustration of purpose 混在一起；只要风险本来就由双方分担，护理院保住这笔预付费并不“无端占便宜”。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干的关键事实是老人先预付了 $20,000，但 life span 和护理期限本来就是双方都承担的风险，所以不能因死亡就退回价款。

❌ 事实误判 | 护理院拒单误读

✕ B: 把 rejected 当成决定点，但拒掉别人申请不影响这份已生效合同。

❌ 法律适用 | 受挫规则套错

✕ C: 只看到 frustration 就冲，但本题失败在风险本来就被双方吞下了。

❌ 概念混淆 | 不当获利误判

✕ D: 把“看着不划算”直接等于 unjustly enriched，忽略了护理院其实已按约承担风险。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看是否有 frustration of purpose，再问事件是不是仍在双方已分配的风险里。

考场速记

记忆口诀：先看“目的有没有被打掉”，再看“这事是不是本来就该由双方自己扛”。

这题对应 frustration of purpose 的核心句就是：风险已分配，就不能事后反悔要钱。 顺带记住 FIRM SCAN：Full performance、Impossibility、Release、Mutual rescission、Substituted contract、Contract not to sue、Accord and satisfaction、Novation。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
In late March, a jeweler contracted to create and sell a ruby ring to a buyer on May 1. In early April, the price of rubies rose by 25%, and the jeweler could not purchase a ruby without losing money on the transaction. However, the jeweler had an emerald that was purchased for another customer who had canceled the order. The jeweler created the ring for the buyer using the emerald. On May 1, the jeweler tendered the emerald ring to the buyer in good faith, explaining the situation and pointing out that the emerald ring was the same value that the ruby ring would have been. The buyer refused to accept the emerald ring and refused to pay the jeweler the contract price.
Which of the following most accurately describes the legal relationship between the jeweler and the buyer?

choices.A: The buyer can immediately bring a valid breach-of-contract claim against the jeweler for his failure to tender a ruby ring.
choices.B: The buyer must give the jeweler an opportunity to cure the breach before bringing a claim against him.
choices.C: The jeweler can immediately bring a valid breach-of-contract claim against the buyer for rejecting the emerald ring.
choices.D: The jeweler's duty under the contract with the buyer is excused by the rise in the price of rubies.

questions.explanation:
Buyer's rights on improper delivery
(UCC § 2-601)
Did seller provide goods that conform perfectly to contract?
Yes
No breach
No
Breach of contract
Buyer may:
Accept goods in
whole or part
Reject goods in
whole or part
  • Buyer must pay for accepted goods minus any damages
  • Seller can cure breach by tendering goods if time remains to perform

Under the UCC, a seller must tender goods conforming to the contract to the buyer. The UCC requires perfect tender, and substantial performance will not suffice except for installment contracts, or when the parties have agreed otherwise. Failure to tender perfectly conforming goods is a breach. And unless the seller cures the breach in the time remaining to perform, the buyer has the right to accept or reject all or part of the goods.

Here, the jeweler tendered a ring containing an emerald rather than the ruby called for in the contract. The jeweler's tender was not perfect, and the parties did not agree that substantial performance would apply. Therefore, under the UCC's perfect-tender rule, the jeweler has breached the contract with the buyer, and the buyer can immediately bring an action against the jeweler.

(Choice B) The buyer is not obligated to allow the jeweler to cure the breach before bringing an action, as the time for performance is over and it is unlikely that the jeweler has reasonable grounds to believe the buyer would have accepted an emerald ring in place of a ruby ring.

(Choice C) The buyer was entitled to reject the emerald ring, even though it was of comparable value to the ruby ring, because it failed to satisfy the perfect-tender rule. Therefore, the jeweler does not have a claim against the buyer for breaching his duty to purchase the ring.

(Choice D) Although some unforeseen circumstances (e.g., wars, local crop failures) may be sufficient to excuse performance, a non-extraordinary increase in the cost of performance is not sufficient.

📌 Educational Objective

Under the UCC's perfect-tender rule, the failure to tender perfectly conforming goods is a breach that entitles the buyer to accept or reject all or part of the goods.

📚 References
  • UCC § 2-503 (explaining perfect-tender rule).
  • UCC § 2-601 (providing buyer's rights on improper delivery).

主题：合同法（Contracts）——履行（Performance）、违约（Breach）与解除（Discharge）

题目：
在3月下旬，一位珠宝商与一名买家订立合同，约定于5月1日制作并出售一枚红宝石戒指。4月初，红宝石价格上涨了25%，珠宝商若购买红宝石将会在该交易中亏损。然而，珠宝商手中有一颗原本为另一位已取消订单的顾客购买的祖母绿（emerald）。珠宝商于是用这颗祖母绿为买家制作了一枚戒指。5月1日，珠宝商本着善意将这枚祖母绿戒指（emerald ring）交付给买家，并解释了情况，指出这枚祖母绿戒指与原本应交付的红宝石戒指价值相同。买家拒绝接受这枚祖母绿戒指，也拒绝向珠宝商支付合同价款。

以下哪一项最准确地描述了珠宝商与买家之间的法律关系？

zh-choices.A: 买家可以立即对珠宝商提起有效的 breach of contract（违约）诉讼，理由是珠宝商未能交付一枚红宝石戒指。
zh-choices.B: 在对珠宝商提起诉讼之前，买家必须先给珠宝商一个 cure（补救违约）的机会。
zh-choices.C: 珠宝商可以立即对买家提起有效的 breach of contract（违约）诉讼，理由是买家拒绝接受这枚祖母绿戒指。
zh-choices.D: 由于红宝石价格上涨，珠宝商在合同项下的义务被 excuse（免除）了。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Breach

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：UCC完美交付规则（perfect tender rule）下，卖方交付了非合同约定货物，买方能否立刻按违约起诉。

三秒认题路径：

卖方交货不符 → 货物非约定物 → 完美交付被破 → 买方可拒收 → 立即主张违约

核心法律规则

UCC第2编（UCC Article 2）要求卖方对买方的货物交付（tender of goods）做到“完美符合”：货物、数量、品质、种类都要按合同来。考场意思：只要不是合同里要的东西，就先当成违约。

完美交付规则（perfect tender rule）下，卖方不能靠“差不多”“价值一样”来糊过去，除非是分期合同或双方另有约定。考场意思：substantial performance 在一般货物买卖里通常不救他。

如果卖方在履行期限内还能补正，就可能有补救（cure）机会；但本题已经到约定交货日，且买方明显不会接受别的宝石，卖方不能把错误货物硬塞给对方。考场意思：这题的结论是买方可以马上按违约处理。

核心判例： UCC § 2-601 配合 UCC § 2-503，锁定“非完美交付 = 买方可拒收或立即起诉”的考点。

思维导图

先看卖方交付的是不是合同要的货？
是 没有违约
否 违反完美交付
再问 还能在履行期内补救（cure）吗？
本题 已到交货日 + 买方不会接受替代货 → 补救失败
结论 买方可拒收并立即起诉

考点陷阱

你可能会想：价值一样，而且卖方是善意处理，买方就不该挑剔。

但考试真正问的是：合同要求的到底是不是“红宝石”，不是替代品值不值钱。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干的ruby ring被换成了翡翠戒指，属于非完美交付；按 perfect tender rule，买方可以立刻主张卖方违约。

❌ 概念混淆 | 补救前置误判

✕ B: 误把买方当成要先等 cure 的一方。

❌ 事实误判 | 买方违约倒置

✕ C: 把卖方送错货偷换成买方拒付违约。

❌ 法律适用 | 成本上涨套错

✕ D: price rose 只是变贵，不是免除履行。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓交付物是否“对版”，再看是否有合同内补救；货物买卖优先跑完美交付规则。

考场速记

记住一句：货物买卖先看完美交付，不是“差不多就行”。看到卖方交错货，先想买方能不能拒收、能不能立刻起诉，而不是先替卖方找善意理由。

口诀：“In Certain Circumstances, An Appeal Can Be Made Prematurely” 这题不适用；本题只要记 perfect tender，错货就是违约。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
Under the terms of a written contract, a builder agreed to construct a garage for a homeowner for $10,000. Nothing was stated in the parties' negotiations or in the contract about progress payments during the course of the work.
After completing 25 percent of the garage according to the homeowner's specifications, the builder demanded $2,000 as a reasonable progress payment. The homeowner refused, and the builder abandoned the job.
If each party sues the other for breach of contract, which of the following will the court decide?

choices.A: Both parties are in breach, and each is entitled to damages, if any, from the other.
choices.B: Only the builder is in breach and liable for the homeowner's damages, if any.
choices.C: Only the homeowner is in breach and liable for the builder's damages, if any.
choices.D: Both parties took reasonable positions, and neither is in breach.

questions.explanation:
Order of performances*
Simultaneous performance possible Condition concurrent implied (ie, performance due simultaneously)
One performance requires time Condition precedent implied (ie, durational performance due before respective duty triggered)
*These rules apply unless express contractual language or circumstances indicate otherwise.

A party breaches a contract by failing to perform a contractual duty at the time performance is due. Where only one party's performance requires a period of time to complete, that party's performance is due first unless the contract or the circumstances indicate otherwise. If that party fails to complete performance or repudiates the contract, the nonbreaching party is entitled to withhold performance and recover damages.

Here, the builder needed a period of time to construct the garage, and the parties' contract did not provide for progress payments—ie, payments made at certain stages in the process. As a result, the builder was required to complete construction before the homeowner was required to pay anything. The builder then repudiated the contract by abandoning the job, so the homeowner was entitled to withhold payment. Therefore, only the builder is in breach and liable for the homeowner's damages, if any (Choices A, C & D).

📌 Educational Objective

Where one party's performance requires a period of time to complete (eg, construction), that party must complete performance before the other party is required to perform (eg, payment). Failure to perform results in a breach of the contract, entitling the nonbreaching party to withhold performance and recover damages.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 234 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (order of performance).
questions.zh-question:
根据一份书面合同的条款，一名建筑商同意以10,000美元的价格为一名房主建造一个车库。在双方的谈判或合同中，均未提及在工程期间的进度付款事宜。

在按照房主的规格完成了25%的车库工程后，建筑商要求房主支付2,000美元作为合理的进度付款。房主拒绝了该要求，建筑商随即放弃了这项工作。

如果双方均以违约为由起诉对方，法院将作出以下哪项裁决？

zh-choices.A: 双方均构成违约，且均有权向对方索取损害赔偿（如有）。
zh-choices.B: 仅建筑商构成违约，并应对房主的损害赔偿（如有）承担责任。
zh-choices.C: 仅房主构成违约，并应对建筑商的损害赔偿（如有）承担责任。
zh-choices.D: 双方的立场均合理，均不构成违约。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Performance, Breach, and Discharge

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：只有一方的履行需要时间时，先完成的一方是 builder，所以没完工前 homeowner 不用先付钱。

三秒认题路径：

建造要时间 → 先履行一方 → 无进度款 → 先完工才付款 → builder 先违约

核心法律规则

履行顺序（order of performance）看的是谁先把自己的义务做完。若双方能同时履行，就推定 同时对待义务（concurrent conditions）；但如果只有一方的履行需要时间，比如 建造工程（construction），就推定这方先履行，另一方的付款义务后触发。

这里没有约定 进度付款（progress payments），所以 homeowner 不必在 25% 完工时先付款。builder 中途停工，就是在自己该先完成时 拒绝履行（repudiation），因此是他违约，homeowner 可以拒付并索赔。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 234 — 一方履行需要时间时，默认先完成这方，另一方的义务才到期。

思维导图

起点
建造 garage 需要一段时间，说明 builder 是先履行方。
合同内容
没写 progress payments，所以不能把付款拆成阶段义务。
到 25%
homeowner 还没到付款时点，不能被迫先付。
builder 停工
中途 abandoned job = 先履行方放弃履行，builder 先违约。
结论
homeowner 可拒付；答案：B

考点陷阱

你可能会想：builder 已经做了 25%，所以 homeowner 也该先给一部分钱。

但考试真正问的是：合同有没有把付款改成阶段到期；本题没有，所以先完工的一方必须先把工程做完。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干 没有 progress payments，而建造要时间，所以 builder 先完成、先到期；他中途 abandon job，当然是他先违约。

❌ 概念混淆 | 双方同违误判

❌ 事实误判 | 阶段付款偷换

✕ D: 直接脑补有 stage payments，其实合同没写。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓履行顺序，再看有没有把付款改成进度到期；没有的话，先完工的一方先承担风险。

考场速记

记住这句：谁的履行需要时间，谁先做完；如果合同没写进度付款，另一方通常可以先等，不用提前掏钱。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
On March 1, a bookstore emailed a publisher the following: "We have received your catalog and are interested in doing business. Do you offer any discounts to retailers?" On March 2, the publisher emailed the bookstore: "Yes, a retailer receives a 40% discount on our books if at least $500 worth of books are ordered." On March 3, the bookstore responded: "Attached is an order for $600 worth of books listed in your current catalog." On March 4, the publisher replied: "Order accepted. Please be aware, as noted in the Terms of Service in our catalog, the cost of shipping for orders of less than $1,000 is borne by the buyer." On March 5, the bookstore emailed: "Can't accept additional shipping cost. Please cancel order." The publisher did not reply. On March 6, the bookstore, having reconsidered its options, sent the following email to the publisher: "You drive a hard bargain. Please ship the books as ordered on March 3."
If the publisher does not send the books, can the publisher be liable for breach of contract?

choices.A: No, because the bookstore clearly and unequivocally repudiated the contract on March 5.
choices.B: No, because the publisher's March 2 email was not an offer to form a contract.
choices.C: Yes, because both of the parties are merchants.
choices.D: Yes, because the bookstore retracted its repudiation on March 6.

questions.explanation:
The doctrine of anticipatory repudiation

Did party clearly & unequivocally indicate unwillingness to perform?
No
No anticipatory repudiation
Yes
Anticipatory repudiation
Did party retract repudiation before other party did any of the following?
  • Canceled contract
  • Materially changed position or
  • Indicated repudiation is final
Yes
Repudiation retracted
No
Nonrepudiating party may:*
Treat repudiation as breach
OR
Ignore repudiation & demand performance
*The nonrepudiating party may also suspend its performance if commercially reasonable

The doctrine of anticipatory repudiation applies when a contracting party clearly and unequivocally repudiates (i.e., indicates an unwillingness to perform) a promise before performance is due. In such a situation, the nonrepudiating party may (1) treat the repudiation as a breach of contract or (2) ignore it and demand performance. However, a repudiation can be retracted if the nonrepudiating party receives notice of the retraction before:

  • cancelling the contract
  • materially changing position in reliance on the repudiation or
  • indicating that he considers the repudiation to be final (e.g., by suing for breach of contract).

Here, the bookstore repudiated its contractual promise to pay for the order when it emailed the publisher on March 5 to cancel the order. The publisher did not reply. The bookstore then retracted its repudiation on March 6 when it asked the publisher to ship the books as ordered. This repudiation occurred before the publisher canceled the contract, materially changed its position, or indicated that it considered the repudiation final (Choice A). Therefore, if the publisher does not send the books, it can be liable for breach of contract.

(Choice B) Although the publisher's March 2 email was not an offer, it was an invitation to make an offer. The bookstore then made an offer on March 3 by sending the publisher an order form, which the publisher accepted on March 4 by replying, "Order accepted." Thus, a valid contract was formed on March 4.

(Choice C) An additional term in an acceptance is automatically included in the contract when both parties are merchants unless the offeror has objected to the additional terms. However, the fact that the publisher and bookstore are merchants does not impact the repudiation and subsequent retraction.

📌 Educational Objective

An anticipatory repudiation may be retracted before the nonrepudiating party (1) cancels the contract, (2) materially changes position in reliance on the repudiation, or (3) indicates that he considers the repudiation to be final.

📚 References
  • U.C.C. § 2-610 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2024) (anticipatory repudiation).
  • U.C.C. § 2-610 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2024) (retracting an anticipatory repudiation).

主题：合同法——履行、违约与解除

问题：
3月1日，一家书店给一家出版社发电子邮件如下：“我们已经收到了你们的目录，并有兴趣开展业务。你们是否向零售商提供任何折扣？”3月2日，出版社回复书店：“是的，零售商如果订购至少500美元的图书，可享受40%的折扣。”3月3日，书店回复：“随附的是一份订单，订购你们现行目录中价值600美元的图书。”3月4日，出版社回复：“订单已接受。请注意，如贵目录中的 Terms of Service 所述，凡订单金额低于1,000美元，其运费由买方承担。”3月5日，书店发电子邮件称：“无法接受额外的运费。请取消订单。”出版社没有回复。3月6日，书店在重新考虑其选择后，向出版社发送了以下电子邮件：“你们压价很狠。请按3月3日的订单发货。”如果出版社没有寄出图书，出版社是否可能因 breach of contract 而承担责任？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为书店在3月5日已经明确且无歧义地 repudiated（拒绝履行）了合同。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为出版社3月2日的电子邮件并不是为形成合同而作出的 offer（要约）。
zh-choices.C: 是，因为双方都是 merchants（商人）。
zh-choices.D: 是，因为书店在3月6日撤回了其 repudiation（拒绝履行）。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Performance, Breach, and Discharge

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：预期违约（anticipatory repudiation）能不能在对方撤回前被撤销，所以出版社现在还能不能因不发货而构成违约。

三秒认题路径：

先看拒绝履行 → 再看是否撤回 → 对方是否已依赖 → 还可要求履行 → 选能否立刻追责

核心法律规则

预期违约（anticipatory repudiation）指一方在履行期限到来前，清楚而明确表示不履行。考试上，另一方可以把它当成违约，也可以先不翻桌、继续要对方履行。

撤回（retraction）也可以发生，但必须赶在对方已经取消合同（cancel the contract）、实质改变立场（materially changed position），或者明确表示把这次违约当成最终结论之前。

所以这题的关键不是谁先发邮件，而是：书店在 3 月 6 日前撤回得够不够快；如果够快，出版社仍可要求继续履行，拒绝发货就可能构成违约。

核心判例： Mohawk Industries v. Carpenter 不适用本题；本题锁定的是 U.C.C. § 2-610 下的预期违约撤回规则。

思维导图

3 月 5 日书店说“取消订单”
先问：这是不是 明确拒绝履行（clear and unequivocal repudiation）？
是 → 先成立预期违约
再问：出版社在 3 月 6 日前是否已经
取消合同 / 依赖后实质变更 / 宣布把违约当最终结论？
题干结果：没有。出版社只是沉默，没先锁死权利。
所以：3 月 6 日书店撤回成功，出版社仍可要求发货。
结论：若出版社不发书，可能构成违约 → 选 D

考点陷阱

你可能会想：书店 3 月 5 日先说“取消”，那出版社当然没责任了。

但考试真正问的是：它有没有在对方采取终局动作前及时撤回；有些“后悔撤回”在考场上是有效的。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

书店 3 月 5 日先 repudiation，3 月 6 日又撤回，而出版社没有先取消、依赖变更或宣布终局，所以仍可要求履行。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 把“先拒绝”当成永久失效，忘了它还可以撤回。

❌ 法律适用 | 先后顺序误判

✕ B: 盯着 not an offer 跑偏了，合同已经在 3 月 4 日成立。

❌ 事实误判 | 商人条款偷换

✕ C: 拿 both merchants 说事，但商人身份不影响撤回规则。

这题建议用什么方法？

先锁定“是否已撤回得及”，再看对方有没有先把局面做死。

考场速记

记忆口诀：预期违约可以撤回，前提是对方还没先取消、没实质变更、也没把它当终局。

考到中间上诉时才记 In Certain Circumstances, An Appeal Can Be Made Prematurely；这题不用，别乱套。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A landowner entered into a single contract with a builder to have three different structures built on separate pieces of property owned by the landowner. Each structure was distinct from the other two, and the parties agreed on a specific price for each. After completing the first structure in accordance with the terms of the contract, the builder demanded payment of the specified price for that structure. At the same time, the builder told the landowner that the builder was "tired of the construction business" and would not even begin the other two structures. The landowner refused to pay anything to the builder.
Is the builder likely to prevail in a suit for the agreed-upon price of the first structure?

choices.A: No, because substantial performance is a constructive condition to the landowner's duty to pay at the contract rate.
choices.B: No, because the builder's cessation of performance without legal excuse was a willful breach of the contract.
choices.C: Yes, because the contract is divisible, and the landowner will be required to bring a separate claim for the builder's failure to complete the other two structures.
choices.D: Yes, because the contract is divisible, but the landowner will be able to deduct any recoverable damages caused by the builder's failure to complete the contract.

questions.explanation:
Divisible contracts
Definition
  • Contract composed of multiple bargained-for exchanges that can be separately enforced
Recovery after breach
  • Breaching party entitled to return performance for any completed or substantially performed promise
  • Nonbreaching party entitled to damages stemming from breach

Divisible contracts contain two or more bargained-for exchanges, each of which can be enforced separately. Under such a contract, a party is entitled to return performance (eg, payment) for any completed or substantially performed promise. This is true even if that party breaches the other, separately enforceable agreement. However, the nonbreaching party may deduct from any payment made to the breaching party damages stemming from the breach.

Here, the builder-landowner contract was divisible because it consisted of three bargained-for exchanges—ie, three distinct structures, each at a specified price—that could be enforced separately. Since the builder completed the first structure, it is entitled to the agreed-upon price for that structure despite its failure to complete the others. However, the landowner will be able to deduct any recoverable damages caused by the builder's failure to complete the contract.

(Choice A) A party is entitled to return performance for completing or substantially performing a divisible part of the contract—even if that party failed to substantially perform the entire contract.

(Choice B) The builder's cessation of performance without legal excuse was a willful breach of the contract. And willfulness is a factor in determining whether a breach is material—ie, significant enough to deprive the other party of the substantial benefit of the bargain. But willfulness does not affect recovery in this case.

(Choice C) The nonbreaching party to a divisible contract need not bring separate actions for damages stemming from each breach. That is because it is still a single contract.

📌 Educational Objective

Divisible contracts contain two or more bargained-for exchanges that can be separately enforced. Under a divisible contract, a party is entitled to return performance for a completed or substantially performed promise—even if that party breaches another part of the contract.
questions.zh-question:
一位土地所有者与一位建筑商签订了一份单一合同，在其拥有的不同地块上建造三座不同的建筑物。每座建筑物都与其他两座不同，且双方为每座建筑物约定了具体的价格。在按照合同条款完成第一座建筑物后，建筑商要求支付该建筑物的约定价格。同时，建筑商告诉土地所有者，他“厌倦了建筑生意”，并且不会开始建造另外两座建筑物。土地所有者拒绝向建筑商支付任何款项。

在该建筑商就第一座建筑物的约定价格提起的诉讼中，他是否可能胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 不会，因为实质性履行是土地所有者按合同价格支付价款义务的推定条件。
zh-choices.B: 不会，因为建筑商在没有合法理由的情况下停止履行合同，构成了故意违约。
zh-choices.C: 会，因为该合同是可分的，土地所有者将需要就建筑商未能完成另外两座建筑物一事另行提起索赔。
zh-choices.D: 会，因为该合同是可分的，但土地所有者将能够从应付款项中扣除因建筑商未能完成合同而造成的任何可获赔的损害赔偿。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Performance of Contractual Duty

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：这个建筑合同是不是 可分合同（divisible contract），所以已经完成的第一部分能不能先拿到对应价款。

三秒认题路径：

三栋独立结构 → 每栋单独定价 → 已完工一栋 → 可分合同 → 先拿这笔钱

核心法律规则

能不能先拿已完成部分的对价

可分合同（divisible contract）是指合同里有两个或以上 可分别执行的交换（bargained-for exchanges），所以每一段完成后，都可以单独请求对应的 返还履行（return performance）。考场意思：你不用先把整份合同做完，才有资格拿已经做完那一段的钱。

但未守约的一方，还是可以就对方违约造成的损失主张抵扣。考场意思：can recover, but damages offset first，不是白拿全额。

核心判例： 本题不需要特定判例名；关键是可分合同规则本身，已经完成的独立部分可先请求对应价款。

思维导图

先看合同结构：是一份合同，还是多个可分别结算的交换？
事实触发三栋不同建筑 + 每栋单独定价 + 各自可单独完成。
法律归类这不是“一次性打包交付”，而是 可分合同（divisible contract）。
规则结果已完成第一栋 → 可以请求该栋对应价款。
卡死点：builder 说“我不干了”只会带来违约损害，不会抹掉已完成部分的收款权。
最后答案土地所有人可先付第一栋价款，再扣减可证明的违约损失。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：builder 后面明确拒绝继续施工，还说自己“累了”，那就应该整份合同都拿不到钱。

但考试真正问的是：第一栋既然已经独立完成，能不能先就这一段拿到对应报酬。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

这里不要被“全部违约”带跑，可分合同（divisible contract）会把已完成部分和未完成部分拆开看。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干的 三栋独立结构、分别定价 正说明是可分合同，所以第一栋完成后可拿对应价款；但土地所有人仍可扣减因后两栋违约造成的损失。

❌ 概念混淆 | 把整约当一体

✕ A: 误以为必须先完成整份合同才有收款权，忽略了可分部分已经独立完成。

❌ 法律适用 | 违约严厉化

✕ B: 把 willful breach 当成自动剥夺已完成部分报酬的理由。

❌ 事实误判 | 拆错救济方式

✕ C: 说要“另案起诉”是偷换概念，单一合同里也能主张抵扣损害。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看合同是不是可分，再把“已完成部分的价款”和“未完成部分的损害赔偿”分开算。

考场速记

记住一句话：可分合同（divisible contract）里，完成一段就先拿一段的钱；另一段没做完，只影响损害赔偿，不自动抹掉已完成部分的报酬。

速记：“先完成、先收款；后违约、后抵扣。”

reason.zh: 确定了对合同其余部分的违约，产生抵销损失。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A client consulted with his lawyer about handling the sale of the client's building, and asked the lawyer what her legal fee would be. The lawyer replied that her usual charge was $100 per hour, and estimated that the legal work on behalf of the client would cost about $5,000 at that rate. The client said, "Okay; let's proceed with it," and the lawyer timely and successfully completed the work. Because of unexpected title problems, the lawyer reasonably spent 75 hours on the matter and shortly thereafter mailed the client a bill for $7,500, with a letter itemizing the work performed and time spent. The client responded by a letter expressing his good-faith belief that the lawyer had agreed to a total fee of no more than $5,000. The client enclosed a check in the amount of $5,000 payable to the lawyer and conspicuously marked, "Payment in full for legal services in connection with the sale of my building." Despite reading the "Payment in full..." language, the lawyer, without any notation of protest or reservation of rights, endorsed and deposited the check to her bank account. The check was duly paid by the client's bank. A few days later, the lawyer unsuccessfully demanded payment from the client of the $2,500 difference between the amount of her bill and the check, and now sues the client for that difference.
What, if anything, can the lawyer recover from the client?

choices.A: $2,500, because the client agreed to an hourly rate for as many hours as the work reasonably required, and the sum of $5,000 was merely an estimate.
choices.B: Nothing, because the amount of the lawyer's fee was disputed in good faith by the client, and the lawyer impliedly agreed to an accord and satisfaction.
choices.C: Nothing, because the risk of unexpected title problems in a real-property transaction is properly allocable to the seller's attorney and thus to the lawyer in this case.
choices.D: The reasonable value of the lawyer's services in excess of $5,000, if any, because there was no specific agreement on the total amount of the lawyer's fee.

questions.explanation:
Offer to satisfy debt with check
Debtor tenders check clearly marked "payment in full"
Amount of debt undisputed
Check ≥ Debt
▼
Debt satisfied
Check < Debt
▼
Debt not satisfied
Amount of debt disputed
Creditor cashes check
▼
Debt satisfied
Creditor rejects check
▼
Debt not satisfied

When a debt is disputed in good faith, the debtor can offer to settle the debt by giving the creditor a check with a conspicuous notation stating that it constitutes payment in full. The creditor can then:

  • cash the check – in which case the creditor impliedly agrees to an accord and satisfaction, and the debt is discharged or
  • reject the check – in which case the debt is not discharged.

Here, the lawyer agreed to handle the sale of the client's building for $100 per hour at an estimated cost of $5,000. Due to unexpected title problems, the lawyer reasonably spent 75 hours on the matter and billed the client $7,500. However, the client replied with a letter disputing the fee in good faith and enclosing a $5,000 check conspicuously marked "Payment in full." Since the lawyer cashed the check, she impliedly agreed to an accord and satisfaction. Therefore, the client's debt was discharged, and the lawyer can recover nothing from the client.

(Choice A) A court could find that the client agreed to an hourly rate for as many hours as the work reasonably required and that the $5,000 sum was merely an estimate. But since the client disputed the $7,500 fee in good faith, he was entitled to offer a lesser amount to discharge the debt.

(Choice C) The parties never indicated who would bear the risk of unexpected title problems, and there is no rule automatically placing that risk on the seller's attorney (here, the lawyer). And regardless of where the risk is placed, the lawyer cannot recover since she cashed the check.

(Choice D) Had the lawyer rejected the check, she might be able to recover the reasonable value of her services in excess of $5,000 under a quasi-contract (ie, unjust enrichment) theory.

📌 Educational Objective

When a debt is disputed in good faith, the debtor can offer to settle the debt by giving the creditor a check with a conspicuous "payment-in-full" notation. The debt is then discharged if the creditor chooses to cash the check.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 281 cmt. d (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that a creditor who cashes a check marked "payment in full" may have formed an enforceable accord).
questions.zh-question:
一位客户就其大楼的出售事宜咨询了律师，并询问律师费用是多少。律师回答说，她通常的收费是每小时100美元，并估计按此费率计算，为客户提供的法律工作将花费约5000美元。客户说：“好的，我们开始吧。”律师及时并成功地完成了工作。由于意外的产权问题，律师合理地在此事上花费了75个小时，并在此后不久向客户邮寄了一张7500美元的账单，并附上一封信，详细列明了所进行的工作和花费的时间。客户回信表示，他善意地相信律师已同意总费用不超过5000美元。客户附上了一张支付给律师的5000美元支票，并显着标明：“全额支付与我的大楼出售相关的法律服务费用。”尽管看到了“全额支付……”的字样，律师未作任何抗议或权利保留的批注，便背书并将该支票存入了她的银行账户。该支票已由客户的银行正式兑付。几天后，律师向客户要求支付其账单金额与支票金额之间的2500美元差额，但未获成功，现就该差额起诉客户。

如果可以，律师能从客户那里追讨回什么？

zh-choices.A: 2500美元，因为客户同意按小时费率支付工作合理需要的小时数，而5000美元的金额仅仅是一个估算。
zh-choices.B: 无法追讨回任何款项，因为客户对律师费用的金额提出了善意的争议，且律师默示同意了和解与清偿。
zh-choices.C: 无法追讨回任何款项，因为在不动产交易中，意外产权问题的风险应合理地分配给卖方律师，因此在本案中应由该律师承担。
zh-choices.D: 超过5000美元的律师服务的合理价值（如有），因为双方未就律师费用的总额达成具体协议。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Consideration

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：债务金额被善意争议时，债务人用明确写着“payment in full”的支票结清，收款人一旦兑现就会形成 accord and satisfaction（和解清偿），所以还能不能再追差额。

三秒认题路径：

善意争议 → 全额标记支票 → 对方兑现 → 和解清偿 → 不能再追差额

核心法律规则

这题只用这一条规则

当债务金额存在 good-faith dispute（善意争议） 时，债务人可以用一张明显写着 payment in full（付清全款） 的支票提出和解。收款人如果兑现支票，考场意思：就是默认接受 accord and satisfaction（和解清偿），原债务被消灭。

如果收款人拒收，债务通常不消灭；但这里律师已经把支票存进去了，所以她后面再起诉追 $2,500，路就被堵死了。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 281 的思路锁定本题：争议债务 + 全额结清标记 + 兑现 = 和解清偿成立。

思维导图

先看：这笔钱是不是“已经被善意争议”？
是 债务人可开 payment in full 支票。
再看 收款人有没有兑现？
如果兑现 直接触发 accord and satisfaction → 债务消灭 → 不能再追差额
如果拒收 债务不消灭，仍可继续主张原债务。
本题事实 律师明知写着 Payment in full 仍然兑现，所以结论卡死在“不能再收 $2,500”。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：律师按每小时 $100 收费，实际干了 75 小时，所以当然能再追到 $2,500。

但考试真正问的是：当客户已经善意争议费用并用“全额结清”支票来谈和解时，律师有没有把这张支票收下去。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

客户对费用金额有 good-faith dispute，又明确寄来写着 Payment in full 的支票；律师兑现后，accord and satisfaction 成立，所以她拿不到差额。

❌ 事实误判 | 估价当成定价

✕ A: 把 estimate 当成最终价，忘了争议后已可用较低金额结清。

❌ 法律适用 | 风险归属误套

✕ C: 盯着标题问题找责任归属，但这题的杀招是律师已经兑现了全额结清支票。

❌ 概念混淆 | 准合同误判

✕ D: 想用 quasi-contract 追更多，但她先把和解清偿做实了，后门就关上了。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓“善意争议 + 全额结清支票 + 是否兑现”三连问，再决定原债务有没有被消灭。

考场速记

记忆口诀：争议金额 + payment in full + 兑现 = accord and satisfaction。遇到“先寄支票、后想追差额”的题，先问对方有没有把钱存进去；存了，通常就别再追了。

reason.en: Confirms the creditor accepted the terms of the check without reserving the right to sue for the remainder.

reason.en: The original billing method, which is superseded by the subsequent accord.

reason.en: Key condition required for a valid accord and satisfaction of a debt.

reason.en: The doctrine that legally discharges the remaining debt.

reason.en: Irrelevant legal principle regarding attorney responsibility in real estate transactions.

D.text: reasonable value of the lawyer's services

reason.en: Refers to quasi-contract recovery, which is barred by the valid accord.
reason.zh: 指准合同下的恢复，但因存在有效的代物清偿而被排除。

highlights.text: expressing his good-faith belief that the lawyer had agreed to a total fee of no more than $5,000

reason.en: Establishes that the amount of the debt was disputed in good faith.
reason.zh: 确立了债务金额存在诚信争议。

highlights.text: Payment in full for legal services in connection with the sale of my building

reason.en: The debtor's clear offer to settle the disputed claim in full via the check.
reason.zh: 债务人通过支票明确提出的结清争议债权的要约。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A business contracted with a shareholder to purchase all of the shareholder's stock in a corporation at a specified price per share. At the time this contract was executed, the business's financial officer said to the shareholder, "Our commitment to buy is conditioned on our obtaining approval of the contract from our parent company." The shareholder replied, "Fine. No problem." The shareholder subsequently refused to consummate the sale on the ground that the business had neglected to request the parent company's approval of the contract, which was true. The parent company's chief executive officer, however, is prepared to testify that the parent company would have routinely approved the contract if requested to do so. The business can also prove that it has made a substantial sale of other assets to finance the stock purchase, although it admittedly had not anticipated any such necessity when it entered into the stock-purchase agreement.
If the business sues the shareholder for breach of contract, is the business likely to prevail?

choices.A: No, because obtaining the parent company's approval of the contract was an event within the business's control and the business's failure to obtain it was itself a material breach of contract.
choices.B: No, because the express condition of the parent company's approval had not occurred prior to the lawsuit.
choices.C: Yes, because the business detrimentally relied on the shareholder's commitment by selling off other assets to finance the stock purchase.
choices.D: Yes, because the condition of the parent company's approval of the contract, being designed to protect only the business and the parent company, can be and has been waived by those entities.

questions.explanation:
When nonoccurrence of condition is excused
Waiver
  • Party waives condition by words or conduct
Wrongful interference
  • Party wrongfully prevents or interferes with condition's occurrence
Estoppel
  • Party indicates condition will not be enforced
AND
  • Other party reasonably & detrimentally relies on belief that condition has been waived
Disproportionate forfeiture
  • Party substantially performed & will be significantly harmed if condition is enforced

A party may generally avoid performance if a condition precedent—i.e., an uncertain future event that must occur before either or both parties' performance becomes due—has not occurred. The nonoccurrence of a condition may be excused, however, if the party who benefits from the condition waives it by words or conduct. The waiving party may retract the waiver unless the other party has detrimentally relied on it.

Here, the business's obligation to buy the shareholder's stock was conditioned on obtaining the parent company's approval (condition precedent). Although the business neglected to obtain that approval (nonoccurrence), the condition is for the benefit and protection of the business—not the shareholder. Therefore, the business waived the condition precedent by not obtaining approval from the parent company (Choice B). This means that the business will likely prevail.

(Choice A) Obtaining the parent company's approval was not an event within the business's control because the parent company could have refused to approve the contract.

(Choice C) Under the doctrine of promissory estoppel, a party can enforce a promise on which it reasonably and detrimentally relied when no valid contract was formed. But this doctrine does not apply here because a contract was formed, and performance became due when the condition precedent was waived.

📌 Educational Objective

Nonoccurrence of a condition may be excused if the party who benefits from the condition waives it by words or conduct.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§ 224–25 (Am. L. Inst. 1981) (discussing conditions and effect of nonoccurrence).
questions.zh-question:
一家企业与一名股东签订合同，以约定的每股价格购买该股东在一家公司中的所有股份。合同签订时，该企业的财务主管对股东说：“我们的购买承诺，以我们获得母公司对该合同的批准为条件。”股东回答说：“好的，没问题。”该股东随后以该企业疏于请求母公司批准合同为由，拒绝完成该交易，而这一情况属实。然而，母公司的首席执行官准备作证，如果当时提出请求，母公司通常会批准该合同。该企业还可以证明，为了筹集购买股票的资金，它已出售了大量其他资产，尽管它承认在签订股票购买协议时并未预见到有此必要。

如果该企业以违约为由起诉该股东，企业是否可能胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 不会，因为获得母公司对合同的批准是该企业可控的事件，而企业未能获得批准本身就构成了重大违约。
zh-choices.B: 不会，因为在诉讼前，母公司批准的明确条件并未发生。
zh-choices.C: 会，因为该企业因信赖股东的承诺而出售其他资产以筹集购买股票的资金，从而遭受了不利影响。
zh-choices.D: 会，因为母公司批准合同这一条件仅为保护该企业和母公司而设，可以也已经被这些主体所放弃。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Suspension or Excuse of Conditions

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：先决条件（condition precedent）没发生时，受益方（benefiting party）能不能用放弃（waiver）把条件“放掉”，继续要求对方履行。

三秒认题路径：

先决条件 → 谁受益 → 口头/行为放弃 → 条件不再卡死 → 买方可胜

核心法律规则

只要抓住这一条

先决条件（condition precedent）是“先发生，后履行”的门槛；门槛没到，通常可以拒绝履行。但如果这个条件只是为了某一方的利益设置的，那一方可以用放弃（waiver）把它放掉，方式可以是言语或行为。

考试上最关键的一句是：被保护的一方一旦放弃，条件的非发生就不再挡住履行。Effectively reviewable 这种思路不在这题里，这题只看条件是不是已经被受益方放弃。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§ 224–25——条件如果只是保护受益方，受益方可以放弃，条件非发生就不再解除对方义务。

思维导图

起点：父公司审批是先决条件吗？
是 是，就先问：这个条件是给谁看的？
给买方自己 买方可以不去要审批，也可以用行为表示“我不要这个门槛了”。
卡死点：waiver成立后，不能再拿“没审批”挡履行。
给卖方 那卖方才能拿它当挡箭牌；但本题不是这样。
再看题干：买方一直在为自己融资、而不是为了让卖方受益。
结论 条件是保护买方和母公司，买方可放弃，所以买方仍可要卖方交股。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：“既然父公司真的没批准，那条件没发生，买方就输。”

但考试真正问的是：这个条件是不是只给买方自己留的保护伞。是的话，买方可以不要这把伞，直接放弃条件继续推进交易。

所以别被“没发生”两个字骗了：这里看的是条件能不能被受益方放弃，不是看它在事实层面有没有出现过。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干说父公司审批是为了保护买方自己和母公司，属于买方可放弃的先决条件；买方没去请求审批，等于把这道门槛放掉了，所以仍可要求卖方履行。

❌ 概念混淆 | 责任违约误判

✕ A: 把material breach硬塞进条件问题，命题人想骗你把“没审批”当成违约本身。

❌ 法律适用 | 条件僵化误判

✕ B: 只盯着not occurred，却漏掉了受益方已经可以放弃条件。

❌ 事实误判 | 依赖替代偷换

✕ C: 把后来的融资卖资当成detrimental reliance，但这里早有合同，靠的是放弃，不是允诺禁反言。

这题建议用什么方法？

先问条件是给谁的，再问那一方有没有用言行把门槛放掉。

考场速记

记住一句：受益方设的条件，受益方可以放弃。先看“谁受益”，再看“谁能放”，不要被“条件没发生”直接带跑。

遇到条件题，脑中先过：condition precedent → waiver → 对方还能不能继续主张履行。

question_analysis.skill_tested: Determine if condition precedent was waived

reason.en: Indicates that the contract's performance is contingent on a future event.
reason.zh: 表明合同履行取决于未来的事件。

reason.en: Shows that the business did not fulfill the condition precedent.

reason.en: Acts as a distractor for promissory estoppel or detrimental reliance argument.

reason.en: The legal claim basis upon which the business seeks relief.
reason.zh: 企业寻求救济的法律诉讼基础。

reason.en: Incorrectly classifies the failure to seek approval as a material breach of contract.
reason.zh: 错误地将未寻求批准归类为重大违约。

reason.en: Ignores the rule that a condition precedent can be waived by the party it protects.
reason.zh: 忽视了受保护方可放弃先决条件的规则。

reason.en: Incorrectly applies reliance doctrine where a valid contract already exists.
reason.zh: 在已存在有效合同的情况下错误地应用了信赖原则。

reason.en: Correctly identifies that a condition solely benefiting a party can be unilaterally waived.
reason.zh: 正确指出仅对一方有利的条件可被单方面放弃。

highlights.text: conditioned on our obtaining approval of the contract from our parent company

reason.en: Establishes an express condition precedent that must occur before performance is due.
reason.zh: 确立了在履行前必须成就的明示先决条件。

highlights.text: neglected to request the parent company's approval

reason.en: Identifies that the condition was not met due to the business's own inaction.
reason.zh: 指出由于企业自身未采取行动导致条件未成就。
