questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A rental company contracted to lease a collapsible sports dome to a private tennis club. The dome would be used to cover the club's outdoor tennis courts so that the courts could be used for the club's Annual Winter Tennis Tournament beginning on November 16. The contract required the rental company to finish installing the dome no later than November 15.
On November 10, the installation crew arrived to lay out the anchoring system required for the dome. However, the crew did not have enough anchors to secure the dome. The club's owner overheard a crew member say that the rental company had forgotten to order the rest of the anchors and that he did not expect them to arrive for at least a month. That same day, the club owner canceled the contract and leased an indoor space near the club. The rental company has sued the tennis club for breach of contract.
Will the rental company likely prevail?

choices.A: No, because the crew member's November 10 statement was an anticipatory repudiation that gave the club owner the right to cancel the contract.
choices.B: No, because the rental company's failure to order the remaining anchors made it impossible to finish installing the dome by November 15.
choices.C: Yes, because the club owner failed to seasonably notify the rental company of his intention to cancel the contract before leasing the indoor space.
choices.D: Yes, because the club owner never demanded and did not obtain the rental company's assurance of due performance under the contract.

questions.explanation:
Prospective inability to perform v. Anticipatory repudiation
Contract formed
Doubtful ability to perform =
Prospective inability to perform
Demand for assurance
(in writing under UCC)
Reasonable time for assurance
(≤ 30 days under UCC)
Repudiation from failure to assure
Action for breach
Performance due
Clear & unequivocal refusal to perform =
Anticipatory repudiation
Action for breach
Performance due
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

Anticipatory repudiation occurs when one party to a contract unequivocally communicates to the other party that it will not perform under the contract. This gives the other party the right to cancel the contract and sue for breach.* In contrast, prospective inability to perform involves words or conduct that create reasonable grounds for insecurity that a party will perform. This gives the other party the right to demand assurance of performance. Failure to provide adequate assurance within a reasonable time is an anticipatory repudiation.

Here, the club owner overheard the crew member say that he did not expect the remaining anchors to arrive for at least a month. This was not an unequivocal statement by the rental company that it would not perform (no anticipatory repudiation) (Choice A).

However, the statement gave the owner reasonable grounds for insecurity about the company's ability to install the dome by November 15 (prospective inability to perform). But since the owner never demanded and did not obtain the company's assurance, the owner's cancellation of the contract on November 10 was premature. Therefore, the company will likely prevail.

*Alternatively, the other party may ignore the repudiation and demand performance pursuant to the contract.

(Choice B) A repudiation can be communicated through words or through conduct that renders due performance impossible. Here, although the lack of anchors made it impossible to install the dome on November 10, the rental company still had five days to perform.

(Choice C) Had the rental company repudiated the contract, it could have retracted the repudiation by notifying the club owner of the retraction before he (1) cancelled the contract, (2) materially changed position in reliance on the repudiation, or (3) indicated that he considered the repudiation to be final. But the club owner would not have been required to notify the rental company before doing any of those things.

📌 Educational Objective

A contracting party's prospective inability to perform entitles the other party to demand assurance of performance. Failure to provide such assurance within a reasonable time is an anticipatory repudiation that justifies canceling the contract.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 250 (Am. Law Inst. 2020) (repudiation).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 251 (Am. Law Inst. 2020) (failure to provide assurance as repudiation).
questions.zh-question:
一家租赁公司与一家私人网球俱乐部签订合同，向其出租一个可折叠式运动穹顶。该穹顶将用于覆盖俱乐部的室外网球场，以便这些球场能用于俱乐部于11月16日开始的年度冬季网球锦标赛。合同要求租赁公司不迟于11月15日完成穹顶的安装。

11月10日，安装团队到达现场，为穹顶布置所需的锚固系统。然而，团队没有足够的锚栓来固定穹顶。俱乐部所有者无意中听到一名团队成员说，租赁公司忘记订购剩余的锚栓，他预计这些锚栓至少一个月内不会到货。同一天，俱乐部所有者取消了合同，并在俱乐部附近租用了一个室内场地。租赁公司以违约为由起诉了该网球俱乐部。

租赁公司可能会胜诉吗？

zh-choices.A: 不会，因为该团队成员11月10日的陈述构成了预期毁约，赋予了俱乐部所有者取消合同的权利。
zh-choices.B: 不会，因为租赁公司未能订购剩余的锚栓，导致其不可能在11月15日前完成穹顶的安装。
zh-choices.C: 会，因为俱乐部所有者在租赁室内场地之前，未能及时将其取消合同的意图通知租赁公司。
zh-choices.D: 会，因为俱乐部所有者从未要求也未能获得租赁公司根据合同作出的适当履行的保证。

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Anticipatory Repudiation

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：对方只是履约能力可疑（prospective inability to perform），还是已经明确拒绝履约（anticipatory repudiation）；只有前者时，先要索取履约保证（assurance of performance），不能直接解约。

三秒认题路径：

没到期 → 只是不稳 → 先要保证 → 未给保证 → 不能先解除

核心法律规则

anticipatory repudiation（预期违约）要求一方用言语或行为明确表示“我到期也不会履行”，所以对方可以直接解除并起诉。若只是让人担心它可能来不及履约，这叫prospective inability to perform（履约前景不稳），考场意思：你先别急着翻桌，应该先要assurance of performance（履约保证）。如果在合理时间内没拿到保证，才会转成可解除的违约。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 251 — 这里锁定的是“先催保证、后谈解约”，不是一听到坏消息就立刻终止合同。

思维导图

先看：对方有没有明确说“我不会履行”？
YES 这才是 anticipatory repudiation，对方可直接解除并起诉。
NO
只是“看起来可能来不及”或“能力不稳”？
YES 先要 assurance of performance → 合理时间内没给 → 才算违约，可解除
NO 继续等到到期 → 到期未履行再算
本题卡死点：11月10日只是“ anchors 还没到”，不是“我绝不履行”。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然锚钉不够，11月15日之前一定完不成，那就可以马上解除。

但考试真正问的是：这是不是已经到了明确拒绝履约（anticipatory repudiation）的程度，还是只是履约前景不稳（prospective inability to perform）。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的材料现在够不够」。 本题里，租赁公司还有时间补救，业主不能跳过“先要保证”这一步。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干只显示 11 月 10 日锚钉不够、工人说“至少一个月后才到”，这只是让业主起疑；他没有先要到assurance of performance就直接解约，所以是他先违约。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 把“可能晚到”误当成anticipatory repudiation，其实还没到明确拒绝那一步。

❌ 事实误判 | 时间节点偷换

✕ B: 误把“当天装不完”说成“到11月15日也做不到”。

❌ 法律适用 | 先通知义务错置

✕ C: 先催告保证的是业主，不是先去通知对方自己要解除。

这题建议用什么方法？

先分清是“明确拒绝”还是“只是让人不放心”，再决定能不能直接解约。

考场速记

记忆口诀：先看是否明确拒绝；不明确，就先要保证。看到“还没到期、只是材料不够、对方担心会迟到”，先联想 prospective inability to perform，不要急着选“立刻解除”。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A producer contracted to pay an inexperienced performer a specified salary to act in a small role in a play the producer was taking on a six-week road tour. The contract was for the duration of the tour.
On the third day of the tour, the performer was hospitalized with a stomach disorder. The producer replaced her in the cast with an experienced actor. One week later, the performer recovered, but the producer refused to allow her to resume her original role for the remainder of the tour.
In an action by the performer against the producer for breach of contract, which of the following, if proved, would be the producer's best defense?

choices.A: Both the producer and the performer knew that a year earlier the performer had been incapacitated for a short period of time by the same kind of stomach disorder.
choices.B: The actor, by general acclaim, was much better in the role than the performer had been.
choices.C: The actor was the only replacement the producer could find, and the actor would accept nothing less than a contract for the remainder of the six-week tour.
choices.D: The producer offered to employ the performer as the actor's understudy for the remainder of the six-week tour at the performer's original salary, but the performer declined.

questions.explanation:
Ways to discharge contractual obligations

  • Full performance of contractual obligations
  • Impossibility, impracticability, or frustration of purpose
  • Release (in writing only)
  • Mutual rescission
  • Substituted contract
  • Contract or covenant not to sue
  • Accord & satisfaction
  • Novation
Mnemonic: FIRM SCAN

A party's duty to perform under a contract can be dismissed by impracticability. The defense of impracticability is available when:

  • an unanticipated or extraordinary event makes it impracticable for the party to perform
  • the contract was formed under a basic assumption that the event would not occur and
  • the party seeking discharge was not at fault.

However, temporary impracticability merely suspends the party's duty to perform until the circumstances giving rise to the impracticability cease to exist—with one exception. If the delay makes performance materially more burdensome, the party's duty to perform is dismissed.

Here, the performer's illness suspended the producer's duty to employ the performer during the period that her illness prevented her from acting. The producer then replaced her with an experienced actor. If the actor was the only replacement the producer could find and would not take a contract for less than the remainder of the six-week tour, the producer's obligation to the performer would be dismissed. The reason is that it would be materially more burdensome for the producer to employ them both. Therefore, if proved, that is the producer's best defense.

(Choice A) If both the producer and the performer knew that a year earlier the performer had been incapacitated by the same kind of stomach disorder, the performer's illness would have been foreseeable. As a result, this fact would undermine the producer's impracticability defense.

(Choice B) The relative quality of the actor's performance is not a circumstance that would suspend or discharge the producer's contractual duty to the performer.

(Choice D) The producer's action in offering the performer a job as the actor's understudy is irrelevant to the critical issue of whether the producer had the right to cancel the contract.

📌 Educational Objective

A period of temporary impracticability suspends a party's duty to perform until the circumstances giving rise to the impracticability pass. But if the delay caused by the impracticability makes performance materially more burdensome, then the party's duty to perform is discharged.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 261 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (discharge by supervening impracticability).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 269 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (temporary impracticability).
questions.zh-question:
一名制片人与一名缺乏经验的演员签订合同，约定支付其特定薪酬，让其在该制片人组织的一场为期六周的巡回演出戏剧中扮演一个小角色。合同期限为整个巡演期间。

巡演第三天，该演员因胃病住院。制片人用一名经验丰富的演员替换了她在剧组中的位置。一周后，该演员康复，但制片人拒绝让其在剩余的巡演期间恢复其原有角色。

在该演员以违约为由对制片人提起的诉讼中，以下哪项如果得到证实，将是制片人最好的抗辩理由？

zh-choices.A: 制片人和演员双方都知道，一年前该演员曾因同类胃病而短暂丧失行为能力。
zh-choices.B: 根据普遍赞誉，新演员在该角色上的表现远胜于原演员。
zh-choices.C: 该新演员是制片人能找到的唯一替代人选，并且该新演员只接受一份覆盖剩余六周巡演时间的合同。
zh-choices.D: 制片人提出在剩余的六周巡演中，以原薪酬聘用原演员担任新演员的替补，但原演员拒绝了。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Impracticability

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：临时不履行不能（temporary impracticability）会先暂停合同义务，但如果拖延会让继续履行变得更沉重，义务就能被解除。

三秒认题路径：

生病停演 → 临时不能 → 看替代人 → 继续更重 → 解除义务

核心法律规则

不履行不能（impracticability）考场意思：不是“有点难”，而是出现了一个意外且重大事件，让原本的履行变成不合理地困难。

临时不履行不能（temporary impracticability）考场意思：先暂停义务，不是自动终止；但如果等下去会让履行变得 materially more burdensome，就可以直接解除。

这题的关键是：演员只是暂时住院，并不当然让制片人永远免除雇用义务；要看继续把她留在合同里，会不会比现在更难办。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§ 261, 269 — 这两条把“超出预期的重大事件”与“临时不能时的暂停/解除”锁死了本题结论。

思维导图

看到“演员住院、临时不能演” → 先问：是完全终局解除，还是只是暂时暂停？
先看规则
临时不能 → 原则上只是暂停义务，不是立刻毁约。
再看例外
如果拖延会让继续履行变成 materially more burdensome，就从“暂停”跳到“解除”。
套回题干
只有“找不到别的替代演员，且替代人要占满剩余六周”→ 同时雇两个人会更重、更贵、更麻烦。
落点
所以制片人最佳抗辩是：继续等她回来会让履行更沉重，义务可解除 → 选正确项。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：演员更优秀、以前也生过这种病、或者制片人给了她替代岗位，应该都能帮制片人赢。

但考试真正问的是：哪一个事实能证明“临时不能”已经变成“继续履行更麻烦”，不是谁演得更好、也不是谁态度更体面。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干 only replacement 加上对方只肯接满剩余六周，说明继续等她回来会让制片人同时背两份排演安排，履行变得更重，所以能解除义务。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 以前也犯过病不等于这次就能免责，反而更像可预见风险。

❌ 事实误判 | 优劣偷换

✕ B: 演得更好不是解除义务的理由，much better 只是偏好，不是不能履行。

❌ 法律适用 | 备选岗位误判

✕ D: 给她当替补岗位不解决核心问题，重点还是能否终止原合同。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓“临时不能”与“继续履行是否更重”这条线，再看哪个选项正好证明解除义务。

考场速记

记住：临时不履行不能（temporary impracticability）先暂停，只有拖到 materially more burdensome 才会解除；本题就找“唯一替代人 + 必须占满剩余期限”这种升级事实。

口诀：FIRM SCAN 里先扫 impracticability，再想“是暂停，还是已经变成更重所以能解约”。

question_analysis.skill_tested: evaluating excuse for contract nonperformance

reason.en: Triggers the doctrine of temporary impossibility of performance due to illness.
reason.zh: 触发因疾病导致暂时履行不能的规则。

reason.en: Establishes the short duration of the contract, making replacement constraints critical.
reason.zh: 确定了合同的短期性，使得寻找替代人选的限制变得至关重要。

keywords.text: refused to allow her to resume

reason.en: The conduct of the producer that forms the basis of the performer's breach action.
reason.zh: 构成演员起诉违约基础的制作人行为。

reason.en: Directs the inquiry to finding an excuse that discharges the producer's duty.
reason.zh: 引导寻找免除制作人合同义务的抗辩事由。

A.text: incapacitated for a short period of time

reason.en: Suggests prior knowledge or foreseeability of illness, which is legally irrelevant to the current breach defense.
reason.zh: 暗示先前已知情或疾病的可预见性，这在法律上与当前的违约抗辩无关。

reason.en: A replacement's superior quality does not excuse breaching the contract with the original performer.
reason.zh: 替代人员更优秀的表现并不能免除对原演员违约的责任。

C.text: only replacement the producer could find

reason.en: Demonstrates the necessity of securing the replacement, which discharges the duty to reinstate.
reason.zh: 证明了确保替代人员的必要性，从而免除了重新雇佣原演员的义务。

D.text: employ the performer as the actor's understudy

reason.en: Relates to the mitigation of damages (remedy) rather than a defense to the breach of contract claim itself (liability).
reason.zh: 涉及减轻损失（救济），而非对违约指控本身的抗辩（责任）。

highlights.text: hospitalized with a stomach disorder

reason.en: Shows performer was temporarily unable to perform, permitting the producer to find a replacement.
reason.zh: 表明演员暂时无法履行，允许制作人寻找替代者。

highlights.text: refused to allow her to resume her original role

reason.en: The specific action by the producer that is the subject of the breach of contract claim.
reason.zh: 制作人被诉违约的具体行为。

highlights.text: six-week road tour

reason.en: Shows that a one-week delay is a substantial portion of the contract period, affecting the materiality of breach.
reason.zh: 表明一周的延迟占合同期的比例很大，影响违约的实质性判断。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A broker needed a certain rare coin to complete a set that he had contracted to assemble and sell to a collector. On February 1, the broker obtained such a coin from a hoarder in exchange for $1,000 and a written promise to redeliver to the hoarder "no later than December 31 of this year" a comparable specimen of the same kind of coin. On February 2, the broker consummated the sale of the complete set to the collector.
On October 1, the market price of rare coins suddenly began a rapid, sustained rise. On October 15, the broker wrote the hoarder, "In view of the surprising market, it seems unfair that I should have to replace your coin within the next few weeks." On October 17, the hoarder responded in writing that she was treating the broker's repudiation as final and canceled the contract.
On November 15, the hoarder sued the broker for the market value of a comparable replacement-coin.
If the broker moves to dismiss the hoarder's complaint, which of the following is the broker's best argument in support of the motion?

choices.A: Even if the broker repudiated on October 15, the hoarder has no remedy because she failed to demand in writing that the broker retract his repudiation.
choices.B: Even if the broker repudiated on October 15, the hoarder's only action would be for specific performance because the coin is a unique chattel.
choices.C: The broker did not repudiate the contract on October 15 and may still perform no later than the contract deadline of December 31.
choices.D: Under the doctrine of impossibility, the broker is temporarily excused by the market conditions from timely performance of his coin-replacement obligation.

questions.explanation:
The doctrine of anticipatory repudiation
Did party clearly & unequivocally indicate unwillingness to perform?
No ➔ No anticipatory repudiation
Yes │ ▼
Anticipatory repudiation
│ ▼
Did party retract repudiation before other party did any of the following?
  • Canceled contract
  • Materially changed position or
  • Indicated repudiation is final
Yes ➔ Repudiation retracted
No │ ▼
Nonrepudiating party may:*
▼
▼
Treat repudiation as breach
OR
Ignore repudiation & demand performance
*The nonrepudiating party may also suspend its performance if commercially reasonable

The doctrine of anticipatory repudiation is applicable when a contracting party indicates an unwillingness to perform a promise before the time for performance arises or elapses. The repudiation must be clear and unequivocal, and it may be by words or actions. Upon repudiation, the nonrepudiating party may either treat the repudiation as a breach or ignore it and demand performance pursuant to the contract.

Here, the broker wrote the hoarder that "it seems unfair that I should have to replace your coin within the next few weeks." This statement did not clearly and unequivocally demonstrate the broker's intention not to perform pursuant to their contract. As a result, the broker's best argument supporting dismissal of the hoarder's breach-of-contract claim is that he did not repudiate the contract and may still perform no later than the contract deadline.*

*The broker's statement presents reasonable grounds for insecurity about his willingness to perform, so the hoarder has the right to make a written demand for assurances. The broker's failure to provide such assurances within 30 days would result in an anticipatory repudiation.

(Choice A) A repudiation may be retracted unless the nonrepudiating party has (1) canceled the contract, (2) materially changed position, or (3) indicated that he/she considers the repudiation final. But there is no requirement that the nonrepudiating party demand in writing that the repudiating party issue a retraction.

(Choice B) Specific performance is an available remedy when monetary damages would be inadequate because the property or chattel at issue is unique. But monetary damages would be adequate here since the parties contracted for a comparable specimen of the same kind of coin—not the exact same coin.

(Choice D) The doctrine of impossibility discharges a party's contractual duties when an unexpected and extraordinary event beyond the parties' control makes performance impossible. However, a change in market conditions is neither unexpected nor extraordinary. And the broker is able to perform since he can still purchase the coin, albeit at a higher price.

📌 Educational Objective

The doctrine of anticipatory repudiation applies when a party clearly and unequivocally repudiates (ie, indicates an unwillingness to perform) a promise before the time for performance arises or elapses. The nonrepudiating party may treat the repudiation as a breach or ignore it and demand performance pursuant to the contract.

📚 References
  • U.C.C. § 2-610 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (anticipatory repudiation).
questions.zh-question:
一名经纪人需要一枚特定的稀有硬币来完成一套他已签约组合并出售给一位收藏家的藏品。2月1日，该经纪人从一名囤积者处获得这样一枚硬币，作为交换，他支付了1000美元，并书面承诺“不迟于今年12月31日”向该囤积者返还一枚同类的可比硬币。2月2日，该经纪人完成了将整套藏品出售给收藏家的交易。

10月1日，稀有硬币的市场价格突然开始快速、持续上涨。10月15日，经纪人致信囤积者称：“鉴于惊人的市场行情，我不得不在未来几周内替换您的硬币，这似乎不公平。”10月17日，囤积者书面回复称，她将经纪人的毁约行为视为最终决定，并解除了合同。

11月15日，囤积者起诉经纪人，要求其赔偿一枚可比替换硬币的市场价值。

如果经纪人提出动议要求驳回囤积者的诉状，以下哪项是支持该动议的最佳论据？

zh-choices.A: 即使经纪人在10月15日毁约，囤积者也无法获得救济，因为她未能书面要求经纪人撤回其毁约。
zh-choices.B: 即使经纪人在10月15日毁约，囤积者唯一的诉讼理由也只能是要求特定履行，因为该硬币是独特的动产。
zh-choices.C: 经纪人并未在10月15日毁约，并且仍可在不晚于12月31日的合同截止日期前履行合同。
zh-choices.D: 根据 doctrine of impossibility，经纪人因市场状况而暂时免于履行其按时替换硬币的义务。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Performance, Breach, and Discharge

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：对方一句“看起来不公平”到底算不算预期违约（anticipatory repudiation），还是只是表示不安、但合同期限还没到。

三秒认题路径：

未到期 → 看是否明确拒绝 → 不够明确 → 继续可履行 → 选 C

核心法律规则

预期违约（anticipatory repudiation）的关键不是“未来会不会涨价”或“现在看起来很不爽”，而是对方在履行期前有没有明确且无歧义（clear and unequivocal）地表示不打算履行。非违约方（nonrepudiating party）碰到真正的拒绝时，可以把它当成违约，或者先不理它、继续要求履行。单纯抱怨、谈条件、表达困难都不够，考试上要找的是“我不履行了”这种硬拒绝。

核心判例： U.C.C. § 2-610 结合本题：买卖货物相关合同里，只有明确拒绝才触发预期违约；这里的话语还不够硬，所以不能直接算违约。

思维导图

先问：10月15日这句话，是不是在履行期前“明确且无歧义”地拒绝履行？
NO：“it seems unfair” 只是抱怨成本上升，没说“我不会交货”。
卡死点：没有明确拒绝，就没有 预期违约（anticipatory repudiation）。
结果：合同仍有效，履行期还在 12月31日之前。
YES：如果真有硬拒绝，才轮到对方选“当成违约”或“继续催履行”。
所以本题结论： broker 还能在截止日前继续履行，不能说他已经违约。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：价格暴涨了，他明显是在“变相赖账”。

但考试真正问的是：这句话够不够硬到可以直接算anticipatory repudiation，不是他现在情绪上是不是想反悔。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干 it seems unfair 只是表达不满，不是明确拒绝履行；所以 broker 仍可在 December 31 前继续完成义务。

❌ 概念混淆 | 书面撤回误判

✕ A: 把撤回条件看成要先书面催告，written demand 不是法律要求。

❌ 法律适用 | 救济类型误判

✕ B: 把“可比替代币”当成唯一物，硬套 specific performance。

❌ 事实误判 | 不可抗力夸大

✕ D: 见到涨价就想拉到 impossibility，但只是更贵，不是不能买。

这题建议用什么方法？

先盯“是否明确拒绝”，再分清“只是嫌贵”还是“真的不履行”。

考场速记

记住一句：预期违约（anticipatory repudiation）要看“硬拒绝”，不是看“嫌麻烦”。

这题的速记就是：没说不干 = 还没违约；说得太软 = 继续等到履行期。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A seller and a buyer entered into a written agreement providing that the seller was to deliver 1,000 cases of candy bars to the buyer during the months of May and June. Under the agreement, the buyer was obligated to make a selection by March 1 of the quantities of the various candy bars to be delivered under the contract. The buyer did not make the selection by March 1, and on March 2 the seller notified the buyer that because of the buyer's failure to select, the seller would not deliver the candy bars. The seller had all the necessary candy bars on hand on March 1 and made no additional sales or purchases on March 1 or March 2. On March 2, after receiving the seller's notice that it would not perform, the buyer notified the seller of its selection and insisted that the seller perform. The seller refused.
If the buyer sues the seller for breach of contract, is the buyer likely to prevail?

choices.A: No, because a contract did not exist until the buyer selected the specific candy bars, and the seller withdrew its offer before selection.
choices.B: No, because the buyer's selection of the candy bars by March 1 was an express condition to the seller's duty to perform.
choices.C: Yes, because the delay of one day in making the selection did not have a material effect on the seller.
choices.D: Yes, because upon the buyer's failure to make a selection by March 1, the seller had a duty to make a reasonable selection.

questions.explanation:
Contract not specifying assortment of goods

(UCC § 2-311)
Did buyer timely
select assortment?
Yes
Seller must follow
selection
No
Did delay materially
impact seller's
performance?
Yes
Seller can choose to:
  • proceed in reasonable manner or
  • treat nonselection as breach
No
Seller must
follow selection

Contracts for the sale of goods (eg, candy bars) are governed by Article 2 of the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC). When a sale-of-goods contract fails to specify the assortment of goods to be delivered (eg, the quantities of various candy bars), the UCC imposes a duty on the buyer to select the assortment of goods.* If the buyer fails to timely do so AND the delay materially impacts the seller's performance, then the seller can:

  • proceed in any reasonable manner (eg, choose a reasonable assortment of goods) or
  • treat the buyer's non-selection as a breach (Choice D).

Here, the parties agreed that the buyer would select an assortment of candy bars by March 1. Although the buyer made the selection on March 2, the delay did not materially impact the seller's performance. That is because the seller had all the necessary candy bars on hand and had entered into no new contracts at that time. As a result, the seller unjustifiably refused to accept the buyer's selection, and the buyer will likely prevail.

*In contrast, arrangements relating to shipping are the seller's duty to specify.

(Choice A) The UCC rejects the idea that a contract must specify the assortment of goods to be valid. Here, the contract stated the buyer could select the assortment later.

(Choice B) Absent language requiring strict compliance, the buyer's selection of the candy bars was a constructive or implied condition to the seller's duty to perform, which could be satisfied by substantially complying (eg, selecting a day late).

📌 Educational Objective

If the buyer fails to timely select the assortment of goods for delivery and the delay materially impacts the seller's performance, then the seller can (1) proceed in any reasonable manner or (2) treat the failure as a breach.

📚 References
  • UCC § 2-311 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (options and cooperation respecting performance).
questions.zh-question:
卖方和买方签订了一份书面协议，规定卖方在五月和六月期间向买方交付1000箱糖果棒。根据该协议，买方有义务在3月1日之前选定合同项下将要交付的各种糖果棒的数量。买方未能在3月1日前做出选择，于是在3月2日，卖方通知买方，由于买方未能选择，卖方将不交付糖果棒。卖方在3月1日备有所有必需的糖果棒，并且在3月1日或3月2日没有进行任何额外的销售或采购。3月2日，在收到卖方将不履约的通知后，买方向卖方通知了其选择，并坚持要求卖方履约。卖方拒绝了。

如果买方以违约为由起诉卖方，买方是否可能胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 不会，因为在买方选定具体的糖果棒之前合同并不存在，而卖方在选择前撤回了其要约。
zh-choices.B: 不会，因为买方在3月1日之前选择糖果棒是卖方履行义务的一个明示条件。
zh-choices.C: 会，因为延迟一天做出选择对卖方没有产生重大影响。
zh-choices.D: 会，因为在买方未能在3月1日前做出选择时，卖方有义务做出合理的选择。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Assortment of goods

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：货物种类未定（assortment of goods）时，买方晚一天选货是否真的让卖方受损；若没有实质影响，卖方不能借口拒绝履行。

三秒认题路径：

卖货合同 → 买方选货 → 晚一天 → 卖方是否受损 → 不能拒绝

核心法律规则

货物买卖合同（sale of goods contract）受UCC Article 2管；如果合同没把具体货物种类（assortment）写死，买方通常负有选择义务，考场意思：先由买方定规格，卖方按这个来交货。

但如果买方没按时选，只有在延迟materially影响卖方履行时，卖方才可以改用合理方式处理，或把不选择当成违约；考场意思：不是一晚就自动失效，要看卖方有没有被卡住。

本题里卖方在3月1日已经把所需糖果棒都备齐，而且没有新交易，所以买方3月2日才选并没有实质伤到卖方；卖方这时不能直接拒绝，反而应当按买方选择履行。

核心判例： UCC § 2-311（options and cooperation respecting performance）——确认买方迟延选货后，只有在影响卖方时，卖方才有改采合理方式或主张违约的空间。

思维导图

合同已成立
货物买卖已定，但assortment留给买方选。
3月1日截止
买方没按时选；别误以为卖方就立刻可以毁约。
关键分流
只看一件事：延迟有没有materially影响卖方。
本题事实
卖方已备齐货，且无新交易，损害为零。
结论
卖方必须跟随买方选择；拒绝履行构成违约。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：买方没在3月1日前选货，所以卖方就能马上不交货。

但考试真正问的是：这一天的拖延有没有真的卡到卖方的履行节奏；本题没有。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干明确写明卖方在3月1日已备齐全部糖果棒，买方只是晚一天选货，delay did not materially impact the seller，所以卖方不能拒收，买方能赢。

❌ 概念混淆 | 合同成立误判

✕ A: 把 did not specify 误听成合同没成立。

❌ 法律适用 | 严格履行误判

✕ B: 误把买方迟选当成必须严格守时的绝对条件。

❌ 事实误判 | 卖方责任偷换

✕ D: 题干没说卖方要替买方补选，reasonable selection 是套错义务。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓UCC下的协作义务，再问延迟有没有实质伤害卖方，没伤害就不能把迟延当借口。

考场速记

记住这句：买方晚选不等于卖方自动赢；先看有没有实质影响（materially impact），没有就继续按买方选择履行。

速记口诀：“晚选不必死，先看伤不伤。”

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
On July 1, a man and a developer contracted in writing for the sale and purchase of the man's farm, and to close the transaction on December 1.
On September 1, the developer unequivocally repudiated the contract. On September 15, the man urged the developer to change her mind and proceed with the scheduled closing on December 1. On October 1, having heard nothing further from the developer, the man sold and conveyed his farm to a farmer without notifying the developer. On December 1, the developer attempted to close under the July 1 contract by tendering the full purchase price to the man. The man rejected the tender.
The developer sued the man for breach of contract.
Will the developer likely prevail?

choices.A: No, because acceptance of the purchase price by the man was a concurrent condition to the man's obligation to convey the farm to the developer on December 1.
choices.B: No, because the developer did not retract her repudiation before the man materially changed his position in reliance thereon by selling the farm to the farmer.
choices.C: Yes, because the man failed seasonably to notify the developer of any pending sale to the farmer.
choices.D: Yes, because the man waived the developer's September 1 repudiation by urging her to retract it on September 15.

questions.explanation:
The doctrine of anticipatory repudiation
Did party clearly & unequivocally indicate unwillingness to perform?
No
No anticipatory repudiation
Yes
Anticipatory repudiation
Did party retract repudiation before other party did any of the following?
  • Canceled contract
  • Materially changed position or
  • Indicated repudiation is final
Yes
Repudiation retracted
No
Nonrepudiating party may:*
Treat repudiation as breach
OR
Ignore repudiation & demand performance
*The nonrepudiating party may also suspend its performance if commercially reasonable

The doctrine of anticipatory repudiation applies when a contracting party clearly and unequivocally repudiates (ie, indicates an unwillingness to perform) a promise before the time for performance arises or elapses. A repudiation can be retracted if the nonrepudiating party receives notice of the retraction before:

  • canceling the contract
  • materially changing position in reliance on the repudiation or
  • indicating that he/she considers the repudiation to be final.

If the repudiation is not retracted, the nonrepudiating party may (1) treat the repudiation as a breach or (2) ignore it and demand performance pursuant to the contract.

Here, the developer unequivocally repudiated the contract for the sale of the farm on September 1. One month later, the man sold and conveyed the farm to the farmer because the man had heard nothing from the developer. Since the developer did not retract her repudiation before the man materially changed his position in reliance thereon, the developer has no recourse for breach of contract. Therefore, the developer likely will not prevail.

(Choice A) The fact that the man did not accept the purchase price when the developer tendered it on December 1 is not the reason the developer will lose. Instead, the developer will lose because she repudiated the contract on September 1 and the man materially changed his position in reliance thereon by selling the farm to someone else.

(Choice C) The nonrepudiating party need not notify the repudiating party that the nonrepudiating party materially changed his/her position in reliance on the repudiation.

(Choice D) The fact that the man urged the developer to retract her repudiation did not waive the repudiation because only the developer can retract it.

📌 Educational Objective

A party who anticipatorily repudiates a contract may retract the repudiation if the nonrepudiating party is notified of the retraction before (1) canceling the contract, (2) materially changing position in reliance on the repudiation, or (3) indicating that he/she considers the repudiation final.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 253 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (effect of an anticipatory repudiation).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 256 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (retraction of repudiation).
questions.zh-question:
开发商以违约为由起诉该男子。

开发商是否可能胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 不会，因为该男子接受购买价款，是其在12月1日向开发商转让农场义务的一项同期履行条件。
zh-choices.B: 不会，因为在该男子因信赖开发商的拒绝履行表示而将农场出售给农民，从而实质性地改变其处境之前，开发商并未撤回其拒绝履行的表示。
zh-choices.C: 会，因为该男子未在适当时间内将任何待进行的向农民出售农场的事宜通知开发商。
zh-choices.D: 会，因为该男子在9月15日催促开发商撤回其拒绝履行的表示，从而放弃了追究开发商在9月1日拒绝履行合同的权利。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Anticipatory Repudiation

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：一方先明确毁约后，另一方在对方撤回前已经依赖地位并卖掉标的时，能不能再拿“后来想履行”来翻盘。

三秒认题路径：

先毁约 → 能否撤回 → 对方是否依赖 → 是否已卖房 → 不能翻盘

核心法律规则

只记这一条就够做题

先出现明确、无歧义的 预期违约（anticipatory repudiation），受害方可以继续等，也可以把它当成违约。若毁约方在对方收到撤回通知前，已经让对方 实质改变立场（materially changed position），撤回就来不及了。

这里的关键不是“后来有没有去交钱”，而是开发商在 9 月 1 日先撕约，男方随后卖掉农场，说明他已经按这个毁约去安排了自己的处置。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 253 与 § 256 的逻辑锁定本题：先毁约，再看撤回是否晚于对方依赖。

思维导图

先看有没有 明确且无歧义的拒绝履行？
Yes进入 预期违约（anticipatory repudiation）
再看毁约方有没有在对方行动前撤回？
对方是否已经 取消合同、实质改变立场，或把毁约当成最终决定？
本题卡死点：男方 10 月 1 日已卖房，说明撤回太晚
所以结论：男方可把毁约当成违约，开发商不能靠 12 月 1 日“来交钱”逆转。
No没有预期违约，按一般履行规则走

考点陷阱

你可能会想：男方 9 月 15 日还劝她撤回，说明他接受继续履行，所以她 12 月 1 日来交钱就该有效。

但考试真正问的是：她有没有在男方 卖掉农场 之前完成撤回；一旦男方已经按毁约去处理财产，晚来的“我改主意了”救不了。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干的关键事实是：开发商先在 9 月 1 日明确毁约，而男方在 10 月 1 日已把农场卖掉，说明她撤回太晚，不能再主张对方违约。

❌ 概念混淆 | 共同给付误判

✕ A: 把 concurrent condition 当成本题败点，忽略了真正先发生的是预期违约。

❌ 事实误判 | 通知义务偷换

✕ C: 硬加 seasonably notify，题干根本不要求男方先通知她自己卖房。

❌ 法律适用 | 撤回主体错位

✕ D: 以为劝她回头就等于放弃毁约效力，但只有毁约方自己才能撤回。

这题建议用什么方法？

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
In a signed writing, a man contracted to purchase a 25-foot travel trailer from a dealership for $15,000, cash on delivery, no later than June 1. The man arrived at the dealership's sales lot on Sunday, May 31, but he refused to pay for and take delivery of the trailer as contracted when he discovered that the spare tire was missing. The dealership offered to install a spare tire on Monday when its service department would open, but the man replied that he did not want the trailer and would purchase another one elsewhere.
Which of the following is accurate?

choices.A: The man had a right to reject the trailer and terminate the contract under the perfect-tender rule.
choices.B: The man had a right to reject the trailer, but the dealership was entitled to a reasonable opportunity to cure the defect.
choices.C: The man was required to accept the trailer, because the defect could be readily cured.
choices.D: The man was required to accept the trailer, because the defect did not substantially impair its value.

questions.explanation:
Seller's right to cure
(UCC § 2-508)
Within time for performance Seller has right to cure by:
  • giving reasonable notice to buyer of intention to cure AND
  • making conforming delivery within time for performance
After time for performance If seller had reasonable grounds to believe goods were acceptable at delivery, seller has right to cure by:
  • giving reasonable notice to buyer of intention to cure AND
  • making conforming delivery within reasonable time
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

Contracts for the sale of goods are governed by Article 2 of the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC). Under the UCC perfect-tender rule, a buyer may reject goods in a single-delivery contract—ie, a one-time bargained-for exchange—that fail to conform to the contract in any way. But if the time for performance has not yet expired, a seller may cure (ie, remedy) a defect by:

  • giving reasonable notice to the buyer of its intention to cure and
  • making a conforming delivery within the time for performance under the contract.

Here, the man contracted to purchase a 25-foot travel trailer from a dealership (single-delivery contract). The trailer was missing a spare tire (nonconforming good) when the man attempted to take delivery on May 31, so he had a right to reject the trailer. But since delivery was to occur no later than June 1, the dealership had a right to cure the defect by notifying the man of its intention to cure and then delivering a conforming trailer by June 1 (Choices A & C).

(Choice D) To reject nonconforming goods under an installment contract, the nonconformity must (1) substantially impair the value of the goods and (2) be incurable. But under a single-delivery contract, a buyer may reject goods that fail to conform to the contract in any way.

📌 Educational Objective

In a single-delivery contract, the buyer may reject nonconforming goods. But if there is still time to perform under the contract, the seller has the right to cure the defect by (1) giving the buyer reasonable notice of its intention to cure and (2) making a conforming delivery within the time for performance under the contract.

📚 References
  • U.C.C. § 2-508 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (seller's right to cure).

一名男子以书面形式签订合同，以15,000美元的价格从一家经销商处购买一辆25英尺的旅行拖车，约定货到付款，交付时间不迟于6月1日。该男子于5月31日（星期日）到达经销商的销售场地，但在发现拖车缺少一个备用轮胎时，他拒绝按照合同约定支付款项并接收拖车。经销商主动提出在周一其维修部门开门时安装一个备用轮胎，但该男子回答说他不要这辆拖车，并将在别处购买另一辆。

以下哪项陈述是准确的？

zh-choices.A: 根据完全履行规则，该男子有权拒绝接收该拖车并终止合同。
zh-choices.B: 该男子有权拒绝接收该拖车，但经销商有权获得一个合理的机会来补救该瑕疵。
zh-choices.C: 该男子必须接收该拖车，因为该瑕疵可以被轻易补救。
zh-choices.D: 该男子必须接收该拖车，因为该瑕疵并未实质性地损害其价值。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Remedies Under the UCC

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：单次交货的货物买卖里，买方虽然可以按 perfect-tender rule 拒收不合格货物，但只要履行期限还没到，卖方就有 补救权（right to cure），所以不能直接判死刑。

三秒认题路径：

单次交货 → 货物有瑕疵 → 期限未到 → 卖方可补救 → 不能立刻终止

核心法律规则

只背这一条就够做题

货物买卖（sale of goods） 走 UCC Article 2。单次交货合同里，买方遇到不合格货物时，确实可以按 完美履行规则（perfect-tender rule） 拒收。可是一旦 履行期限（time for performance） 还没过，卖方就能先 补救（cure）：先给买方合理通知，再在期限内交付合格货物。

考试上这句话的意思是：买方现在不能把卖方一脚踢出局，因为合同还没到最后截止日，卖方还有机会把缺的东西补上。

核心判例： U.C.C. § 2-508 — 只要时间还没到，卖方先通知、后补交合格货物，就能把瑕疵修回来。

思维导图

签约时点
买卖的是 旅行拖车（travel trailer），属于货物合同，先想到 UCC。
5月31日
买方来取货时发现 spare tire missing，这就是不合格。
关键门槛
但合同写明最迟 June 1 交货，说明 履行期限 还没过。
卖方动作
卖方说次日装上 spare tire，并愿意交付合格拖车，这是典型 cure。
结论
买方可以先拒收，但不能直接说合同完了；卖方有合理机会补救，所以答案落在 B。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：缺一个零件 就是不合格，所以买方当然能直接拒收并终止合同。

但考试真正问的是：在履行期限还没到的时候，卖方有没有先把货补合格的机会。

这里最容易混的是：买方能拒收，和买方能立刻终止，是两回事。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干的 June 1 仍在最后交货期限内，所以卖方还有 补救权（right to cure）；买方能先拒收，但不能直接把合同判死。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 只盯着 perfect-tender，忘了卖方还没到截止日。

❌ 法律适用 | 补救条件倒置

✕ C: 把“能补救”偷换成“买方必须收货”。

❌ 事实误判 | 价值门槛偷换

✕ D: 把 substantially impair 硬搬来单次交货合同。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看是不是货物合同，再卡住履行期限，最后判断卖方能不能先 cure。

考场速记

记住一句：单次交货 + 期限未到 = 买方可拒收，但卖方通常有补救权。看到“缺件”先别急着选终止，先问一句：time for performance 过了吗？

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
The manager of a state fair contracted with a renowned hog breeder to exhibit the breeder's only world-champion hog for the three weeks of the annual fair. At the conclusion of the fair the breeder would receive $300. Two days before the opening of the fair, the hog became sick with a communicable disease among swine and, under the applicable state quarantine law, could not be exhibited for at least a month.
Upon learning this, which of the following courses of action can the manager legally pursue with respect to his contract with the breeder?

choices.A: Suspend his own performance and recover damages from the breeder for breach of contract unless the breeder at once supplies a healthy hog of exhibition quality as a substitute for the world-champion hog.
choices.B: Suspend his own performance, demand assurances from the breeder, and treat a failure by the breeder to produce the hog as an actionable repudiation.
choices.C: Terminate his own performance and treat the hog's illness as discharging all remaining duties under the contract.
choices.D: Terminate the contract, but only if the manager promptly seeks to obtain for the exhibit a suitable substitute for the world-champion hog from another hog owner.

questions.explanation:
When an unanticipated event makes a party's contractual duties impracticable to perform, those duties will be discharged if:

  • nonoccurrence of the event was a basic assumption of the contract and
  • the party seeking discharge is not at fault.

Here, the manager contracted to exhibit the breeder's only world-champion hog at the annual state fair. Two days before the fair opened, the hog became sick. That unanticipated event rendered performance impracticable since the hog could not be exhibited for at least a month under state law. And since the hog's ability to be exhibited was a basic assumption of the contract and the manager was not at fault, the manager can terminate his own performance and treat the hog's illness as discharging all remaining duties under the contract.

(Choice A) If possible, a party must render a reasonable substitute performance in place of the impracticable part. But a healthy hog of exhibition quality is not a reasonable substitute for the breeder's only world-champion hog.

(Choice B) If reasonable grounds arise to believe that a party will not perform because of impracticability, the other party cannot demand assurances of performance and treat a failure to give them as a repudiation. That is because the prospective nonperformance would not be a breach.

(Choice D) The manager's right to terminate his performance under the contract does not depend on whether he first seeks to obtain a suitable substitute for the world-champion hog from another hog owner.

📌 Educational Objective

When an unanticipated event makes a party's contractual duties impracticable to perform, those duties will be discharged if (1) nonoccurrence of the event was a basic assumption of the contract and (2) the party seeking discharge is not at fault.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 261 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (impracticability).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 278 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (substituted performance).

得知此事后，关于其与养猪人的合同，经理可以合法采取下列哪项行动？

zh-choices.C: 终止自己的履行，并将猪的疾病视为解除了合同项下所有剩余的义务。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance, Breach, and Discharge - Impracticability

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：不可行履行（impracticability）发生后，合同义务能不能直接解除，而不是继续逼对方找替代品。

三秒认题路径：

突发疾病 → 法定隔离 → 履行变难 → 基本假设落空 → 义务解除

核心法律规则

只抓这条规则

当一个未预见事件（unanticipated event）让合同履行变得不可行（impracticable）时，义务可以被解除，但前提是：该事件的不发生是合同的基本假设（basic assumption），而且请求解除的一方没有过错（not at fault）。

这里，赛前两天猪突然得了会传染的病，州法又直接禁止展出，所以不是“只是麻烦”，而是“法律上不能按原计划履行”。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 261, § 278 - 这题就是用来考：真正的替代履行不能被强行拼出来时，剩余义务可以直接消失。

思维导图

先问：这是不是终局判决 final judgment？
不是。 继续看有没有法定中间上诉；本题没有。
再问： 能不能走附带命令原则 collateral-order doctrine？
1. 重要吗？重要。
2. 独立于实体吗？勉强可以。
3. 关键卡点：终局后还能复审，所以不是“无法有效救济”（effectively reviewable）。
所以结论： 这类律师-当事人特权披露令一般不能立刻上诉，先等终局判决再救济。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然只能拿那头“冠军猪”展出，那现在找不到同等级替代品，是不是就要先逼对方补救、继续履行？

但考试真正问的是：州法已经把这头猪锁死了，合同目的被打断，impracticability 直接触发解除，不是先去折腾替代供应。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干的 赛前两天突发传染病 + 州法禁止展出 让履行失去现实可能，且不是管理人过错，所以他可以终止自己的履行，并把这次疾病视为解除余下义务的事由。

❌ 概念混淆 | 代替履行误判

✕ A: 把 substitute performance 当成必须硬找的救命绳。

❌ 法律适用 | 保障程序错套

✕ B: 把 demand assurances 套到这里，但不可行不是违约预警。

❌ 事实误判 | 先找替代条件

✕ D: 误以为必须先找 another hog owner 才能解除。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看是否满足不可行履行，再看有没有把“替代”“催告”这些无关动作硬塞进来。

考场速记

记忆口诀：unanticipated event + basic assumption + not at fault = discharge。看到“突发事件把履行卡死”，先想解除，不先想催告或找替代。

再记一遍：impracticability 盯的是“还能不能按合同原样做”，不是“做起来是不是更贵、更麻烦”。
